jobs.description:
The Physical Therapist reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Medicine, adheres to the organization's Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Description

• Demonstrates the four NM values of teamwork, patients first, integrity, and excellence in daily work and interactions.
• Presents a friendly, approachable, professional demeanor and appearance.
• Provides accurate information and timely updates to patients and customers. Addresses questions and concerns promptly or identifies appropriate person and resources to do so. Provides directions to help patients and customers with finding their way.
• Uses effective service recovery skills to solve problems or service breakdowns when they occur.
• Maintains primary responsibility over patient plan of care through timely and consistent collaboration with treating PT/ PTA s.
• Demonstrates teamwork by helping co-workers within and across departments. Communicates effectively with others, respects diverse opinions and styles, and acknowledges the assistance and contributions of others.
• Uses organizational and unit/department resources efficiently.
• Manages work schedule efficiently, completing tasks and assignments on time.
• Contributes to opportunities and processes for continuous improvement.
• Participates in efforts to reduce costs, streamline work processes, improve and grow services we provide.
• Demonstrates creative problem solving and diversity when adapting the treatment to special circumstances as evidence by team feedback and documentation.
• Demonstrates essential skill competencies in selecting the appropriate evaluation in the use of treatment modalities, equipment and protocols. Performs re-evaluations according to department guidelines, adjusting the treatment plan accordingly. Evidenced by chart review.
• Assumes complete responsibility over the course of physical therapist patient management from the time of initial contact to discharge for functional progress, safety and treatment outcome as evidenced by team feedback and documentation. Maintains primary responsibility over patient plans of care through timely and consistent collaboration with treating PTA(s).
• Adheres to department policy regarding evaluations, progress notes, and discharge summaries. All notes are documented in electronic medical record (EMR).
• Completes daily notes that reflect patient’s response to treatment, actual performance, and an assessment as to status, relevant to the treatment plan and eventual discharge needs as evidenced by chart review, meeting all documentation requirements (e.g., allows other therapists to continue treatment, allows for interpretation by payers, supports reimbursement).
• Provides educational materials and methods appropriate to the patient’s level of understanding and motivation as evidenced by chart review, observation and team feedback.
• Participates in committees, department processes and special projects in accordance with clinical expertise and individual performance plan.
• Works to develop and maintain professional relationships with members of healthcare teams (ex: physician, nurse, case manager). Participates in internal and external marketing per department expectations.
• Creates a culture of respectful communication by listening, asking for team member input, open and honest conversation, approachability, and timely acknowledgement of individual and team contributions.
• Accepts constructive feedback and can make timely changes as evidenced by written coaching forms/chart audits and team feedback.
• Proactively completes non-patient care responsibilities within established timelines (coverage notes, PTO/schedule change requests, bonus pay (forms and follow up phone calls).
• Contributes to educational efforts of department/clinic (e.g., in-services, journal clubs, new hire orientation, PI) as per department expectations.
• Actively participates in student clinical or observation programs by serving as a clinical instructor, mentor, or observation host as per department expectations
• Maintains productivity standards per department expectations
• Demonstrates willingness to flex schedule or assignment to meet patient care needs, staff meetings and department specific meetings outside of normal work hours.

AA/EOE.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Physical Therapy.
• Licensed Physical Therapist in State of Illinois
• BLS from the American Heart Association within 90 days of hire

• Lymphedema Certification

About ParetoHealth

ParetoHealth is redefining the way employers fund healthcare. As the largest and fastest-growing benefits captive in the United States, we help thousands of small and midsize employers take control of healthcare costs through a smarter, more sustainable model.

Our mission is simple: give small and midsize employers the scale and protection they need to eliminate volatility and lower healthcare costs.

By combining data-driven insights, innovative risk management, and the collective purchasing power of our community, we enable employers to reduce volatility, improve long-term outcomes, and reinvest savings into their businesses and their people.

Headquartered in Philadelphia, ParetoHealth is growing rapidly and transforming one of the country's largest industries. Our success is fueled by talented people who are united by our four core values: Fire in the Belly, For the Greater Good, See the Field, and Get It Done Right. These values shape how we innovate, collaborate, make decisions, and deliver exceptional results for our clients and one another.

If you're energized by solving complex challenges, thrive in a high-growth environment, and want to help reshape the future of healthcare, we'd love to meet you.

Competitive candidates will be smart, personable, with a proactive attitude with a focus on learning and team collaboration. Bonus points for applicants who are quick—to learn, laugh, and make an impact within a nimble organization with big plans. In return, Pareto offers a casual and fun work environment, full of people who take the company mission—but not themselves—incredibly seriously

• Interest in Project Management

• Ability to manage multiple tasks effectively

• Gaining valuable hands-on experience.

• Assist in developing and maintaining tools, resources, and workflows to enhance underwriting efficiency.

• Contribute to initiatives aimed at strengthening the Underwriting team capabilities and capacity.

• Currently pursuing a degree in Finance, Risk Management, Data Analytics, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Serve as a resource for staff and physicians for daily problem solving and decision-making. Maintain a consistent alertness to patient care needs and take a proactive approach to address/resolve issues. Delegate appropriate tasks according to Illinois law and organizational protocols to Licensed Practical Nurses and Medical Assistants.

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72 occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.

Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

DRIVING SPECIFIC JOB DUTIES

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

REQUIRES

Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Carrying

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing walking and climbing duties.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Walking

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Climbing

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure To

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

Far vision and night vision for driving

jobs.title: Production Manager
jobs.description:
Manages and coordinates activities concerned with all production areas including cleaning, operation and equipment upkeep by performing the following duties personally or through subordinate leaders.  Responsibilities include determining the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of each production area.  Completed documentation and carries out responsibilities in accordance with company policy and procedures.

The duties and responsibilities of this position shall consist of, but not be limited to, the following:

SAFETY

• Perform all duties within OSHA and company safety standards; LOTO, wear PPE and maintain safety equipment.
• Enforce all safety rules and company policies.
• Maintain a safe, clean and organized work area.
• Immediately report all accidents and deficiencies to management, complete accident investigations.
• Ensure safety devices are installed and working properly.
• Monitor work environment for general food safety hazards such as condensation monitoring, etc.
• Performs other duties and responsibilities as necessary.

GENERAL

• Responsible for overseeing production across all shifts
• Coordinates work schedule and work procedures to meet production schedules.
• Analyzes and resolves problems or assists team members in solving problems.
• Ensures start ups are timely .
• Investigate production issues and work to identify root cause and corrective actions.
• Develop and maintain SOP’s and other Work Instructions.
• Confer daily with maintenance management and production personnel on production related mechanical problems.
• Complete documentation and carry our responsibilities in accordance with company policies and procedures.
• Route reports and records to designated plant personnel.
• Follow Lean Manufacturing Processes, team building, consistency in high quality, preventative maintenance, good workplace conditions, productive work, etc.
• Identify and recommend process improvements.
• Work closely with CI to determine ideal rates, staffing, procedures, etc.

PERSONNEL

• Follow good manufacturing practices and training, along with company pre-requisite programs, SOP’s, and SSOP’s
• Ensure that all team members are adequately and properly trained in safety, sanitation procedures, chemical handling, and GMP’s, etc.
• Ensure proper staffing is maintained, including interviewing and hiring new team members.
• Implement and monitor training for new hires & continuing training of current team members.
• Ensure supervisors maintain attendance records, counsel team members with poor attendance, & follow up with coaching/discipline as appropriate.
• Appraise work performance: conduct appropriate reviews for team members; give coaching/discipline as appropriate in a consistent and timely manner.
• Review, correct, and approve timekeeping tool to ensure team members are paid correctly each pay-period.
• Provide appropriate interpretation of company policies and safety policies for team members.

• Provide direct/indirect supervision to production Team Members.
• Performs other duties and responsibilities as necessary.

LEADERSHIP

• Build and support a culture at their location which values Personnel Safety and Food Safety.
• Must demonstrate the Jack Link’s Values: Be Real – Relationship Driven – Stewardship – Speed Matters – Self Discipline – Show Awesome character
• Build and support a culture of openness and accountability within (and outside) the assigned department.
• Demonstrate professionalism; encourage and insist on positive attitudes and behaviors from team members.
• Encourage team member initiative and innovation and show recognition for effort & achievement.
• Create and cultivate positive work relationships at all levels of the plant/organization.
• Discuss work goals vs. actual output with team members to motivate and engage team members to assure targets are met.
• Develop bench strength by identifying strong leaders within the group and create Individual Development Plans (IDPs).
• Ensure processes are followed to ensure the highest level of quality.

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Required Education: High School Diploma or GED

Required Experience: 2 years** of experience in the food industry plus prior supervisory experience

Preferred: Bachelor’s Degree and 5 or more years of successful supervisory experience in a food manufacturing environment

*A High School Diploma or GED is equivalent to two years of experience

**An Associate’s Degree or higher can be taken into consideration for 2 years of experience

REQUIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE and ABILITIES:

• Proven understanding of manufacturing operations in the food industry.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills; must work effectively with all levels of management and employees
• Demonstrated effective leadership, problem solving, planning, presentation, and employee motivational skills.
• Good computer skills including; Internet navigation, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
• Some Travel Required 10%
• Management skills
• Proven track record in managing production
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, set priorities, identify and address problems, meet deadlines, and stay within budget

jobs.description:
VP of Technical Marketing – PQShield

Reports to: Chief Commercial Officer

Location: [Remote / UK / US] ·You must have the right to work in one the above countries in order to be considered for the role.

💼 About the role

PQShield is looking for a VP of Technical Marketing to make PQShield the technology and the brand the industry thinks of first for post-quantum security.

You will be the commercial team's technical voice in the market. You'll build the solutions and partnerships that help our sales team grow the pipeline, develop the semiconductor ecosystem around our IP, and lead technical thought leadership with customers, partners, standards bodies, and industry analysts.

Since NIST published its first post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards, which the PQShield team co-authored, semiconductor companies, OEMs, and system builders across automotive, defense, industrial IoT, networking, and enterprise face a hard and urgent transition. This role puts PQShield at the center of that transition — through the partners who build with our IP, the solutions customers deploy, and the industry relationships that shape how the market moves.

This is a senior role for someone who combines a security IP background with deep industry relationships, and who knows how to turn both into revenue.

⚒️ What you’ll be doing

• Build solutions that grow pipeline: Create reference solutions, joint offerings, and use-case packages that give sales clear, repeatable ways into accounts. Combine PQPlatform, PQPerform, PQCryptoLib, and PQMicroLib with partner technology into solutions customers can adopt quickly.

• Develop the semiconductor ecosystem: Build and manage relationships with semiconductor suppliers, foundries, EDA and IP partners, processor and security-subsystem providers, and design services firms. Make PQShield IP the default choice for PQC in their roadmaps, reference designs, and platforms.

• Drive partnerships that create demand: Identify, structure, and launch technical partnerships that open new markets and channels. Own the technical case for each partnership and ensure it produces pipeline, not just announcements.

• Lead technical thought leadership: Be the senior technical voice of the commercial team. Speak at industry conferences, brief analysts and press, author white papers and technical articles, and represent PQShield in standards and industry forums.

• Use industry relationships to build the brand: Leverage your network across semiconductors, security, and system OEMs to establish PQShield as the key technology and brand for post-quantum security.

• Arm the commercial team technically: Give sales, FAEs, and partners the technical narratives, architectures, competitive positioning, and solution content they need to win complex, multi-stakeholder deals with engineers, architects, and executives.

• Shape the market narrative: Define how the industry thinks about the post-quantum transition, cryptographic agility, side-channel and fault-injection protection, and certification (FIPS 140-3, SESIP, Common Criteria, ISO 26262) — and where PQShield fits.

• Lead technical launches: Plan and deliver the technical go-to-market for new products, certifications, reference designs, and partner integrations.

• Bring the market back in: Feed customer, partner, and competitive insight into product and engineering so our roadmap stays ahead of where the market is heading.

• Build the team: Hire and lead a technical marketing team as the role scales.

What success looks like in your first 12 months

We will measure this role on the following deliverables:

• Reference designs: Deliver 2 PQShield reference designs on widely used MCUs or SoCs, built with silicon partners and used in active sales opportunities.

• Semiconductor ecosystem: Sign 5 ecosystem partners, such as silicon vendors, EDA and IP partners, or design services firms, that include PQShield IP in their roadmaps, reference designs or platforms.

• Joint roadmap meetings and OEM requirements: Run 10 joint roadmap meetings that bring together an OEM, its silicon supplier and PQShield, and secure 5 OEM letters or RFQs that ask silicon suppliers for PQC capability.

• Partner-sourced pipeline: Create identifiable silicon pipeline from ecosystem partners and joint roadmap meetings, tagged as influenced in CRM, that contributes to the company goals of 3x pipeline coverage and 15 design wins in 2027.

• Solutions: Launch 3 solution packages that combine PQShield products with partner technology for priority use cases, each with a reference architecture, a solution brief and a demo.

• Thought leadership: Deliver 6 conference talks or analyst briefings and 4 technical white papers or articles, and represent PQShield in at least one standards or industry working group.

• Market insight: Deliver a quarterly report to product and engineering on partner, customer and competitive requirements.

🎯 Required Skills And Qualifications

We're looking for a senior technical marketing leader with a security IP background, a strong industry network, and a track record of turning partnerships and technical credibility into revenue.

• 12+ years in semiconductor IP, security, or embedded technology, with at least 5 years in technical marketing, solutions, business development, or ecosystem leadership roles.

• A background in security IP — for example, hardware security modules, root of trust, secure enclaves, cryptographic accelerators, or embedded security software.

• Established relationships across semiconductor suppliers, IP and EDA vendors, system OEMs, and the security industry that you can use to open doors and build PQShield's position.

• A proven record of building ecosystem programs and partnerships that measurably grew pipeline and revenue.

• Credibility as a technical thought leader: experience speaking at industry events, writing for technical audiences, and engaging analysts, press, and standards bodies.

• Ability to work in depth with cryptographers and engineers, and to explain complex security technology to engineers, architects, CISOs, CTOs, and business executives.

• A strong commercial mindset: you measure success by pipeline, design wins, and revenue.

• Experience supporting complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles in semiconductor or OEM markets.

• Comfortable building in a fast-moving company where the market narrative is still being written.

Strong advantages

• Experience at Arm, or in the Arm ecosystem.

• Knowledge of cryptography, post-quantum cryptography, side-channel and fault-injection countermeasures, or security certifications such as FIPS 140-3, SESIP, or Common Criteria.

• Familiarity with functional safety standards such as ISO 26262, or with automotive, defense, or industrial IoT markets.

What we can offer you

• A competitive compensation package.

• Share options.

• A remote first company. You will work from home most of the time, but will need to join us in the office for planning sessions and key meetings as required.

• Travel for customer meetings and marketing events as needed.

• Health insurance.

• Generous PTO and holiday package.

• Company contributions towards 401K/pension

• …and other great benefits.

If you enjoy working as part of a technology company, value the security of our daily digital lives, and love solving hard problems - then we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Supervises a team of Production Workers and their daily activities to ensure the needs of all functions within the area are met (production, training, safety, security and housekeeping).  Provides leadership/direction to the team and ensures that all the procedures for food safety and manufacturing high quality products are achieved.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

The duties and responsibilities of this position shall consist of, but not be limited to, the following:

Personnel

• Ensure proper staffing is maintained, including interviewing and hiring new team members.
• Implement and monitor training for new hires & ongoing training of current team members.
• Maintain attendance records, counsel team members with poor attendance, & follow up with coaching/discipline as appropriate.
• Evaluate team member work performance, conduct appropriate reviews for team members, address complaints and resolve conflicts, reward or discipline accordingly. Provide input for termination decisions.
• Review, correct, and approve timekeeping tool to ensure team members are paid correctly each pay-period.

Safety

• Enforce all safety rules and company policies; provide appropriate interpretation of company policies and safety policies for team members.
• Immediately report all accidents and deficiencies to management; complete accident investigations and report within 24 hours of incident.
• Verify work and storage areas are maintained, safe, clean, and organized.
• Ensure safety devices are installed and working properly.
• Perform all duties within OSHA and company safety standards; Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO), wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and maintain safety equipment.
• Complete and review all Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP), and Standard Sanitation Operating Procedures (SSOP) requirements and paperwork. This includes but not limited to Pre-Operational Inspection, Operational Inspections, Pre-Shipment Review, and Corrective Actions.

Quality

• Ensure quality protocols are followed and openly communicated with QC and the Plant Manager in order to fix defects and ensure quality standards are consistently met.
• Maintains quality product by establishing and enforcing organization standards.
• Recommend methods to improve manufacturing processes including equipment performance to ensure product quality and increase efficiencies.
• Supports successful implementation of SQF (Safe Quality Foods) within the facility.
• Drive and support Continuous Improvement (CI) efforts.
• Understand the concepts of FIFO (First-In-First-Out) on perishable products and ensure successful implementation of FIFO throughout packaging operations within the facility.
• Ensure all required sanitation functions are within acceptable standards.

Productivity

• Monitor and track inedible, rework and down time generated by machine.
• Perform production paperwork, receiving, and inventory control procedures with complete accuracy.
• Identifies, through a proactive approach, potential cost-saving and efficiency gain opportunities to improve overall operations.
• Discuss work goals vs. actual output with team members to motivate and engage team members to assure targets are met.
• Identify, control and follow up on losses incurred due to substandard supplies, i.e., time and materials.
• Manage inventory and cost control.
• Implement and monitor weekly requisitions for daily supplies and manufacturing supplies.
• Conduct accurate weekly, period end, and year-end departmental inventories.
• Compile, store, and retrieve production data.

Leadership

• Provides direction to team members to ensure quality products and adherence to productivity goals and cost standards
• Demonstrate professionalism; encourage and insist on positive attitudes and behaviors from team members such as dependability, and trustworthiness in team members.
• Create and cultivate positive work relationships at all levels of the plant/organization.
• Build and support a culture of openness and accountability within (and outside) the assigned department.

Communication

• Communicate with peers, subordinates, and leaders in an effective, timely manner
• Keep Assistant Plant Manager & other leaders informed daily of problems incurred during shift.
• Confer with appropriate personnel to coordinate activities between departments.

Misc. Responsibilities

• Coordinate all functions related to the operations of all processing procedures, and specifications.
• Monitor product coding related to the lot traceability program and ensure its accuracy.
• Performs other duties and responsibilities as necessary.

Schedule

Monday-Thursday

2:30 pm - 1:00 am (hours may vary)

Required Education: High School Diploma or GED*

Required Experience: Minimum of 2 years’ experience in manufacturing and 1-3 years Lead experience

Preferred: 2 years of Supervisory experience, Leadership in food manufacturing industry.

*A high school diploma or GED is equivalent to two years of relevant experience

REQUIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE and ABILITIES:

• Able to supervise, instruct, and direct Team Members
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, set priorities, identify and address problems
• Able to organize and prioritize in a multi-tasking environment.
• Ability to communicate professionally with people both inside and outside the organization
• Knowledge of plant/distribution center models and production/logistics processes
• Superior accuracy and attention to detail.
• Planning Skill
• Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment.
• Must possess math and mechanical aptitude

Solid verbal and written communication skills; must work effectively with all levels of management and employees

Must demonstrated effective leadership, problem solving, presentation, and employee motivational skills.

Proficient in Internet navigation, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

ParetoHealth is redefining the way employers fund healthcare. As the largest and fastest-growing benefits captive in the United States, we help thousands of small and midsize employers take control of healthcare costs through a smarter, more sustainable model.

Our mission is simple: give small and midsize employers the scale and protection they need to eliminate volatility and lower healthcare costs.

By combining data-driven insights, innovative risk management, and the collective purchasing power of our community, we enable employers to reduce volatility, improve long-term outcomes, and reinvest savings into their businesses and their people.

Headquartered in Philadelphia, ParetoHealth is growing rapidly and transforming one of the country's largest industries. Our success is fueled by talented people who are united by our four core values: Fire in the Belly, For the Greater Good, See the Field, and Get It Done Right. jobs.title: Civil Engineering Transit Intern
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Civil Engineering Transit Intern to join our growing Transit Engineering Group in Chicago, Illinois. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to the Chicago Transit Authority (CTA) Forest Park Branch Rebuild project to revitalize the Congress Line corridor. Internship experience will include assisting with the final design of the Forest Park Branch Rebuild project, which is currently one of the most critical projects in the CTA's system. AECOM also led the design of Phase I of the Forest Park Branch Rebuild. Apply now to help shape the future of transit in Chicago.

This position is expected to begin in May 2027.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Assists with the engineering design of rail projects—including track design, corridor modeling, design plan development —under the supervision of an experienced engineer.
• Learns transit design alongside the AECOM Transit Design Group through various initiatives stretching beyond our projects to elevate our group’s expertise in transit design. Various initiatives include creating PowerPoint slides for technical design sessions, updating project sheets, and centralizing examples of specific elements of transit rail projects.
• Work collaboratively with other interns and engineers within our transit, roadway design, structures, water, and environmental departments of our office.
• Builds analytic and design skills.
• Creates designs, calculations, sketches, diagrams, schematic drawings, and final working drawings in Bentley OpenRail Designer under the supervision of an experienced engineer.
• Uses computer software as a tool for solving basic engineering problems.
• Performs work under supervision following an agreed-upon budget and schedule.
• Contributes to the development of reports and documentation needed for the pursuit of federal grants.
• Conducts limited field work related to the design process.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

• Candidates must be pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering and must have completed at least two years of study . Candidates who have recently graduated with a Bachelor’s degree and plan to continue with the Master’s degree are eligible to apply for these positions. Recent graduates must have been enrolled in their bachelor’s degree in the most previous school term with an interest in pursuing an advanced degree in the same or similar discipline at the conclusion of the internship.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Previous internship or co-op experience with an emphasis in civil engineering fields such as rail design, roadway design, site design, utility design, stormwater, and multimodal transportation projects.
• Desire to help shape high quality transit systems in cities across the United States, including a focus next summer on significant transit projects in Chicago.
• Involved in student organizations such as AREMA, APTA, ASCE, SWE, ITE, WISE, EWB, WTS, Steel Bridge, Concrete Canoe, and Chi Epsilon.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
• Working knowledge of Bentley MicroStation/OpenRail/OpenRoads .
• Basic knowledge of transportation topics.
• Willingness to pursue an Engineer-in-Training certification upon graduation by having passed or have a plan to pass the Fundamentals of Engineering exam.
• An understanding of AREMA, APTA, CDOT, and/or IDOT Standards.
• An ability to coordinate among multiple disciplines including track, civil, drainage, electrical, structural, and urban planning.
• Good interpersonal skills, good command of the English language both verbally and written, the ability to express thoughts clearly, good time management skills, and a good attitude toward work.
• Ability to work as a member of a team or perform independent work as required.

• Sponsorship for U.S. employment authorization is not available for this position.
• Relocation assistance is not available for this role.

To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Regional Materials Management
jobs.description:
Purpose:

The Sr. Manager, Regional Materials Management is responsible for leading regional materials management activities for raw materials, commodities, and shared critical supplies across the biologics manufacturing region. The role drives inventory optimization, material availability, risk mitigation, and cross-site coordination to ensure uninterrupted supply while improving operational efficiency, inventory performance, and network responsiveness.

Major Responsibilities:

• Lead regional planning and inventory management activities for raw materials, commodities, and shared critical supplies across multiple manufacturing sites.
• Monitor regional inventory positions and direct inventory balancing, transfers, and redeployment strategies across sites to optimize supply continuity and mitigate surplus inventory to minimize obsolescence.
• Serve as the primary escalation point for regional material shortages, supply disruptions, and inventory-related risks.
• Partner with Procurement to develop material supply strategies and support sourcing decisions for shared and critical materials.
• Lead regional initiatives to standardize material management processes, inventory policies, and planning practices across the network.
• Support governance forums, planning reviews, and business processes including S&OP, Financial Plan, and Long-Range Planning activities.
• Collaborate with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, Tech Ops, Procurement, and Finance leadership to resolve constraints and align priorities.
• Monitor and report key performance indicators related to inventory health, material availability, stock-outs, excess and obsolete inventory, and planning effectiveness.
• Partner with PDS&T, Procurement, AoS, CMM and Single Use COEs to develop and implement plans for deploying new materials and phasing out obsolete technologies
• Lead continuous improvement projects focused on materials planning, inventory management, warehousing, logistics, and process efficiency.

• Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
• 10+ years of Supply Chain, Materials Management, Manufacturing Operations, or Planning experience, including experience operating across multiple sites or a network environment.
• Experience within the manufacturing industry (pharmaceutical or biotechnology highly preferred).
• Direct experience with SAP, preferably S/4HANA, supporting materials management and supply planning processes.
• Demonstrated leadership of cross-functional initiatives involving inventory optimization, supply continuity, and operational improvement
• Strong analytical skills: ability to assimilate and interpret large data sets and translate into actions.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across all organizational levels; ability to influence without authority.

Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law: ​

• The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. jobs.description:
Build the Future with Us — EquipmentShare is Hiring a District Operations Manager

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

EquipmentShare is searching for a District Operations Manager to help us oversee rental yards throughout our markets in Little Rock, AR.

Primary Responsibilities

• Lead by example and inspire others to perform to their highest potential, maintaining a professional appearance at all times.

• Responsible for building team - source, interview, hire, train and develop amazing people. Conduct reviews and performance evaluations as necessary to produce positive results. Assist location personnel in training for all system requirements.

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. • See challenges as opportunities

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. jobs.title: Project Manager, Iberia (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
ABOUT NUMA

Hey there! We’re Numa, a forward-thinking hospitality brand redefining how people discover cities. We create spaces where simplicity meets innovation, offering thoughtfully designed rooms, studios, and apartments in the heart of Europe’s most vibrant neighbourhoods.
We’re not just transforming the guest experience—we’re revolutionizing the hospitality industry from the inside out. Our cutting-edge technology streamlines operations, delivering unparalleled value with no hidden fees—just real, quality experiences.
At Numa, we believe that travel should be curious and authentic, and we bring those same values to our work culture. As part of our team, you’ll experience a dynamic and supportive environment where creativity thrives, and your contributions make a real impact. We’re committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where every voice is valued, and different perspectives fuel our innovation.

As a Project Manager at Numa, you will own the delivery of property launches with a main focus on Lisbon and Porto. Projects in Spain, other parts of Portugal and potentially other regions may also come up. You will manage 4 or more launches per year with a Launch Manager. You are responsible for delivering projects on time, on budget, and on brand—ensuring every space meets our design, tech, and operational standards. You will coordinate multidisciplinary teams across all workstreams (base build, FF&E, OS&E, ICT, signage, and launch readiness), acting as the central point of accountability from technical due diligence through to signing to handover and to launch.

Projects are new developments or takeovers, depending on the annual pipeline. Most are landlord-delivered: the landlord designs, tenders and builds, and you oversee delivery against lease requirements, budget and timeline, and flag risks early. You won't produce designs. The landlord's team designs and builds, and you review and steer. You support senior leadership decisions with clear recommendations, watch quality, architecture and the base build, and act as a control point so that Numa's procedures, standards and milestones are followed.

You work in a project team, own your projects end-to-end and are expected to be autonomous within about 6 months. Travel is around 50%, mainly across Iberia, and you may be asked to travel to other cities or countries when needed.

Key Responsibilities

1. Due Diligence & Pre-Contract Phase

• Carry out technical due diligence with the project team, through to a go/no-go recommendation

• Evaluate technical feasibility of new properties (conversions, refurbishments, or developments) and review architectural, MEP, fire safety and ICT plans

• Estimate budgets, timelines, and risk profiles for each project

• Participate in lease and vendor contract reviews to ensure alignment with delivery objectives, focusing on technical and delivery clauses

• Work with legal and revenue in pre-signing to reach a signing decision

2. Project Planning & Execution

• Lead full-cycle project delivery, managing external partners (developers, landlords, general contractors, vendors)

• Act as the main contact for landlords and their consultants and contractors, including escalations

• Drive internal coordination across design, procurement, ops, revenue, legal, and tech teams

• Own project scheduling and scope control using standardised PM tools (Asana, G-Suite, etc.)

• Anticipate and resolve bottlenecks, scope changes, or cross-team conflicts proactively

• Track financials including CAPEX budgets, change orders, and payment approvals

• Ensure alignment with lease obligations and commercial handover terms

• Conduct regular site visits, quality control checks, and ensure Numa standards are fully implemented

• Navigate local permit and municipal processes, mainly in Lisbon and Porto, including heritage approvals, and work with the local contractor market

3. Handover (HO) & Launch Management

• Develop detailed launch plans including go-live strategy, timelines, and operational ramp-up

• Lead the HO process, a key part of the PM role, from technical acceptance through to launch and post-launch hypercare, in partnership with our Launch Manager

• Coordinate final delivery and installation of FF&E, OS&E, signage, and other assets

• Oversee snagging, quality assurance, and operational handover

• Ensure all departments are aligned and ready for opening day (ops, finance, revenue, legal, tech)

4. Post-Launch & Continuous Improvement

• Lead post-mortem reviews and capture lessons learned to improve future launches

• Work closely with procurement and design to reduce time and cost across the project lifecycle

Your Profile

• Architecture or civil engineering background (or equivalent proven experience) and at least 5 years on development or construction projects, with built projects and on-site follow-up you can demonstrate.

• Strong technical background and understanding of architectural and MEP systems

• Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects across multiple sites. Has led technical due diligence

• Ability to read and assess contracts (leases, vendor agreements) in the pre-signing stage, and to work effectively with other teams such as legal, real estate and revenue

• Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day work, and interested in testing and helping implement new tools

• Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills, including external vendors and landlords

• Comfortable managing multiple projects in parallel under time and budget constraints

• Fluency in Portuguese and advanced English is a must. Fluency in Spanish is a big plus but not a must-have.

ABOUT OUR OFFER

• Empower your career: Thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where your ideas help shape our future. Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and build a fulfilling career path.

• Experience our brand: Immerse yourself in the Numa lifestyle with a complimentary stay. Share the love with friends and family through exclusive discounts on our stylish apartments. Connect with a global community of colleagues at our inspiring team-building events.

Numa values the diversity of the people it hires and serves. Diversity at our company means fostering a workplace in which individual differences are recognised, appreciated, respected and responded to in ways that fully develop and utilise each person’s talents and strengths. We therefore welcome applications from people of all races, ethnicities, disability statuses, ages, religions, gender identities, and sexual orientations.

For more information on the processing of your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.

We’re looking for friendly, dependable Delivery Drivers to deliver orders safely and provide excellent customer service.

Responsibilities

• Deliver orders promptly while following traffic laws and safe driving practices.
• Verify orders before leaving the store.
• Provide friendly, professional service at each delivery.
• Process payments and handle cash accurately.
• Assist in the store with taking orders, preparing food, cleaning, and restocking.
• Follow food safety standards and company procedures.

Qualifications

• Valid driver's license held for at least 2 years. Driver roles require a motor vehicle record review that meets our insurance standards; we do this only after a conditional job offer and with your written permission.
• Access to a reliable vehicle with current registration and required auto insurance.
• Ability to meet company driver eligibility requirements.
• Strong customer service skills and dependable attendance.
• Availability for evenings, weekends, and holidays.
• No delivery experience required; training provided.

Benefits and Advancement

• Opportunities to advance to Assistant Manager and General Manager based on performance, training, and available positions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking

For short distances for short durations.

Surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in line with New Jersey and Philadelphia fair-chance laws. Any background check happens only after a conditional job offer, with your written permission, and includes an individualized assessment of your specific record and the duties of the job.

jobs.description:
An exciting opportunity to join Leafio as a Quality Officer and play an important role in shaping the future of our pharmaceutical wholesale operations.

As Leafio continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Quality Officer who is passionate about maintaining high standards of quality, compliance and patient safety.

This is an opportunity to be part of a business at a pivotal stage of its journey, helping to establish and develop our quality processes as we build a compliant, efficient and reliable pharmaceutical supply chain.

Working closely with our Responsible Person and wider operational teams, you will play a key role in maintaining our Quality Management System, supporting regulatory compliance and ensuring that the medicines moving through our supply chain meet the highest standards.

We are looking for someone who brings hands-on experience within a regulated pharmaceutical environment, a strong understanding of Good Distribution Practice (GDP) and the confidence to take ownership of quality activities in a fast-paced, evolving business.

If you enjoy working collaboratively, have a keen eye for detail and want to make a meaningful contribution to a growing organisation, this could be a fantastic next step in your career.



What is the job?



We are looking for an experienced Quality Officer to join Leafio at a pivotal stage of our growth. This is a unique opportunity to join an ambitious team as we establish our pharmaceutical wholesale operation and secure the licences required to import, store and distribute medicinal products across the UK.



As part of the Quality team, you will ensure the daily activities are actioned and monitored and meet the highest standards of Good Distribution Practice (GDP), regulatory compliance and product quality.



You will play a critical role in ensuring that all medicinal products received, stored and supplied by Leafio comply with GDP, MHRA requirements (esp Reg 167), internal Quality Management Systems (QMS) standards, and customer expectations.



What will you be doing?



 - Ensure that Deviations, change controls, risk management and CAPAs are actioned according to their target date of completion

 - Raise Deviations, change controls, risk managements and CAPAs when needed and support in the investigations where relevant

 - Maintain and update the QMS (SOPs, policies, forms, logs)

 - Draft standard operating procedures, distribute for reviewing and finalising the procedures

 - Manage document control, versioning, training records and archiving

 - Support preparation of quality management review

 - Deliver GDP and QMS training to the relevant departments where needed

 - Support with batch traceability, Certificate of Analysis (CoA) documentation and batch release confirmations/verifications

 - Support with customers’ complaints and ensure timelines are adhered to

 - Support the Responsible Person (RP) in maintaining compliance and safeguarding product quality throughout the supply chain.

 - Actively collaborating with cross-functional teams (e.g. pharmacy, warehouse)

 - Participating and supporting in audits (internal/external) and inspections where required

 - Any other tasks deemed necessary by the Responsible Person (RP)



What do you need?



 - Knowledge of Good Manufacturing (GMP) or Good Distribution Practice (GDP) and the regulatory framework governing pharmaceutical wholesale and distribution

 - Proven experience working within a GMDP regulated pharmaceutical environment, (ideally supporting wholesale distribution and importation), with more than 2 years experience

 - Proven experience of dealing with a Quality Management Systems (QMS), including but not limited to Complaints, CAPAs, Deviations risk management, change control, self inspections/internal audits

 - Proven experience in dealing with unlicensed products (especially in accordance with Regulation 167)

 - Excellent attention to detail and analytical skills

 - Strong communication and report-writing ability

 - Highly organised, able to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines



Desirable

 - Experience or exposure to Importation of unlicensed products from outside the EEA

 - Experience in working with an ERP system

 - Previous experience working within the medical cannabis sector

 - Previous experience in releasing products (QC-Quality control)



What we offer:

 - Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three + 8 bank holidays

 - Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

 - Private Healthcare Scheme

 - Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, and more

 - Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

 - Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave


About Us

At Leafio, we’re building a smarter, more resilient pharmaceutical supply chain that gives pharmacies fast and reliable access to the medicines they need, when they need them.



By working directly with manufacturers and creating a more efficient wholesale model, we’re improving stock availability, simplifying distribution and helping to make medicines more affordable for patients. Everything we do is focused on creating a supply chain that is responsive, transparent and equipped to better support healthcare providers across the UK.



We are an ambitious, fast-growing business with exciting plans for the future. This is an opportunity to make a genuine impact, help shape how we grow and join a team that is modernising pharmaceutical distribution from the ground up.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world! And schedules that work with you, not against you? That's right, we live to beat the rush and make it possible to make, bake or take pizzas during the hungry hours of the day and night, part or full time. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, hanging with your friends, or whatever. Sound good? Even if you just need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

We are searching for qualified customer service reps with personality and people skills. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, drop us a line. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

Pay: $15.92 per hour..

.

● Advancement: Opportunities to advance into Assistant Manager and General Manager positions.

ADVANCEMENTMany of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From customer service representative to management, General Manager to Manager Corporate Operations or Franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

JOB REQUIREMENTS

General Job Duties For All Store Team Members Operate all equipment.

Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

Prepare product.

Receive and process telephone orders.

Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

Must be able to make correct monetary change.

Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

Fumes from food odors.

Exposure to cornmeal dust.

Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

Depth perception.

Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4".

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies.

A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

jobs.title: Sr Field Applications Engineer (FAE)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly capable Senior Field Applications Engineer (FAE) to support strategic customers across datacenter, AI, server, and advanced computing markets. This role is based in the San Jose, CA area.

This position combines strong hands on technical execution, customer facing support, and system level power expertise. The ideal candidate brings experience in power electronics and board level debug, with the ability to support customers through design, bring up, validation, and issue resolution. This role is well suited for an experienced engineer who can work independently on complex technical issues while collaborating effectively across internal and customer teams.

Renesas provides comprehensive training on our digital multiphase power solutions, helping new engineers build expertise in our architectures, tools, and validation methodologies.

Responsibilities

Customer Facing Technical Support

• Serve as a key technical interface for customer accounts, supporting power architecture and voltage regulator engagements from design phase through production.
• Provide technical guidance on digital multiphase power controllers, power modules, and server class power delivery solutions.
• Support schematic reviews, layout reviews, board bring up, debug, and validation activities.
• Generate customer facing technical materials including program updates, validation reports, controller configuration files, issue summaries, and supporting waveform data.
• Assist customers during system validation, including VR performance, telemetry, protection behavior, and interaction with CPU, GPU, ASIC, or SoC power domains.

VR Simulation and Validation

• Perform VR solution simulations with application specific PDNs in SIMPLIS to support design reviews and early risk reduction.
• Execute validation of multiphase power solutions for datacenter and AI platforms, including transient response, efficiency, telemetry, fault behavior, and protection features.
• Develop and maintain test plans, validation checklists, and coverage matrices to ensure thorough evaluation across operating conditions.
• Use lab instrumentation and structured test methods to support repeatable, high quality validation.

Debug and Root Cause Analysis

• Diagnose complex electrical and system issues using oscilloscopes, electronic loads, current probes, network analyzers, power supplies, and related lab equipment.
• Drive issue resolution with urgency, including support for high priority customer escalations.
• Partner with design, systems, and applications teams to identify root cause and help define corrective actions.
• Escalate appropriately when deeper cross functional support is needed, while maintaining ownership of customer communication and follow through.

Program Execution and Technical Ownership

• Work closely with Sales, Product Line, Marketing, and engineering teams to support successful customer engagements and design wins.
• Manage multiple customer activities in parallel, including design support, validation efforts, debug tasks, and issue tracking.
• Drive execution against customer milestones and internal priorities with strong attention to detail and responsiveness.
• Help mitigate technical risk on active programs by identifying issues early and driving timely action.
• Support successful design adoption by combining technical depth with practical judgment on where to focus effort for highest customer and business impact.

Required

• BS or MS in Electrical Engineering or related field.
• 5+ years of experience in power electronics, voltage regulator validation, power applications, or system level power architecture.
• Strong hands on experience with bench level electrical testing and debug methodologies.
• Working knowledge of oscilloscopes, function generators, electronic loads, power supplies, current probes, and soldering tools.
• Experience supporting customer technical issues through structured debug and problem solving.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both engineers and customer stakeholders.
• Ability to manage multiple concurrent technical activities with a strong sense of urgency and ownership.

Preferred

• Experience supporting AI, ML, CPU, GPU, or server power delivery applications.
• Hands on experience with: Multiphase buck converters and digital VR controllers, high current server or AI power designs< SIMPLIS simulation environment
• · Familiarity with validation planning, test automation, and lab instrumentation workflows.
• · Experience working directly with strategic customers in a field applications, systems, or product applications role.
• · Ability to balance technical problem solving with commercial awareness in support of design win execution.

What Success Looks Like in This Role

· Builds credibility quickly with customers through strong technical execution and consultative engagement.

· Supports successful design progress and helps reduce technical risk on active programs.

· Handles multiple customer priorities effectively, including urgent escalations.

· Contributes positively to team execution, customer satisfaction, and business results.

Why This Role Matters

Power delivery is a defining constraint and differentiator for AI and hyperscaler platforms. This role operates at the intersection of customer execution, power architecture leadership, and long-term strategy. The Senior Manager, Field Applications Engineering – Strategic Accounts (Power) will directly shape how Renesas is perceived by its most strategic customers and materially impact our ability to win and scale next-generation datacenter platforms.

The expected annual pay range for this position is $135,000-168K. This position is also eligible for bonus opportunities. Please note that final offer amount will be dependent on geographic location, applicable experience, and skillset of the candidate.

Renesas offers a full range of elective benefits including medical, health savings account (with applicable medical plan), dental, vision, health and/or dependent care flexible spending accounts, pre-tax commuter benefits, life insurance, AD&D, and pet insurance. In addition to elective benefit options, benefited employees receive company-paid life insurance and AD&D, LTD, short term medical benefits as well as paid sick time, paid holidays, and accrued paid vacation. New employees will attend a detailed benefit orientation to learn more about our many benefits and resources.

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

jobs.description:
The College Seminar Teacher is responsible for the implementation of Uncommon’s college seminar curriculum.  The College Seminar Teacher will teach freshmen and sophomores with the goal of students building a stronger sense of purpose, a college-going mindset, and a tool kit of strong high school habits to ensure their academic and personal success. The College Seminar Teacher will also support the college office and assist with other college and school-wide initiatives as needed.

The College Seminar Teacher role is a great opportunity for an experienced academic teacher who may be interested in transitioning to a College Counselor position. If successful in this role, the College Seminar Teacher may be considered for a College Counseling position in the subsequent school year if there is an opening.

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES

• Implement College Seminar 9 and 10 curricula and activities to meet our high academic standards
• Build a college-going culture and mindset in our 9th and 10th grade students through effective implementation of curriculum, motivation, and inspiration
• Focus constantly on student learning, thinking critically and strategically to respond to student learning needs
• Create a positive, structured learning environment to ensure that students observe the school’s core values, high expectations, and code of conduct
• Communicate effectively with students, families, and colleagues
• Commit to continual professional growth, participating actively in our annual, three-week staff orientation training in August and instructional training throughout the school year
• Support with operations and administrative tasks in the college office, as directed by the Director of College Counseling, College Team and school leaders

Strong applicants will possess the following:

• Relentless drive to improve the minds, characters & lives of students both in and out of school

You do not need to be certified to be hired; however, if hired you will need to pass state teacher certification tests to meet the MA state requirements.Candidates must embody a passion for empowering students and helping them discover their purpose; knowledge of college prep is a plus but not a requirement.

Our people are what make us Uncommon.  We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits that support the personal health, wellness, and finances of our staff and their families. Our compensation philosophy values equity & fairness and attracting & retaining top talent.

jobs.description:
WHY SOCURE?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.



Introduction

Socure is evolving its partner ecosystem toward a sales-driven channel model. As a Strategic Alliance Director, you will own the performance and growth of a portfolio of active strategic partners. You will work as a quota-carrying leader, turning those relationships into predictable, scalable revenue through joint planning, co-selling, and disciplined pipeline management.

Key Responsibilities

 - Own a Revenue Quota: Deliver annual and quarterly revenue targets through partner-sourced and partner-influenced deals.

 - Partner Portfolio Management: Own a defined book of active partners. Drive performance, forecast accuracy, and year-over-year revenue growth across the portfolio.

 - Strategic Partner Relationships: Build and maintain executive-level relationships with partner leadership and sales teams. Run regular business reviews to align on goals, performance, and priorities.

 - Joint Business and Account Planning: Develop and execute joint business plans, account plans, and co-sell motions with each partner, in coordination with internal sales and account teams.

 - Partner-Driven Pipeline and Deal Support: Work with partners to generate pipeline, advance opportunities, and close deals. Support deal registration and resolve conflicts across channels.

 - Pipeline and Forecast Discipline: Maintain accurate CRM hygiene. Report weekly on partner pipeline, forecast, and attainment.

 - Partner Enablement: Deliver enablement sessions, ensure partner sales and technical readiness, and equip partners to position Socure effectively.

 - Co-Marketing: Partner with Marketing to launch demand generation initiatives with measurable pipeline results.

 - Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with Leadership, Marketing, Product, and Operations to remove obstacles and accelerate partner-driven opportunities.

 - Strategic Feedback: Serve as the voice of the partner to influence product strategy, GTM design, and enablement materials.

 - Selective Partner Expansion: Identify and activate new partners where there are clear gaps in target markets or verticals, in collaboration with Partnerships leadership.

Required Skills & Qualifications

 - 7+ years in channel sales, alliances, or partner account management, ideally in fintech, SaaS, or identity/fraud solutions.

 - Demonstrated success carrying and exceeding revenue quotas through partner ecosystems.

 - Proven ability to manage, grow, and retain high-performing strategic partner relationships.

 - Deep understanding of co-selling motions, deal registration, and partner pipeline management.

 - Strong business acumen and negotiation skills across executive and sales levels.

 - Proficiency in Salesforce and partner management tools (PRM, attribution, co-sell tracking).

 - Exceptional communication, collaboration, and presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

 - MBA or equivalent advanced degree.

 - Experience with API-driven SaaS products, identity verification, or fraud prevention.

 - Established network across fintech, banking, or digital commerce ecosystems.

 - History of quota overachievement in a partner or channel-driven sales role.

 - Familiarity with identity verification, fraud prevention, or compliance-related solutions.

 - Experience recruiting and onboarding new partners.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 – 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.

Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

REQUIRES

Valid driver's license held for at least 2 years. Driver roles require a motor vehicle record review that meets our insurance standards; we do this only after a conditional job offer and with your written permission.

Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Carrying

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Walking

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Climbing

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure To

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

Far vision and night vision for driving.
