jobs.title: Partner Engagement Manager, Air Combat Command
jobs.description:
CONSEQUENTIAL WORK. DEDICATED PEOPLE.



ABOUT ONEBRIEF


Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Required: Top Secret clearance with eligibility for SCI

In person in Joint Base Langley-Eustis, Virginia.

25% Travel




WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

As a Partner Engagement Manager at Onebrief, you're the customer's trusted technical partner. You serve as the subject-matter expert, maintaining power-user-level fluency in the platform. You stay current on product updates, translating new releases into practical impact for the specific workflows your customer relies on. You act as the primary line of communication between the customer and Onebrief — as the product evolves, you deliver ongoing, role-specific training to ensure users adopt new capabilities rather than getting stuck on outdated workflows. You bridge the technical gap between engineering and the customer, explaining product behavior in terms their staff can actually act on.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Core responsibilities:

 - Clearly communicate user needs to the product team. Maintain a high product proficiency, and excite the customer about each product improvement.

 - Understand, request, and effectively leverage Company resources to meet the goals of the Company.

 - Lead or support exercises.

 - Use your observations of our users to recommend product improvements.

 - Identify gaps between existing directorate workflows and effective Onebrief usage, then drive adoption through hands-on configuration, user coaching, and workflow optimization**.**

 - When responding to incidents (product is unavailable, broken, or not delighting the customer), coordinate with the customer and our product engineering team.

 - Align your team’s efforts to deliver the best customer experience, while coordinating with fellow Partner Engagement Managers to ensure planning and workflows remain synchronized across commands.

 - Enable expansion and upsell opportunities to Allies and Partners by instilling the Onebrief value proposition.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Proven experience in leading operational planning within a military context, preferably at multi-star headquarters.

 - Exposure to large staff planning, through classical training in Professional Military Education or through service experience

 - Familiarity and experience with major military planning exercises and the protocols for software deployment on classified networks.

 - Proven ability to expand business presence within a customer location with emphasis on software or technology solutions.

 - Experience in customer support, both face-to-face and remote, and capability to respond to incidents coordinating with customers and product engineering teams.

 - Strong technical skills to master our application, troubleshoot issues and liaise with customers on technical matters.

 - Proven ability to navigate large government organizations, solve bureaucratic challenges, and deliver successful outcomes.

 - You hold a current Top Secret clearance with eligibility for SCI and have the ability to access DOD facilities and installations.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - You’re technically adept. You don’t need to code, but you do need to be savvy. Can you become a power user of our product and talk engineering with the customer?

 - Customers trust you. You demonstrate strong interpersonal skills, develop rapport, align diverse perspectives, and communicate with clarity and influence.

 - You’re intense about our mission. It’s a core part of who you are

 - You’re proactive and adaptable. You see a problem and get to work. You’re comfortable working autonomously or in a cross-functional team, especially in a fast-paced or ambiguous setting

 - You communicate clearly, concisely, and candidly. Our Company relies on you to assess the situation within your account and effectively communicate your assessment and recommendations to inform strategic decisions.




INDICATORS OF SUCCESS

This role will evolve as priorities change, but the outcomes below reflect what success typically looks like in the first six months.

A successful Partner Engagement Manager will:

 - Opinion and expertise are valued by the customer and company alike (rapport/trust)

 - Learns quick, identifies opportunities and drives progress within the account (forward-leaning/ bias for action)

 - Open-minded and able to pivot when priorities shift (adaptability/ humility)





Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 – 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.

Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

REQUIRES

Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Carrying

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Walking

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Climbing

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure To

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

Far vision and night vision for driving.

jobs.title: Retail Strategist
jobs.description:
ABOUT EDITED

EDITED is the world’s leading AI-driven retail intelligence platform. We empower the world’s most successful brands and retailers with real-time decision making power. 

By connecting internal business and external market data, EDITED infuses intelligence into every retail decision. We help retailers increase margins, generate more sales, and drive better business outcomes through AI-powered market and enterprise intelligence that fuels automation. 

At EDITED, we foster a dynamic and inclusive culture where creativity thrives and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Our environment is dynamic and supportive, encouraging team members to take initiative, innovate, and continuously grow. We value diversity, transparency, and a shared commitment to excellence, creating a workplace where everyone's voice is heard and contributions are recognised. 

We believe that achieving a positive work-life balance is key to driving innovation and success. Our flexible working options—including hybrid working, flexible hours and a work from anywhere policy—empower our team to perform at their best. 



The Role



As a Retail Strategist, you will deliver world class customer success, challenging our customers to be brave enough to change their ways of working so they can realise better margins and higher profits!

Your mission is to deliver projects that enable customers to achieve their business objectives on the EDITED platform to drive measurable impact while serving as a technical and industry expert. If you’re not an expert on EDITED already, don’t worry, because we’ll make you one!

You will be a product advocate and support our users to become as fluid in using the EDITED app as you are. Not only will you be a product expert, you will also be a strong customer advocate - feeding back their views about the product to the relevant teams and helping to shape development of our software. We expect you to be passionate about our customers and be as excited about helping them to get the most value out of our product as we are.



Responsibilities

 - Own a multi-million dollar portfolio of retail clients, with responsibility for ensuring clients are successfully adopting the EDITED product suite and realizing measurable ROI.

 - Create and deliver strategic workshops and trainings that enable clients to achieve their business objectives via the EDITED product suite and drive measure ROI for the client.

 - Act as a thought partner to retail clients; leverage understanding of existing processes within the retail ecosystem to strategically recommend integration of EDITED data.

 - Partner and collaborate with Account Manager to develop and implement strategies to increase adoption, drive ROI, identify upsell opportunities to retain and grow portfolio ARR.

 - Ability to effectively communicate across all levels of retail ecosystem - from individual contributors to the CEO.

 - Strong written communication skills, ability to clearly articulate and document processes both internally and externally.

 - Ability to advocate and influence - both externally with clients and internally,on behalf of our clients, with cross functional partners.

 - Articulate EDITED's positioning, use cases, and value.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Corporate Marketing
jobs.description:
ABOUT JUNIPER SQUARE

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/ operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.




ABOUT YOUR ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Director to lead content at Juniper Square, with editorial content at the core of the role. You will own the editorial voice and the content and search programs that shape how the private markets industry sees us, in partnership with Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, Sales and the executive team.

Reporting to the Head of Marketing, you will lead our content and organic search function and the leaders and specialists within it.

This is a backfill of an existing leadership seat, with a scope shaped around content. The role exists to make content a durable source of awareness, executive visibility and pipeline as the company grows, including in private equity and private markets AI.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the editorial strategy and voice across flagship content, research, customer stories and long-form pieces, so that what we publish is distinctive, credible and recognized in private markets.

 - Own organic search performance, so that our content earns durable discovery and the search program is measured against clear targets.

 - Run integrated content-led campaigns with Growth Marketing, Product Marketing and Sales, so that content is activated across channels and connected to pipeline.

 - Translate company strategy and corporate objectives into a content plan with clear priorities, success metrics and resourcing, and manage your team and agencies to results across quarterly and annual horizons.

 - Build, structure and develop a team of managers and senior specialists in content and search: hire to plan, plan for succession and coach emerging leaders into larger roles.

 - Align executives and cross-functional leaders on content priorities, and represent the department in strategic forums across Marketing, Sales, Product and the executive team.

 - Lead department-level transformation with AI: set team practices for AI in content and search workflows, measure the results, and share what works and what does not across the company.




QUALIFICATIONS

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer (Backend Leaning) - Studio
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
Studio is where creators build and finish video on ElevenLabs, powered by our generative graph engine, Flows. You’ll own our “produce once, distribute everywhere” workflow. It takes a finished Studio project and runs it through our dubbing pipeline to produce it in many languages and aspect ratios, with auto-translated captions. Today that means duplicating and rebuilding projects by hand.
This work is entirely greenfield: the specs aren’t written yet. You’ll shape them through written proposals (RFCs), pressure-test data structures with the team lead, and carry the project from first draft to launch.
You’re a strong backend generalist who is good with complex data structures and has the product instincts to decide what’s worth building.


Requirements

 - Strong backend generalist who has designed and shipped complex, data-heavy systems end to end.

 - Comfortable with enterprise-grade concerns such as usage reporting and accounts.

 - Evidence of product ownership: side projects, open source, or work in a product-facing context.

 - Has taken projects from inception to launch with little hand-holding.

Bonus: experience with media or video-processing pipelines (helpful, not required)

jobs.title: General Manager(03965) - 104-B Hickory Corner Road
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

Pay: $1,000–$1,100 per week (salary), plus a period profit bonus that includes cost control and service incentives, plus separate bonuses for high inspection scores from NSF and Domino's.

Benefits: Full-time management team members are eligible for co-pay health insurance. General Managers get 1 week of paid vacation per year.

You were born to be the boss. We know. You get up in the morning and you make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do. Then you go to work and you make sure that everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss. You just do that because you've always done it. Well maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the boss? Well now's your chance – Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses – more specifically general managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills – judgment, math and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, boss, show us what you've got. Apply now!

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DUTIES

You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and Customer relations. You must set the example. You must follow ALL policy and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew.

In addition: Staffing, Paperwork, Cost Controls, Cash control, Food management, Work to a Schedule, Perfect Image and adherence to standards, Great Customer Service, Attendance& punctuality, Transportation to/from work, Store cleanliness, Marketing, Profitability.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From delivery driver to management, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

QUALIFICATIONS

General job duties for all store team members

Operate all equipment.

Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

Prepare product.

Receive and process telephone orders.

Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

Must be able to make correct monetary change.

Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.

Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

Fumes from food odors.

Exposure to cornmeal dust.

Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

Talking and hearing on telephone.

Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

Depth perception.

Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking

For short distances for short durations.

Surfaces include ceramic tile"bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24"- 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Additional Job Details

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 – 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.

Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

DRIVING SPECIFIC JOB DUTIES

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

REQUIRES

Valid driver's license held for at least 2 years. Driver roles require a motor vehicle record review that meets our insurance standards; we do this only after a conditional job offer and with your written permission.

Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Carrying

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Walking

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Climbing

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure To

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

Far vision and night vision for driving.

 - Provide oversight of personnel and subcontractors, resolve complex operational issues, support planning and budgeting, and ensure accurate and complete documentation.

 - Support activity approvals, readiness reviews, incident investigations, corrective actions, compliance assessments, training and qualification programs, and continuous process improvements.

Requirements

 - Education & Years of Experience – Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or a technical discipline and 8+ years of relevant experience OR an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

 - Citizenship – To be considered, you must be a United States (U.S.) citizen due to the federal nature of the work.

 - Clearance – To be considered, you must be able to obtain and maintain a government issued clearance, if needed.

 - Experience coordinating technical activities, operational projects, or construction activities in a complex work environment.

 - Experience with work planning, work readiness, field execution, documentation, and compliance requirements.

 - Ability to provide field oversight, coordinate personnel and resources, and resolve complex operational issues.

 - Ability to support safety, quality assurance, corrective actions, and regulatory compliance in a nuclear or industrial environment.

Desired Skills

 - 15+ years of construction field experience and 5+ years supporting Department of Energy (DOE) missions.

 - Previous DOE construction or deactivation and decommissioning (D&D) project experience.

 - Experience in work control, quality control, quality assurance, and managing complex issues under NQA-1 requirements.

 - Previous qualifications as an Electrical Field Work Supervisor, Field Work Supervisor, or Responsible (Line) Manager, and experience working within a DOE plutonium facility.

About the Site

The NNSA's Los Alamos National Laboratory (LANL), located in Los Alamos, New Mexico, is a design laboratory responsible for the safety and reliability of the nuclear explosives package in nuclear weapons. This lab possesses unique capabilities in neutron scattering, enhanced surveillance, radiography, and plutonium science and engineering (energy.gov http://energy.gov).




ABOUT GEM

GEM Technologies, Inc. (GEM) is an award-winning federal contractor with more than 30 years of experience providing environmental, construction, facility management, and technical services to federal agencies, state and local governments, and commercial organizations. Founded in 1994 as a nuclear engineering firm to support federal operations in East Tennessee, GEM has since expanded into a nationwide, multi-disciplinary provider with over 270 employees and a diverse portfolio of contracts in the environmental, nuclear, and defense sectors. Some reasons to join GEM are:

 - Our team – We are committed to managing a cohesive workforce and cultivating a supportive workplace for our employees on contracts and in-office.

 - Our community involvement – Supporting our communities, we invest time and money in local schools and non-profit organizations.




COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

jobs.title: Associate, Strategy & Corporate Development
jobs.description:
Overview

Tonal is looking for a passionate, fitness-minded Associate to join our Strategy & Corporate Development team. This role sits at the intersection of long-term strategic planning, partnerships, and high-priority business analysis. You'll work directly with senior leadership and on initiatives that shape the direction of the company, from market expansion and competitive positioning to partnership evaluation and new business opportunities.

The ideal candidate is a strong, independent, strategic thinker, highly analytical, a great team player, and comfortable operating with a great work ethic. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and wants to go deep on the business.



What You Will Do

Strategic Planning & Market Analysis

 - Assist in data- and research-driven strategic initiatives to develop Tonal's short- and long-term strategy.

 - Synthesize and analyze quantitative and qualitative research and data sets into insights, hypotheses, implications, and recommendations.

 - Conduct market and competitive research across consumer hardware, fitness, wellness, and adjacent tech, to inform executive-level strategy discussions.

Financial Modeling & Deal Evaluation

 - Build financial models and business cases to evaluate strategic options, new market opportunities, and investment decisions.

 - Synthesize and analyze quantitative & qualitative research and data sets into insights and/or hypotheses that support initiatives, implications and/or recommendations

 - Create key analyses and negotiation support, working closely with internal and external partners to structure and execute transactions.

Partnerships & Corporate Development

 - Support strategic partnership processes end-to-end: sourcing, evaluation, financial modeling, and internal recommendation materials.

 - Partner on a range of projects spanning product development, product pricing, evaluation of new revenue opportunities, and identification of acquisition/investment targets.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Executive Communication

 - Work cross-functionally with Finance, Product, Revenue, Operations and other teams to develop and pressure-test strategic frameworks.

 - Projects could range from partnering on product development, product pricing, evaluation of new revenue opportunities, and identifying acquisition/investment targets

 - Assist in framing and communicating key conclusions, including board materials, executive presentations, and strategic memos.



Who You Are

 - 3+ years of experience in a highly analytical and strategic role (investment banking, private equity, growth equity, management consulting, corporate strategy, or corporate development).

 - Proficient in financial modeling, valuation and financial analysis

 - Demonstrated experience solving complex, ambiguous, and analytically challenging problems.

 - Excellent verbal and written communicator, able to distill complex analysis into clear, executive-ready narratives.

 - Self-starter who excels in a fast-paced, resource-constrained, and fluid environment. You figure things out rather than wait for direction.

 - Willingness to step up to greater responsibility and take ownership of projects, strong desire to contribute to overall goals

 - Passionate about fitness and wellness. Genuine curiosity about Tonal's business and the broader consumer, fitness, and tech landscape.

 - Strong stakeholder management skills and comfort working directly with senior leadership.

 - Bachelor's degree required; top academic record preferred.



Skills Preferred

 - Proficient in financial modeling, valuation, and financial analysis (three-statement models, DCF, scenario analysis, unit economics).

 - Experience manipulating and deriving insights from data sets using tools such as Excel, Looker, or DataBricks.

 - Ability to frame and communicate complex concepts and analysis using Microsoft Excel and Google Suite

 - Strong research skills and ability to drive independent analysis into growth opportunities and industries.

 - Experience working in or covering consumer hardware, health & wellness, or subscription businesses.

 - Exposure to strategic partnership or business development processes.

At Tonal, we believe that the unique and varied lived experiences of our teammates contribute to our overall strength. We don’t just appreciate differences, we celebrate them, and we always seek people that represent a wide variety of backgrounds. We’re dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and designing employee experiences that contribute to your growth as much as you do to ours. If your experience aligns with what we’re looking for (even if you don’t check every single box), send us your application. We would love to hear from you!

 

Tonal is committed to meeting the diverse needs of people with disabilities in a timely manner that is consistent with the principles of independence, dignity, integration, and equality of opportunity. Should you have any accommodation requests, please reach out to us via our confidential email, accessibility@tonal.com. All requests will be addressed and responded to in accordance with Tonal’s Accessibility Policy and local legislation.

jobs.title: Part-Time Employment Specialist
jobs.description:
Part-Time Employment Specialist

Harrisburg, PA

Up to 20 hours per week

This is an in-person role with the expectation that staff report to a CEO site, as the majority of participant interactions are conducted in person.

Anticipated deadline to submit application: November 13 at 5:00pm EST. Position may close early if application limit is met. Apply promptly for full consideration.

The Opportunity

The Employment Specialist increases the range of employment opportunities available to our participants using participant interests, experiences, and their ambitions as a foundation for participant job placements, and more broadly, for the identification and cultivation of potential employers for prospect portfolios.

As part of our mission, we strongly encourage individuals who have lived experience of incarceration or involvement in the justice system to apply for this role.

Role Tracks

The Employment Specialist role operates on one of two tracks, based on site and regional staffing needs:

• Account Specialist track: focuses on employer cultivation, engagement, and placement support, partnering with dedicated vocational staff members on the participant relationship.

• Full Cycle track: combines employer cultivation, engagement, and placement with direct participant case management, owning the full relationship from job readiness through placement.

Who We Are

The Center for Employment Opportunities (CEO) provides employment services to people recently released from incarceration. Across the United States, 8,000-9,000 people participate in CEO each year, transitioning to employment that supports themselves, their families, and their communities.

What began as a demonstration project of the Vera Institute of Justice in the 1970s to address employment barriers facing the formerly incarcerated following release in New York City has grown into the leading reentry employment organization in the country, where over 30,000 formerly incarcerated individuals have secured full-time employment since 1996.

Who You Are

• You have demonstrated commitment to CEO’s mission and interest in working in a fast-growing and results-oriented nonprofit environment

• You are passionate about helping individuals become the best version of themselves; interested in guiding individuals to achieving their career goals through a balance of accountability and empathy

• You have a deep interest in re-entry or criminal justice reform

• You are comfortable with providing the feedback and support necessary to facilitate the development of participant knowledge and skills

• You have the ability to anticipate problems, evaluate them, and determine and implement solutions

• You have the ability to take into account and analyze various points of view and data to form a perspective appropriate to a particular context

• You have excellent interpersonal and written communication skills with the ability to adjust to particular personalities and interaction styles on the spot

• You are self-motivated, diligent, resilient, and demonstrate stamina and vigor as you hold yourself accountable to deadlines and outcomes, even in the face of adversity or setbacks

• You are comfortable working under pressure and meeting deadlines despite opposition or setbacks

• You are highly organized with top notch time management skills and the ability to juggle multiple priorities seamlessly or ask for support with prioritization when needed

• You are comfortable learning new technologies that an organization adopts/implements

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• Employment Specialist: You have 2+ years of experience in workforce development, recruitment, or sales/account management, a role in which you needed to meet performance goals on a regular basis You are skilled in networking and cultivating lasting relationships with people and businesses, helping them understand how our work can help them achieve their business strategy and goals You have experience in looking at a set of data or market research and use it to guide your practice and decision-making

Responsibilities

Key responsibilities of the Employment Specialist include but are not limited to:

Business Analysis, Relationship Cultivation and Maintenance

• Envision, develop, and implement a strategic plan for placement services for a local office that ensures CEO meets its participant placement metrics

• Conduct reviews of existing CEO business partnerships regularly, evaluate employer demand and usage of CEO services, and determine improvements and ways to leverage relationships with employers

• Achieve weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual placement goals in accordance with CEO’s contractual obligations

• Research, conduct outreach to, and build relationships with prospective employers willing to hire CEO participants and who have hiring needs that match the skills, experience, and interests of our overall participant cohort

• Maintain relationships with existing employer partners

• Schedule and conduct daily prospecting, cold calls, and face-to-face meetings

• Serve as the liaison among employers, participants, and our criminal justice partners

Both Tracks: Job Placement Services

• You are expected to produce up to 5 monthly placements

• Screen and match program participants with employment opportunities, taking into consideration each participant’s skills, work experience, interests, and goals and aspirations

• Customize participants’ resumes to fit identified opportunities

• Manage a caseload of participants, support and coach them around applying for jobs, navigating the hiring process, and finding and securing right fit employment

Account Specialist track:

• Provide placement support to participants in partnership with assigned vocational staff members coordinating on job readiness and application activity

• Communicate employer requirements and opportunity details to vocational staff to support accurate participant matching

Full Cycle track:

• Manage a caseload of participants, support and coach them around applying for jobs, navigating the hiring process, and finding and securing right fit employment

• Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned participants throughout the placement process

Administrative Support

• Document all participant and employer contact, activities, and outcomes in our case management system (Salesforce)

• Supports the Site Director with administrative and operational duties to ensure the smooth and seamless operation of the site

• Perform other job-related duties and responsibilities assigned from time to time

Lead activities within or across offices related to your role’s specific outcomes and/or office needs (such as case conferencing responsibilities)

Compensation and Benefits

The salary for this position is $47,800 In an effort to be both equitable and transparent, CEO's compensation philosophy considers a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, internal equity, and home office location in making a final determination on our salary offer.

We recognize that salary is a part of the overall compensation package and also provide a comprehensive benefits package, including medical and dental coverage, as well as professional development opportunities and training, including regular training opportunities in Motivational Interviewing (MI). MI is one evidence-based skill that reentry and human service professionals can utilize when supporting participants to achieve their goals.

We also offer paid parental leave, participation in a retirement plan, sick and vacation leave, paid holidays and more. We are a workplace that promotes continual learning and teamwork, offering lunch and learns, team outings, holiday gatherings and more for our staff.

More About Us

Center for Employment Opportunities believes that everyone deserves the chance to shape a stronger future for themselves, their families, and their communities. People who are justice involved are highly encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels. CEO is committed to the CROWN Act, and creating an open space where our employees can present as their true authentic selves.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without unlawful discrimination based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, gender, gender identity, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, military status, prior record of arrest or conviction, citizenship status, current employment status, caregiver status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law. We value diverse experiences, including with regard to educational background and justice system contact.

Please note that due to the volume of resumes received, we are unable to contact each applicant regarding the status of each position or reply to candidates' inquiries via phone or email.

jobs.title: Staff Behavioral Scientist
jobs.description:
PURPOSE:

The Predictive Index, a leader in workplace behavioral science, is an award-winning best place to work (Inc., Glassdoor, Boston Business Journal, The Boston Globe).

Our mission is "Better work, Better world," and we take great pride in PI's power to supercharge workplace relationships and culture to achieve the unthinkable. We're our own best case study!

That includes how we work in an AI world. We're rethinking roles, teams, and careers around people and AI working together, and we're applying what we learn inside PI to the products we build for our clients. You'll be working toward a mission that inspires you, and you'll be surrounded by fun, smart, driven people day in and day out.

There's a reason more than 10,000 companies, including The LA Clippers, Hugo Boss, Nissan, Pendo, AstraZeneca, and Bosch, trust PI to help them hire top talent, design winning teams, and develop leaders at every level. Come discover how we empower our clients to solve their biggest challenges and make their business dreams come true.

The Predictive Index is a place where people with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives collaborate on amazing, important work. We celebrate our differences, knowing that they are fundamental to our success as an organization. "Better Work, Better World," starts here, in an organization where every member of the PI community is valued, respected, and welcome. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds to apply.

We’re assembling a small, elite team to build something new — a venture that operates with the independence of a startup and the credibility of a 70-year-old science brand. This is a ground-floor opportunity to define what responsible, rigorous behavioral science looks like in a brand-new product.

The Opportunity

Science isn’t a feature on this team. It’s the foundation.

We’re looking for a Staff Behavioral Scientist to own the scientific integrity of a new PI venture from day one. You’ll be working on a lean, fast-moving team chartered to explore, validate, and build a new market — and you’ll be the person who makes sure every claim we make, every instrument we ship, and every insight we surface can withstand the scrutiny of the most skeptical HR buyer, legal team, or academic reviewer.

This role is for someone who sees I/O psychology not as a credential, but as a craft.

What you’ll do

Provide the scientific foundation and defensibility of the venture’s claims.

• Apply industrial-organizational psychology — assessment science, team dynamics, leadership, engagement, and job fit — to product, positioning, and research decisions.

• Design and validate any new psychometric instruments, scales, or scoring models the product requires, holding them to the same scientific bar as PI’s existing assessments.

• Run applied research with pilot customers — criterion and construct validation, efficacy studies, norm development — to prove the product produces the workplace outcomes it promises.

• Translate peer-reviewed I/O and organizational behavior research into product features, UX, and go-to-market messaging that HR leaders and business leaders will trust.

• Own the scientific defensibility of the venture’s claims — technical manuals, validity evidence, white papers — so the new product inherits the credibility bar PI is known for.

What you bring

If you’ve got all of the below, drop what you’re doing and apply. If you’ve got most of it, we still want to hear from you.

• A PhD (or equivalent applied experience) in Industrial-Organizational Psychology, Organizational Behavior, Psychometrics, or a closely related field.

• Deep hands-on experience in psychometric development: scale construction, IRT or CTT, validation design, and norm development.

• Demonstrated ability to conduct applied validation research in real organizational settings — not only academic labs.

• Fluency translating rigorous science into language that product teams can build from and buyers can trust.

• Comfort working at the frontier, where the research agenda, the product roadmap, and the go-to-market strategy are all still being written.

• Passion for using AI in every aspect of your work — we're an AI-forward team that expects every member to take full advantage of modern tools to sharpen thinking, move faster, and extend the team’s capacity.

• A builder’s mindset. This team moves fast, operates lean, and expects every person to cover surface area beyond their title.

What it’s like here

This is not a support role embedded in a large organization. You’ll be one of thirteen people on a team operating like a venture-backed startup — with its own stack, its own cadence, and its own mandate to find and validate a new market. You’ll report directly to the venture lead and work alongside product, engineering, and go-to-market functions all operating at the same pace.

At The Predictive Index, we value flexibility. All PI employees have the choice to work either at our Westwood, MA headquarters, Remote, or a mix of both! Every PI employee gets access to AI tools and ongoing training to use them well.

Just as our employees are threads in the cultural fabric of PI, THREADS is our framework for understanding our core values.

Teamwork: Focus on the “we,” not the “me.”

Honesty: Follow your moral compass.

Reliability: Be someone others can count on.

Energy: Be balanced, be energized.

Action: Errors of action are better than errors of inaction. Be brave.

Drive: Own it.

Scope: Don't try to boil the ocean.

The Predictive Index participates in E-Verify. E-Verify is an Internet-based system that compares information from an employee's Form I-9, Employment Eligibility Verification, to data from U.S. Department of Homeland Security and Social Security Administration records to confirm employment eligibility.

The Predictive Index is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This position may be performed in our Massachusetts headquarters or remotely within the United States.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer - Productions
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Productions is the “done for you” managed services wing of ElevenLabs, built for creators and media businesses. We bring together our AI audio tools and human experts in linguistics, mixing and post-production to deliver human-edited dubs, audiobooks and more in 15+ languages, directly on the ElevenLabs platform. Our customers include global media broadcasters, publishers, gaming companies and major film studios.

We’re hiring engineers to build the systems behind it: the platforms that let human expertise and AI work together at the quality our clients expect, and the labelling tools our research teams use to improve our models. You’ll own a scope in one of these areas:

 - Human data platform: the labelling and evaluation platform research uses to continuously improve our models. You’ll ship new task editors, improve reliability, catch misuse and build the metrics behind higher-quality data pipelines.

 - Core productions engine: the backend machine nobody sees but everybody relies on. You’ll build and maintain the services that run our production workflows, with room to lead projects.

 - Editor platform: the professional editing tools our production teams work in. You’ll build in Rust, combining UI systems with a deep understanding of the underlying system.

We’re building professional tools and core infrastructure, not consumer features. The work is mostly building, with little hand-holding. You’ll carve out your own scope and own the outcome.

Requirements

 - Strong backend engineering experience, ideally in functional programming languages like Rust, with a full-stack focus on designing UI systems. You’ve shipped and run production systems end to end.

 - Experience making systems reliable and scalable, such as internal platforms, workflow or task engines, or data pipelines. You take pride in the infrastructure nobody sees but everybody relies on.

 - Comfortable switching between building a new tool or editor and hardening the platform underneath it, and keen to lead projects when the opportunity arises.

 - Opinionated and able to defend your ideas, but know when to just grind. You’re happy doing the unglamorous work, and you’re hungry.

Bonus:

 - Experience building editor or UI-heavy professional tools, with a systems-level understanding of what sits underneath.

 - Experience with data labelling or annotation platforms, or managing crowdsourced workforces.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta is the connected platform and AI-native ecosystem for private capital. Built to replace fragmented tools with a single system of record, Carta brings together the software, services, and legal infrastructure that founders use to manage equity, fund managers use to run administration and reporting, and legal teams use to close transactions. Trusted by 55,000 companies and 1.8M+ equity holders in 160+ countries, and 10,000 funds and SPVs representing $250B+ in assets under management, Carta is transforming how private capital operates. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

Scaled Customer Success Manager

Carta Law · Customer Success

About Carta Law

Carta Law is the world's largest AI-native legal services platform — rebuilding how legal work is structured, delivered and scaled. Combining deep legal expertise with proprietary AI infrastructure, we serve the world's leading venture-backed companies, founders and investors across every critical moment in a company's lifecycle: incorporation, fundraising, secondaries, governance and exit.

We sit inside Carta — the operating system for private markets. Our captive client base spans more than 70,000 companies across every stage of growth, giving Carta Law a deal-flow advantage no traditional firm can replicate.

We are not a traditional law firm. We are a technology company building the future of legal services — operating at the intersection of venture financing, software and AI, and scaling rapidly across the Americas, London and APAC. A dedicated team of R&D and product engineers, based across San Francisco, New York and London, works alongside our lawyers to build that future.

The Problems You'll Solve

As a Scaled Customer Success Manager, you'll own a portfolio of 40+ accounts post-onboarding — using smart prioritisation, great tooling, and a medium-touch model to drive retention and expansion across a broad book of business.

Specifically, you'll:

• Own a portfolio of accounts as their primary contact post-onboarding — building strong relationships and ensuring clients are consistently getting value from Carta Law.

• Triage and prioritise your portfolio by risk, strategic value, and expansion opportunity — deploying your time where it has the greatest commercial impact.

• Conduct quarterly check-ins and bi-annual Executive Business Reviews — keeping clients engaged, informed, and aligned to their goals.

• Leverage CS tooling and AI to manage portfolio health at scale — tracking account signals, personalising outreach, and identifying at-risk accounts before they churn.

• Partner with Account Executives (AE) on renewals and expansion opportunities — identifying whitespace across Contracts, Compliance, and Funds, and surfacing commercial conversations at the right moment.

• Synthesise account signals and surface client feedback to product and operations — acting as the voice of your clients internally to influence service design and roadmap.

• Drive significant Net Dollar Retention across your portfolio, with a focus on whitespace opportunities, proactive risk management and early intervention.

• Contribute to playbook development, sharing learnings that improve the scaled model for the whole team.

The Team You'll Work With

You'll be joining our Carta Law Customer Success (CS) team. We manage the full client lifecycle — from welcoming new clients through onboarding to building deep, lasting relationships with established fund managers and their legal teams.

We sit at the intersection of legal delivery, commercial strategy, and operations. Day-to-day you'll partner closely with AEs, legal delivery, and the CS Program Manager to ensure clients across your portfolio are healthy and growing. You'll be a key part of the team reporting to the Global Head of CS.

About You

We're looking for a client-focused, commercially aware professional who knows how to manage a broad book of business without losing the personal touch. You're organised, data-driven, and energised by the challenge of driving real outcomes at scale.

Specifically, we're looking for:

• 3+ years of experience in Customer Success or Account Management within SaaS or professional services. You've managed a portfolio of accounts and know how to balance competing priorities without dropping anything.

• Portfolio management experience. You're comfortable managing 40+ accounts simultaneously — using data and tooling to triage effectively and deploy your time where it matters most.

• Strong client communication skills. You communicate proactively, build rapport quickly, and handle difficult conversations with professionalism and empathy.

• Commercial instincts. You spot expansion opportunities organically and know how to partner with sales to take them forward. You understand what drives ARR and how CS contributes.

• Data-driven approach. You track GDR, account health scores, and expansion signals — and use them to drive decisions.

• Comfort with tooling and AI. You're experienced with CS platforms and either already using AI to manage your portfolio more efficiently, or you're eager to.

• Cross-functional collaboration. You work naturally with AEs, legal delivery, product, and operations — marshalling internal resources to get things done for your clients.

• Prior experience in the legal industry or private markets is a significant advantage. Familiarity with venture capital, private equity, or fund operations gives you an immediate leg up in understanding our clients' world.

What We Offer

• Competitive salary

• Equity in Carta

• Private health insurance

• Flexible working arrangements

• A high-growth environment where you'll build something that matters

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our expected cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:

• $129,000 - $144,000 in New York $109,000 - $122,000 in New Jersey

We are hiring for multiple levels and locations, so final offers may vary from the amounts listed based on geography, experience and expertise, and other factors.

Disclosures:

• We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.

• Carta uses E-Verify in the United States for employment authorization. See the E-Verify and Department of Justice websites for more details.

• For information on our data privacy policies, see Privacy, CA Candidate Privacy, and Brazil Transparency Report.

• Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com or @carta-external.com domain. Report any contact from unapproved domains to security@carta.com.

jobs.title: Founders Associate
jobs.description:
CIVIC MARKETPLACE: FOUNDERS ASSOCIATE

Location: London, with daily overlap into US Central hours and regular travel to Texas

Type: Full time


ROLE OVERVIEW

Civic Marketplace is an AI native cooperative procurement platform for US local government. Public procurement is one of the largest, least modernised workflows in the public sector. Our agentic workflows help agencies discover, evaluate and engage suppliers faster, and open public sector opportunities to more businesses.

We are looking for a Founders Associate to work directly with the CEO: taking the company's most important cross functional problems, putting structure around them, and running them to completion with a team eight hours away.




WHY CIVIC MARKETPLACE

This is a seat at the centre of a company building category defining infrastructure for how government buys. The market is large, under contested and moving fast toward AI. You will see every part of the business, work directly with the founders, investors and our government partners, and own outcomes rather than support someone else who does.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This is an owner's role, not a chief of staff in the scheduling sense. You will take two or three company priorities a quarter off the CEO's desk and run them end to end. Al is based in the UK and most of the team and our partners are in US Central, so you will open workstreams with Al in the UK morning and run them with the US team through their day.

You will:

 - Own flagship programmes end to end: for example our solicitation sourcing programme with a cooperative partner, designing the process and the AI tooling around it and running it to the outcome.

 - Bring structure to ambiguous questions: turn a half formed question from the CEO, the board or a partner into a framed problem with options and a recommendation, usually within a day.

 - Run the operating rhythm: leadership syncs, board and investor updates, OKR reviews and the all hands, so decisions get made and then get done.

 - Represent the CEO with partners: hold your own with procurement directors, cooperative executives and investors, and take the meetings that do not need Al.

 - Build with AI: use Claude, our MCP server and internal agents as a default part of how you work, and help the team do the same.


ABOUT YOU

You are three to five years post MBB, or an operator at a Series A to C company who has run a cross functional programme. You have owned something from brief to result without a handover, and you want more of that, not a stepping stone toward it.

You likely have:

 - Strategic frameworks you bring into the room unprompted: given an ambiguous problem you structure it, form hypotheses and propose how to test them without being led there.

 - Executive presence: concise, confident, direct, and able to hold a room with senior public sector or investor audiences.

 - A track record of ownership: a programme, launch or deal you ran where you set the plan, made the calls and carried the outcome.

 - Experience working with senior stakeholders across time zones, and a clear method for keeping work moving while you are asleep.

 - Analytical fluency: comfortable building the number yourself in spreadsheets, dashboards and SQL adjacent tools.

 - Hands on use of AI tooling in your own work: agents, MCP, prompt driven workflows.

 - Low ego and high standards: direct, curious, and comfortable being challenged.

 - Public sector curiosity. No prior government experience required; exposure to procurement, cooperative purchasing or regulated B2B markets is a plus.


WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

 - Real ownership from week one, working directly with the CEO and founders.

 - Exposure to every part of a Series A company heading into Series B: product, commercial, partnerships, fundraising and board.

 - A clear path to a Head of Operations or GM style role as the company scales.

 - A small, committed team of thoughtful operators and engineers across the US and UK.

 - Competitive salary and meaningful equity.

 - Remote first with regular time together, and travel to the US given how central relationships are.

jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
The Role

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Data Platform Engineer to build and scale enterprise data services centered on SingleStore Helios and PostgreSQL. You will combine database architecture and production engineering with data pipeline development, data curation, platform migrations, self-service enablement and cost optimization. You will work with teams across regions to deliver reliable, well-governed data services.

What you'll do

• Design, develop and optimize SingleStore and PostgreSQL schemas, SQL queries, physical data models, indexing and workload performance.

• Build and maintain reliable batch, streaming and CDC ingestion pipelines from relational databases, object storage and other enterprise sources into SingleStore; implement validation, transformation, enrichment and data curation.

• Lead technical assessments and migrations of existing applications and data workloads to SingleStore, while onboarding new teams, applications and services.

• Build reusable self-service onboarding capabilities, including APIs, configuration templates, automated provisioning, access requests, pipeline deployment and operational guardrails.

• Optimize cloud database spend through workload right-sizing, consolidation, scheduling and performance tuning; develop transparent SingleStore cluster, application and team-level cost allocation and showback.

• Own production readiness and database reliability: monitoring, incident triage, root-cause analysis, recoverability, deployment controls and collaboration with SingleStore Helios support.

• Integrate data quality, lineage, ownership and access controls into delivery workflows; work with the enterprise data catalog and governance teams.

• Create engineering standards, CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, documentation and cross-region handoffs that reduce manual operational work.

What you'll bring

What you need

• 7+ years of hands-on experience in data platform engineering, database engineering or closely related production data roles.

• Advanced SQL and PostgreSQL expertise, including query plans, schema design, performance tuning and operational troubleshooting.

• Strong Python and practical experience developing production-grade ingestion and transformation pipelines, with testing and observability.

• Experience with distributed or cloud-managed databases and modern data integration patterns, including batch and CDC; familiarity with cloud object storage as an ingestion and staging layer.

• Ability to own end-to-end technical delivery, collaborate with application teams and solve complex production issues independently.

We'd love if you had

• Hands-on SingleStore (MemSQL) or SingleStore Helios experience, including pipelines, performance tuning and workload design.

• Kafka or similar streaming platforms, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and API-driven platform automation.

• Experience building self-service data platforms, data quality frameworks, metadata/catalog integrations and chargeback/showback reporting.

• Experience with cloud FinOps, database migrations or financial-services enterprise data.

Who We Are

Schonfeld is a global multi-manager hedge fund that strives to deliver industry-leading risk-adjusted returns for our investors. We leverage both internal and external portfolio manager teams around the world, seeking to capitalize on inefficiencies and opportunities within the markets. We draw from decades of experience and a significant investment in proprietary technology, infrastructure and risk analytics to invest across four main strategies: Quant, Tactical, Fundamental Equity and Discretionary Macro & Fixed Income.

Our Culture

At Schonfeld, we’ll invest in you. Attracting and retaining top talent is at the heart of what we do, because we believe that exceptional outcomes begin with exceptional people. We foster a culture where talent is empowered to continually learn, innovate and pursue ambitious goals. We are teamwork-oriented, collaborative and encourage ideas—at all levels—to be shared. As an organization committed to investing in our people, we provide learning and educational offerings and opportunities to make an impact. We encourage community through internal networks, external partnerships and service initiatives that promote inclusion and purpose beyond the firm’s walls.

The base pay for this role is expected to be between $180,000 and $250,000. The expected base pay range is based on information at the time this post was generated. This role may also be eligible for other forms of compensation such as a performance bonus and a competitive benefits package. Actual compensation for the successful candidate will be determined based on a variety of factors such as skills, qualifications, and experience.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Supply Chain & External Manufacturing
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Prime Medicine is a leading biotechnology company dedicated to creating and delivering the next generation of gene editing therapies to patients. The Company is leveraging its proprietary Prime Editing platform, a versatile, precise and efficient gene editing technology, to develop a new class of differentiated, one-time, potentially curative genetic therapies. Designed to make only the right edit at the right position within a gene while minimizing unwanted DNA modifications, Prime Editors have the potential to repair almost all types of genetic mutations and work in many different tissues, organs and cell types.

Prime Medicine is currently progressing a diversified portfolio of investigational therapeutic programs organized around our core areas of focus: hematology, immunology & oncology, liver and lung. Across each core area, Prime Medicine is focused initially on a set of high value programs, each targeting a disease with well-understood biology and a clearly defined clinical development and regulatory path, and each expected to provide the foundation for expansion into additional opportunities. For more information, please visit www.primemedicine.com.

Prime Medicine is a clinical-stage biotechnology company creating the next generation of gene editing therapies. Our Prime Editing platform is versatile, precise, and efficient, with the potential to address more than 90% of known disease-causing genetic mutations. We have three programs in the clinic: an ex vivo cell therapy for an ultra-rare disease advancing toward a Biologics License Application (BLA), and two in vivo liver-targeting LNP Prime Editor programs, with more in development. We are a mission-driven team working in a lean, fast-moving environment.

Position Overview

Reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer, the Executive Director of Supply Chain and External Manufacturing is a member of the Technology, Development and Operations (TDO) leadership team. You will own Prime Medicine’s end-to-end supply chain, from raw materials through clinical supply and commercialization, with direct accountability for materials management and for supporting internal planning and manufacturing needs. You will manage our external manufacturing partners, lead a highly functional lean team, and serve as the primary partner to Finance for TDO external spend. We are looking for a leader who embraces AI as a core part of how supply chain and external manufacturing run at Prime Medicine, from forecasting and materials visibility to partner performance and cost modeling. This role is for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is energized by building, and pairs strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

Primary Responsibilities

• Partner with the CTO and TDO leadership to define manufacturing and supply chain strategy, including network design, make-vs-buy decisions, and partner selection.

• AI-enabled operations. • Experience with cell therapy and/or LNP or nucleic acid programs; experience supporting IND/CTA and BLA/MAA submissions

• Financial acumen, including ownership of operating budgets and multi-year cost projections

• Track record of implementing AI or digital tools that improved forecasting, visibility, or decision-making in supply chain or operations, and of changing how teams work as a result

• Strong change management, project management, and communication skills, with the ability to build trust with partners, Finance, and senior leadership

• Plus: lean, fast-moving biotech; ultra-rare disease or small patient population experience

Why Prime Medicine

Your work will matter: our programs have the potential to be curative therapies for patients with no other options, and this role directly enables that. You will be part of the TDO leadership team, with direct access to the CTO and interact with other Executive leaders, and you will shape how AI is applied to supply chain and manufacturing at a company where it is a growing priority. You will have ownership from day one in building how Prime Medicine delivers for patients.
