jobs.title: Senior Privacy Review Specialist (AI/LLM Governance)
jobs.description:
Why Join Exadel

We’re an AI-first global tech company with 25+ years of engineering leadership, 2,000+ team members, and 500+ active projects powering Fortune 500 clients, including HBO, Microsoft, Google, and Starbucks.

From AI platforms to digital transformation, we partner with enterprise leaders to build what’s next.
What powers it all? Our people are ambitious, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

About the Client

A global technology leader specializing in search technology, digital advertising, cloud computing, and artificial intelligence. Delivering enterprise cloud infrastructure and software solutions, the organization builds scalable consumer and enterprise AI experiences. Today, the company leverages foundational AI models and advanced machine learning to power digital ecosystems for billions of global users.

What You’ll Do

• Conduct formal, end-to-end written privacy reviews for products, features, research publications, data pipelines, and experimental prototypes

• Evaluate privacy risks and recommend practical safeguards aligned with internal standards and applicable global regulations

• Manage reviews from initial discovery and risk identification through remediation and final approval

• Provide strategic guidance and support the escalation of complex or high-risk privacy matters

• Maintain accurate, detailed, and audit-ready assessment documentation

• Assess the privacy implications of AI, machine learning, generative AI, and Large Language Model systems

• Evaluate data ingestion, prompt inputs, context windows, model outputs, training workflows, inference processes, and human-in-the-loop oversight

• Identify potential risks involving personal data, data leakage, memorization, secondary use, data retention, and inappropriate model outputs

jobs.title: Mobile Engineer - ElevenMusic
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and share. The team is small, agent-first and sits apart from the main org, with very fast CI, so ideas often ship the same or next day. Today, one engineer runs the whole iOS app alone.

We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer to own ElevenMusic across iOS and Android, and to make mobile a driver of the product rather than a downstream port of web features. You’ll build for musicians and creatives, think in systems as well as screens, and work with high autonomy and a high bar for taste.

Requirements

 - Shipped a well-designed, production mobile app that real users love, and can show us what you owned.

 - Strong systems thinking across mobile and backend. We’re framework-agnostic (Swift UI or Kotlin Jetpack Compose), but expect you to work across iOS and Android.

 - Exceptional product taste and a clear view on what makes a mobile experience great.

 - Highly self-directed: you turn loose directions into shipped work and own the outcome.

Bonus: musical interest or intuition. Open-source or GitHub contributions.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Warsaw, and Amsterdam.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Writer
jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.  Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Our docs get used in a few different ways. Some people land on a page in the middle of a task and just need the answer. Others are working out how to run Kong across a whole company, with real traffic and a lot of teams. The docs also power agent workflows, ours and our customers', like MCP servers and AI assistants. So when a page is wrong, it's wrong everywhere.

You'll own the docs for at least one product area, and you'll decide what to work on based on what you see. What features are releasing? Where are people getting stuck? What are the field teams hearing? You won't spend all your time in your area, though. You'll work with the other docs writers every day, check in with them when your work is done, ask for help when you're buried, and weigh in on each other's problems. You'll also work closely with product managers and engineers, and you'll be in their conversations early.

We own our docs platform, too. If a workflow could be better, you can build a better one. Add Vale rules, upgrade the platform, set up auto-generated docs. We have a docs engineer that can help you turn your needs into real features!




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own your product area

 - Own the documentation strategy for your area. That means getting into the product, seeing what's about to ship, deciding what needs writing, and planning the work. Share that plan with the docs team so everyone knows what's in motion. If something looks off, we'll sort it out together.

 - Work with product and field teams to find where a docs gap is blocking someone, and bring the data: user behavior, field feedback, adoption numbers. Who asked loudest shouldn't decide what gets written.

 - Sit in on product management discussions and say what you're seeing, so the docs and the product strategy stay in step.

Write it and test it

 - Write and edit how-to guides, reference documentation, and the pages that point people where they need to go, like landing pages and overviews.

 - Test everything you write. You're usually the first person outside engineering to use a new feature, so run the software, talk to the experts, and use the command line and API testing tools. If the steps don't work, the page isn't finished.

 - Review docs for technical accuracy and make sure they follow our guidelines.

Keep it all current

 - Maintain what's already published. Update it, revise it, and deprecate what's out of date.

 - Improve how we do docs, including document management and version control in Git, and help plan docs work so it ships on schedule.




WHAT YOU BRING

Must have

 - You've worked alongside other technical writers on a docs team, not just with engineers or a manager, and you're comfortable giving and getting reviews

 - You've worked as a technical writer at a software company or a startup

 - Experience working with AI and AI-native workflows (building skills using MCP servers)

 - An understanding of how to test software, including APIs and command line tools, and hands-on experience doing it

 - Comfort working in the command line, and solid Git experience

 - Experience maintaining, managing, and reviewing docs in a docs-as-code environment



About Kong: 

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com http://www.konghq.com.

jobs.title: AI Transformation Engineer
jobs.description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com.

The AI Transformation Office partners with departments across Yext to improve business outcomes through 30 to 60 day transformation sprints. As an AI Transformation Engineer, you build the production systems that make that real: retrieval, answer drafting, routing and evaluation on live data, plus the APIs, automations and pipelines around them. Each sprint ends with a handoff to the team that owns the outcome.

This is not a product-roadmap engineering role. You embed with department teams, learn how work actually gets done, and build with whatever fits. That is usually a workflow platform such as n8n first, and code only where the platform runs out. You care as much about whether someone else can run your work as whether it runs in production. You build and you teach, as one motion.

What You'll Do

Production LLM systems (40%)

• Build and run production LLM workflows in n8n and similar platforms: retrieval over ticket and documentation data, answer drafting and routing.

• Build APIs, integrations and data pipelines that connect CRM, support and operational systems.

• Build and calibrate confidence scoring so teams know when to trust an answer, and design the review steps and approval gates where a person decides.

• Protect the data you work with: scope what each workflow can read, handle PII and sensitive fields, and keep access logs.

• Ship every solution monitored, error-handled and version-controlled, not just functional.

Evals and quality (15%)

• Define evals before each build: test sets, groundedness and accuracy checks, and the thresholds that decide whether output ships or needs review.

• Report quality results to partner teams in plain terms.

• Track LLM spend and usage by team, manage API keys, and report run rate.

Knowledge transfer and enablement (20%)

• Pair-build with embedded team members so they learn by doing, not by watching.

• Write documentation that scales: runbooks, admin guides, architecture diagrams and decision logs.

• Train department champions at the right altitude: enough to maintain and extend, not enough to overwhelm.

• Build with handoff in mind from day one. The owning team should run each system day to day within 30 days of launch. They own workflow configuration, prompts, review queues and reports. You keep the retrieval, eval and scoring code until a second engineer can take it.

System design and architecture (15%)

• Design integration patterns that connect CRM, support and operational systems.

• Architect data flows that enable automation and AI-powered decisions.

• Evaluate new models and tools, and make build-vs-buy recommendations grounded in the team's real maintenance capacity.

Opportunity identification (10%)

• Spot automation and integration opportunities others miss by understanding how work actually gets done.

• Translate technical possibilities into language department stakeholders can evaluate.

• Estimate effort honestly and scope tightly: cut work that does not change the outcome, and say so early.

What You Have

• 5 to 8 years in software engineering, integration development or automation engineering.

• Production experience with a workflow platform such as n8n, Zapier or Tray.io, building automations that other teams rely on.

• Experience designing reliable autonomous agents: agent frameworks and patterns such as tool calling, orchestration, guardrails and human escalation, with eval feedback loops that keep output high quality and consistent.

• Python or TypeScript for the work a platform cannot do, with API design skills and an understanding of how software is operated: monitoring, error handling, version control and deployment discipline.

• Hands-on production use of LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI or Google), including prompt design and structured outputs.

• Retrieval experience: vector databases such as Qdrant or pgvector, chunking and grounding.

• Experience measuring LLM output quality with test sets, graded review or evals.

• Experience handling sensitive data in production systems: PII, permissions and audit logging.

• A teaching instinct. You explain what you build and why, and you notice when someone is lost before they say so.

• Documentation discipline, and the ability to explain trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders without jargon.

Bonus Points

• MCP servers, agent frameworks or tool-calling design.

• Experience governing a shared LLM cost budget or API keys.

• CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot), data engineering or ETL, and warehouse analytics such as Snowflake.

• Familiarity with support, customer success or professional services operations.

• Experience building internal tools where the users are colleagues, not customers.

• Training, facilitation or mentoring experience, formal or informal.

• Comfort in ambiguous environments where requirements evolve as understanding deepens.

Flex Capabilities

You bring enough business context to understand why a process exists, not only how to automate it. You can contribute to prioritization, challenge assumptions about what is worth building, and sharpen your business instincts over time. We are a small team, and everyone stretches beyond their primary role.

What Success Looks Like

Each engagement agrees on key metrics before work starts, such as deflection rate, handle time or hours saved, and measures it against a baseline taken before launch.

30 days: You understand the systems landscape across the partner department and have identified three or more high-impact automation or integration opportunities. The first sprint has an agreed metric, baseline and eval set. Embedded team members see you as approachable and are already learning from working alongside you.

60 days: The first automation is live, meets the agreed quality threshold, and moves the agreed metric. At least one embedded team member can explain how it works and make minor changes without you. Documentation is current, not aspirational.

90 days: The first system is owned by the partner team day to day, and a second is live and stable. Embedded champions can maintain and extend them, and LLM spend is tracked by team. Handoff documentation is complete enough that a new engineer could onboard from it. The department refers to your work as "ours," not "the AI team's."

jobs.title: Senior Brand Manager
jobs.description:
The Senior Brand Manager is the person who turns brand strategy into campaigns that guests notice, talk about, and travel for. You will lead four to six tentpole campaigns a year from brief to launch to read-out, and you will be a lead voice in shaping the brand plan those campaigns deliver against.

Brand marketing is a muscle we are still building here, and this role is central to building it. We have one of the most naturally beloved and press-magnetic brands in American retail, along with an enormous opportunity to tell that story more deliberately and more often. You will work across creative, social, digital, e-commerce, public relations, out-of-home, partnerships, influencers, and the in-store experience to bring campaigns to life, leading through influence and bringing partners across the business with you.

We are looking for someone with a real brand marketing foundation, the kind built inside a consumer business where the brand itself is the asset, or at a brand-led agency serving those businesses. This role operates across our Scottsboro campus and our Atlanta-based marketing team, and you will spend meaningful time on the ground in Scottsboro, where the destination, the store, and the guest experience actually live. As you establish yourself, the scope grows to include destination and tourism partnerships, a college ambassador program, and out-of-home and local media buying.

How You’ll Drive Our Strategy

Our 5-year vision is to create “a destination experience so compelling, you can’t wait to share it”: an iconic destination brand delivering elevated retail, online, and hospitality experiences that inspire pride, connection, and storytelling. Five strategic imperatives get us there. This role sits at the center of two of them.

• Building a World-Class Brand Experience: Grow our fanatical fanbase locally and nationally through regional awareness campaigns with a strong Huntsville focus, brand tentpoles, and storytelling that makes our brand rival top consumer brands.
• Creating a Multi-Day Campus Destination: Build the awareness, tourism partnerships, and destination marketing programs that turn Scottsboro into a place guests travel for and stay overnight to explore, supporting the campus master plan and the broader revitalization of downtown Scottsboro.

Key Responsibilities

• Campaign Leadership, End to End: Lead four to six tentpole campaigns a year from start to finish. Set the objective and success criteria, write the brief, build the plan and the budget, orchestrate the cross-functional team through execution, and run the post-campaign read-out. Your team carries much of the event production and on-site logistics, and you own the brief, the plan, and the result. This is the core of the role.
• Brand Planning: Serve as a lead voice in building our annual brand strategy, brand plan, and marketing calendar alongside our marketing leadership, then turn that plan into the campaigns that deliver it.
• Creative Briefing & Partnership: Write briefs sharp enough for a creative team to solve, then partner closely with our Creative Director and her team through concepting and production to keep the work on strategy and on brand.
• Regional Awareness & the Huntsville Market: Own the awareness plan for our priority regional markets, Huntsville first. Identify and recommend the strongest out-of-home and local media placements for your campaigns, and build the community presence, sponsorships, and grassroots programs that go with them. Get immersed in Huntsville and build the relationships that come with that.
• Public Relations Support: Build earned media into your campaigns, working as the day-to-day campaign partner to our PR agency and to your PR & Communications Specialist, who supports coordination, press mailings, and on-site media visits.
• Partnerships & Activations: Lead brand partnerships, pop-ups, and activations that extend our reach into new audiences, and brief influencer work into your campaigns.
• Cross-Functional Partnership: Work hand in hand with our social, digital and e-commerce, and experiential design teams so that campaigns land consistently everywhere a guest meets the brand. You will bring the brand lens to their work and they will bring channel expertise to yours.
• Team Leadership: Lead and develop our PR & Communications Specialist and our Project Coordinator, two talented teammates based in Scottsboro who are growing quickly. Investing in them is a core part of this job, and over time they will take on more across events, media operations, measurement, and press coordination.
• Presence in Scottsboro: Spend regular time on the ground in Scottsboro as a working partner to Retail, Operations, and our local marketing team on campaign and event execution.
• Measurement & Reporting: Define success criteria before a campaign launches, track regional awareness, traffic, and engagement against them, and use what you learn to sharpen the next one. Train the broader team to run this over time.
• Budget Stewardship: Build and manage campaign budgets, prioritizing spend toward the highest-impact awareness, traffic, and engagement opportunities.

Team Structure

• Reports To: Sr. Director of Omni-Channel Marketing & E-Commerce
• Direct Reports: PR & Communications Specialist; Project Coordinator
• Key Partners: SVP of Commercial Strategy, Creative Director, Director of Experiential Design, Social Media Specialist, E-Commerce Marketing team, our PR agency, and Retail leadership

What Success Looks Like

• Four to six tentpole campaigns a year that launch on time, on brief, and with measurable results against criteria set before launch.
• A stronger annual brand plan that you helped shape, and campaigns that visibly deliver against it.
• Continued growth in regional brand awareness, particularly in the Huntsville market.
• Growth in both local and destination guest traffic to the Scottsboro store.
• Deeper guest engagement across events, activations, social, and campaigns.
• Two direct reports who are visibly growing in capability and confidence.

• 5 to 8 years of brand marketing experience, built inside a consumer business where the brand is a core asset, such as consumer products, retail, restaurant, hospitality, entertainment, or destination, or at a brand-led agency serving those categories
• A track record leading several full-cycle brand campaigns, from strategy and brief through cross-functional execution and measurement. You have run this process enough times to be comfortable with it
• Strong ability to lead through influence: getting excellent work out of creative, social, digital, PR, and retail partners who do not report to you
• Excellent creative briefing and written communication skills. You can define a problem sharply enough that a creative team can solve it
• Experience partnering with creative teams, with a clear eye for whether work is on strategy and on brand
• Experience planning out-of-home and local media, with a clear point of view on placement and reach in a regional market
• Experience working with a PR, media, or creative agency as a day-to-day partner
• Analytical comfort. You set success criteria before you launch, read the results honestly, and adjust
• Strong project management instincts and the ability to run several campaigns at once without dropping the details
• A self-starter who brings their own direction and is energized by building something rather than inheriting it
• Preferred: destination, tourism, experiential, or retail marketing experience
• Preferred: people leadership experience
• Preferred: existing ties to the Huntsville or North Alabama market
• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or a related field
• Based in Scottsboro, AL or Atlanta, GA, with regular time on site in Scottsboro

Why Join Us

• Be part of an iconic brand with a rich history, an entrepreneurial culture, and a powerful purpose.
• Shape brand marketing for a company with enormous brand equity and a story people already love to tell.
• Directly shape two of the company’s five strategic imperatives: Building a World-Class Brand Experience and Creating a Multi-Day Campus Destination.
• Work in a dynamic, close-knit, and mission-driven environment.
• Competitive salary and benefits package.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
AMS is seeking an Electrical Engineer to support engineering testing, troubleshooting, data analysis, hardware support, and technical documentation for critical systems used in nuclear power plants and other demanding environments.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who wants to work with real equipment, real plant data, and real customer problems. AMS engineers support laboratory testing, field measurements, instrumentation system evaluations, equipment troubleshooting, data acquisition, hardware and software verification, and engineering reports.

Successful engineers at AMS combine strong technical aptitude with curiosity, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a commitment to quality. Training will be provided in AMS methodologies, proprietary systems, testing standards, nuclear industry expectations, and quality assurance processes.

The goal of this position is to develop an electrical engineer who can grow into a trusted technical contributor capable of supporting AMS’s core engineering and testing services with professionalism, accuracy, and accountability.

What You’ll Do

• Analyze real-world plant data, laboratory measurements, and electrical test results.
• Support testing and troubleshooting of instrumentation and control systems used in nuclear power plants.
• Assist with data acquisition, signal measurement, equipment setup, and analysis for commercial testing services, research projects, and engineering evaluations.
• Perform laboratory and field testing activities.
• Prepare equipment for laboratory testing and plant trips, including configuration, verification, documentation, checkout, and return to proper storage.
• Participate in on-site work at nuclear plants and customer facilities as needed, which may include field measurements, testing support, equipment setup, and troubleshooting.
• Assist with troubleshooting efforts when equipment, systems, or test results do not initially meet expected criteria.
• Support hardware development and equipment improvement activities, including prototype assembly, hardware testing, equipment troubleshooting, and documentation updates.
• Support quality assurance activities, including hardware and software verification, test plan execution, documentation completion, and adherence to structured engineering workflows.
• Draft and refine technical reports, trip reports, test documentation, and supporting engineering records with close attention to clarity, accuracy, and applicable requirements.
• Learn and apply applicable industry standards, test methods, customer requirements, and AMS procedures.
• Contribute improvement ideas that strengthen AMS testing methods, equipment, documentation, and overall service quality.

Who We’re Looking For

• A curious and proactive learner who wants to master new technical areas, tools, standards, and test methods.
• A hands-on engineer who enjoys working with equipment, measurements, software, data, and real-world systems.
• A detail-oriented professional who understands that documentation accuracy matters in safety-critical applications.
• A critical thinker with a practical problem-solving mindset and the judgment to ask good questions when needed.
• A clear communicator who can represent AMS professionally with internal teams, customers, and plant personnel.
• A reliable and personally accountable team member who follows through on assigned work and takes ownership of results.
• A collaborative engineer who works effectively with technicians, engineers, managers, and customers in a respectful, high-performing environment.
• Someone who wants to build a long-term technical career in a specialized engineering company serving the nuclear industry.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related technical discipline
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Interest in hands-on testing, instrumentation, controls, electrical systems, data acquisition, hardware, or applied engineering
• Ability to follow structured engineering procedures and work within a quality-assured environment
• Strong attention to detail in technical documentation, data analysis, test planning, and report preparation
• Clear written and verbal communication skills
• Willingness to travel to customer facilities and nuclear plants as needed

This position involves work under U.S. Department of Energy contracts and requires access to nuclear facilities. As a result, U.S. citizenship is required to meet federal compliance and security-access regulations.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience or coursework related to instrumentation and controls, circuits, signal processing, electrical measurements, data acquisition, power systems, controls, or hardware development.
• Experience with test equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, signal generators, spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, data acquisition systems, or similar measurement tools.
• Exposure to laboratory testing, field testing, systems integration, nuclear power, aerospace, defense, automotive, manufacturing, or other regulated technical environments.
• Experience with prototype assembly, hardware troubleshooting, equipment repair, circuit testing, or hardware documentation.
• Familiarity with EMC testing, EMI/RFI troubleshooting, or related standards such as MIL-STD-461 or IEC 61000 is a plus, but not required.
• Experience writing technical reports, test procedures, engineering evaluations, or structured documentation.

Compensation & Benefits

• Health Coverage – Generous employer contributions toward comprehensive health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
• Retirement – 401(k) with generous employer matching contributions
• Paid Time Off – 20 days annual vacation plus at least 10 paid holidays per year
• Professional Development – AMS is committed to your growth as a technical specialist; mentorship by senior engineers and PhDs, access to professional conferences, and continuing education opportunities in nuclear engineering and advanced analysis
• Career Growth – Annual salary reviews, raises, and advancement opportunities within a fast-paced, team-oriented, mission-driven organization
• Meaningful Work – The opportunity to perform engineering analysis that directly supports nuclear plant safety, reliability, maintenance optimization, and regulatory compliance.

AMS Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. We comply with all applicable employment laws and do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic. Certain roles may require U.S. citizenship or other federally mandated clearances.

jobs.title: Associate Attorney – Litigation
jobs.description:

Our litigation associates are not siloed into narrow tasks—they manage matters from inception through resolution, develop case strategy, interact directly with clients, and represent the firm in court. This role is ideal for a litigation attorney who wants to sharpen their judgment, grow as a strategic advisor, and build a long-term career at a firm that values accountability, craftsmanship, and entrepreneurial thinking.

• Draft and review pleadings, complaints, motions, discovery demands and responses, and demand letters.
• Prepare for, take, and defend depositions; prepare clients and witnesses for testimony.
• Argue motions and participate in court appearances, conferences, and settlement negotiations.
• Manage discovery and deadlines proactively to keep matters moving forward efficiently.
• Communicate directly with clients and opposing counsel, building strong, trusted professional relationships.
• Collaborate with paralegals and internal team members while maintaining accountability for quality, deadlines, and case outcomes.

Individuals who share our core values

• Tenacious - Grit & perseverance when the going gets tough
• Pushing Boundaries - Creative approach to problem-solving

• "Big Law" Approach - Intellectually curious, proactive, high standards

• Bring relevant experience as a junior associate or associate attorney in a law firm, with specific experience supporting commercial real estate litigation.
• Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and appetite for learning, seeking a smaller, up-and-coming firm where they can have real impact and grow their skills.
• Value a high-caliber, collegial culture that is collaborative, responsive, and relationship-driven with colleagues and clients.
• Embrace technology (including legal tech and AI tools) and is eager to learn and adopt new systems that enhance efficiency and quality of work.
• Demonstrate strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple transactions simultaneously.
• Thrive in a fast-paced environment, taking pride in accuracy, professionalism, and supporting attorneys and clients effectively.

• Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school and active license (or eligibility for licensure) to practice law in New York.
• Approximately 4–7 years of litigation experience within a law firm environment
• Substantive experience in real estate litigation and/or commercial/business litigation

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong advocacy skills and ability to think strategically about litigation.
• Demonstrated experience drafting motions and pleadings, managing discovery, and handling depositions

Compensation & Benefits

• Health & Wellness Benefits – Substantial employer contributions toward comprehensive insurance, consistent with NYC legal market standards
• Retirement Savings – 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching contributions up to 4%

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and operate data platform components and data-intensive products. You will own significant data engineering work from requirements and design through implementation and production support, partnering with Data Engineering, Data Science, Cloud, DevOps, Application, Product, and client-facing teams to deliver reliable solutions that support business growth.

This is a hands-on role for an experienced engineer who can solve distributed-data challenges, contribute to sound technical decisions, support other engineers, and help bring emerging technologies into reliable production capabilities.

Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines, platform components, and data-intensive services.
• Own data engineering work from requirements and technical design through implementation, deployment, and production support.
• Contribute to data acquisition strategies, dataset contracts, acceptance criteria, quality standards, lineage, and lifecycle policies.
• Build scalable batch and real-time data pipelines, lakehouse architectures, and distributed processing solutions for high-volume workloads.
• Help evolve the data ecosystem to support growth in data volume, velocity, variety, and product complexity.
• Apply and improve reusable patterns for data ingestion, transformation, storage, orchestration, testing, observability, and delivery.
• Build production systems that meet expectations for reliability, security, performance, scalability, cost efficiency, and SLA-driven delivery.
• Contribute to operational practices for monitoring, incident response, failure recovery, replay, backfills, schema evolution, and disaster recovery.
• Partner with Data Science and ML teams to productionize ML, AI, and LLM-based workloads and integrate them into customer-facing products.
• Collaborate with Cloud, DevOps, Application, Security, Product, and client teams to deliver robust solutions for business and customer needs.
• Evaluate technologies and architectural patterns, contribute to technical proofs of concept, and recommend adoption based on measurable value.
• Document technical decisions, trade-offs, risks, and implementation approaches.
• Participate in technical reviews and help improve design, code quality, testing, maintainability, and production ownership.
• Support engineering roadmaps, hiring, and capability development across the data engineering discipline.

• 6+ years of hands-on software or data engineering experience, including experience designing, building, and operating production-grade data systems.
• Experience contributing to complex data initiatives across teams.
• B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or an equivalent technical field, or comparable practical experience.
• Strong understanding of data-intensive and distributed systems, including scalability, reliability, consistency, and performance trade-offs.
• Strong proficiency in Python and working proficiency in Scala.
• Strong expertise with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

• Advanced SQL skills and strong experience with data modeling, query optimization, and data storage systems.
• Hands-on experience with at least one of the following: data lake or lakehouse architectures; columnar or analytical databases; or NoSQL or distributed database systems.
• Experience owning production-grade batch and/or streaming pipelines, including data quality, observability, schema evolution, backfills, recovery procedures, and SLA management.
• Hands-on experience designing, developing, deploying, and operating production-grade microservices.
• Hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD practices; experience with Helm is an advantage.
• Familiarity with LLM application and workflow frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph.
• Ability to evaluate technologies, make sound technical decisions, and communicate trade-offs to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.
• Strong collaboration, mentoring, and technical communication skills.
• Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while balancing platform improvements with near-term product delivery.
• Pragmatic, results-driven approach and commitment to strong engineering fundamentals.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Nice to Have

• Experience with Delta Lake and/or Apache Iceberg; ML lifecycle tools such as MLflow.
• Experience with Pandas/Polars and building data services/APIs (e.g., FastAPI).
• Experience building LLM-powered agents or chat assistants (RAG, tool/function calling, workflow or multi-agent orchestration) using modern frameworks and platforms.
• Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Pulumi/CloudFormation) and cloud security fundamentals (IAM, secrets, encryption).

• Experience building applications with React and Node.js.

Our Benefits

jobs.title: Incident & Escalation Lead- Enterprise Customers
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

Support Engineering at GitLab believes that healthy teams deliver a healthy customer experience, and that command during a crisis shouldn't fall to whoever happens to be senior and available. GitLab's global Incident & Escalation Management (IM/EM) function coordinates critical incidents, complex multi-team engagements, and executive-level escalations for enterprise customers. As Escalation Manager, you'll own complex, executive, and commercial escalations where customer trust and the relationship are at stake, alongside or independently of a technical issue.

In this functional role, you'll advocate for customers inside GitLab, coordinate teams toward resolution, and lead relationship repair after the event.

What you'll do

• Own complex, executive, and commercial escalations end-to-end, as defined in GitLab's IM/EM engagement model.

• Advocate for customers internally and coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales toward resolution, tracking commitments and holding owning teams accountable to agreed dates and deliverables.

• Maintain a written, customer-facing resolution plan from engagement through confirmed resolution, updating it at each communication milestone.

• Coordinate with Incident Managers during concurrent technical incidents to maintain a single, coherent narrative for the customer.

• Own external escalation communications using GitLab's approved templates and cadence, and represent GitLab in high-stakes customer conversations where clarity and ownership influence retention.

• Engage Sales, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders as needed, including executive-to-executive communication for Severity 1 and 2 events. Brief GitLab leadership with concise summaries that distinguish what's known, what's unknown, and next steps.

• Lead post-escalation reviews and relationship repair plans, contribute corrective actions with named owners and due dates to postmortems, and hand the relationship back to the account's Customer Success Manager at resolution.

• Partner with the Head of IM/EM to develop playbooks, communication templates, and process improvements based on patterns from escalations.

What you'll bring

• Experience in enterprise technical support, customer success, or incident and escalation management at a business-to-business software-as-a-service or enterprise software company.

• A track record of owning complex, multi-stakeholder escalations end-to-end, including executive customer engagements and structured resolution or account plans.

• Executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail into plain-language updates for customers and GitLab leadership.

• The ability to coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales under pressure without formal authority over those teams.

• Calm, structured decision-making with incomplete information and the ability to provide a steadying presence in high-stress customer situations.

• Proficiency with support and coordination tools such as Zendesk, Salesforce, Slack, and PagerDuty, or equivalent platforms.

• Availability for on-call coverage supporting executive escalations as part of a globally distributed team.

• Nice to have: Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation or equivalent certification; customer-facing experience with GitLab, development, security, and operations (DevSecOps), continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), or cloud-native products; experience with formal escalation or incident command frameworks; or AI-assisted support tools for triage, sentiment analysis, or resolution drafting.

About the team

The Incident & Escalation Management function sits within Support Engineering in GitLab's Enterprise Technology & AI (ETA) division. We operate a follow-the-sun model anchored in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and Asia-Pacific, providing year-round, 24-hour coverage for enterprise customers. Our Escalation Managers work globally rather than within a single region, partnering with Incident Managers, Communications Leads, and regional Support Engineering leadership. You'll help shape our playbooks, templates, and standards as we scale.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

• Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being

• Flexible Paid Time Off

• Team Member Resource Groups

• Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

• Growth and Development Fund

• Parental Leave

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. jobs.title: Country Manager Kahawatu - Burundi
jobs.description:
Key responsibilities

1) Shape and deliver Kahawatu’s vision for Burundi

• Work with the Burundi and international teams of Kahawatu and SUCAFINA to develop an ambitious roadmap for the next decade.
• Translate that vision into practical, scalable programs that strengthen coffee production, farmer incomes and household resilience.
• Identify new opportunities based on field realities, evidence and the evolving needs of coffee-growing communities.

2) Lead programs that deliver lasting impact

• Oversee the design and execution of high-quality field programs centered on coffee productivity, quality and regenerative agriculture.
• Integrate climate adaptation, income diversification, gender, youth and household resilience where these strengthen the future of coffee-growing communities.
• Maintain a strong field presence and ensure solutions are practical, locally relevant and capable of being adopted at scale.

3) Build evidence and demonstrate results

• Define meaningful indicators covering coffee production, farmer income, resilience and the adoption of improved practices.
• Use data and learning to improve programs, guide decisions and demonstrate credible impact over multiple seasons.
• Turn results and field insights into compelling evidence for partners, funders and the wider coffee sector.

4) Mobilise partnerships, visibility and funding

• Build relationships with government, donors, development organisations and actors across the international coffee industry.
• Help design and secure funding for programs that can contribute to sector-wide change.
• Lead/support communication, partnership and fundraising campaigns that mobilise international support for Burundi’s coffee future.
• Represent Kahawatu Burundi credibly in national and international forums.

5) Lead and develop a nimble local team

• Provide clear direction to agronomy, field, monitoring and evaluation, and administrative colleagues.
• Build a collaborative, motivated and accountable culture in which people can grow and take initiative.
• Strengthen coordination between field delivery, learning, communications and reporting.

6) Ensure sound and responsible operations

• Oversee budgets, reporting, compliance and the effective use of resources.
• Ensure Kahawatu meets local legal and regulatory requirements and maintains high standards of transparency and integrity.
• Establish proportionate systems that support effective delivery without losing the agility of a small foundation.

You may be ready for this managerial role if you have built strong experience in agriculture, coffee or rural development and are now looking for the opportunity to take on broader leadership responsibility. You will need to be comfortable moving between strategy and hands-on delivery: working with farming communities and technical teams, building relationships with senior partners, and representing an ambitious organisation.

We are interested not only in what you have already done, but also in the scale of responsibility you are ready to take on next.

Must-haves

• A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in agriculture, coffee, rural development or a related field
• Experience designing and delivering agriculture-based programs and achieving measurable results
• A practical understanding of agricultural production and the realities facing smallholder farming communities
• Proven experience in leading multi-cultural teams, projects or significant areas of responsibility, together with the potential and ambition to step into broader organisational leadership
• The ability to build trusted relationships across communities, government, funders and private-sector partners
• Strong communication skills and the ability to turn ideas and evidence into persuasive proposals, presentations and partnerships
• Sound judgement, resilience, cultural sensitivity and a willingness to work hands-on in a complex operating environment
• Fluency in French and a basic command of English; speaking Kirundi or Swahili is a plus
• A commitment to living in Burundi and travelling regularly to coffee-growing communities

Nice to have

We do not expect one candidate to bring everything on this list. Any combination of the following would be an advantage:

• Experience in coffee and regenerative agriculture or perennial crops
• Experience in Burundi, the Great Lakes region or another comparable operating environment
• Experience developing donor-funded programs or public-private partnerships
• Exposure to fundraising, proposal development, campaigning or strategic communications
• Experience using monitoring, evaluation and field data to improve programs and demonstrate impact
• An existing network among coffee-sector actors, NGOs, public authorities or development partners
• Knowledge of Kirundi

What success looks like

Success will mean combining an ambitious long-term vision with credible, practical progress on the ground.

Over the first 12–18 months, we would expect the Country Manager to:

• Build the confidence of Kahawatu’s team, farming communities and key national and international partners
• Strengthen the quality, coordination and measurable impact of existing programs
• Establish a clear and compelling roadmap for Kahawatu’s next decade in Burundi
• Create an environment in which a small, capable local team can perform, develop and take initiative

Over time, success will be reflected in:

• Sustained improvements in coffee productivity, quality, farmer income and household resilience
• Wider adoption of regenerative and climate-resilient agricultural practices
• Meaningful economic and social opportunities for women and young people in coffee-growing communities
• Programs and partnerships capable of contributing to national-scale change, supported by credible evidence and able to mobilise international support.
• Strong evidence demonstrating Kahawatu’s impact over multiple seasons
• Kahawatu being recognised as an innovative, trusted and effective partner in the future of Burundi’s coffee sector

Why join Kahawatu Foundation?

• Lead programs that directly impact thousands of coffee-farming households
• Operate at the core of Burundi’s most strategic agricultural sector
• Work across public and private actors to drive systemic change
• Contribute to the long-term transformation of the coffee sector through practical, field-driven impact

If you recognize yourself in this role and believe you have the experience, leadership, and drive to contribute to the future of Burundi’s coffee sector, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Customer Success Engagement Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Viaduct is designed for the new era of manufacturing and powered by patented predictive models, Viaduct delivers a single, real-time view of your operations that help manufacturing

teams improve yield, eliminate rework, and reduce costs. By turning complex operational data into actionable insights, our customers catch issues earlier and maximize asset performance.  Take a couple minutes to view this “day in the life” video and the S&P Global independent market insight report.

Who you are

We are searching for an engagement manager experienced in customer success and data analytics.  This role will lead several customer engagements to ensure realized value. As a key member of our customer success team, you will be the primary point of contact for customers, ensuring they are allocated proper resources, consistently receive quality service, and have access to all of the benefits that Viaduct provides.   Additionally, you will work directly with our data science, product, and engineering teams to evolve our solution to fit customer needs and changing market dynamics.

‍The role requires excellent attention to detail, collaboration, communication and organizational skills, paired with the ability to manage multiple projects and customers. Additionally, you are a skilled analytics practitioner who knows how to apply practical data analytics to create solutions that drive measurable impact

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and oversee customer engagement(s), consulting and/or analytics projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality outputs.

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers, understanding their needs and translating them into actionable analytics solutions.

• Collaborate and provide expert guidance to the product, engineering and data science teams, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

• Ensure the alignment of analytics projects with business value.

• Monitor project progress, manage risks, prioritize actions, and ensure adherence to budgets and timelines.

• Present findings and recommendations to senior management and customers, effectively communicating complex data insight resulting in business value.

• Develop strategy and lead execution of customer engagement extensions and renewals.

• Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in data analytics and apply them to improve our software.

• Work with customers to gather software requests and prioritize backlog with product teams.

In addition to your responsibilities as a customer success engagement manager, you will be supporting various Solution Architect responsibilities including but not limited to:

• The Solution Architect will engage with business teams to translate business visions into realistic technical implementations while also working closely with our customers to identify and pilot value-based use cases.

• The role combines technical prowess, strategic vision, and a deep understanding of AI to drive successful implementations in the automotive domain.

• The Solution Architect has a focus on pre-sales activities with continuation through any PoCs. In addition, the position will support the Customer Engagement Lead where needed throughout the delivery of an engagement.

• The Solution Architect will bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and practical business outcomes, ensuring that our AI solution moves beyond proof of concept and into production.

• The solution architect owns the responsibility for our demo structure, components, environment and overall availability. In addition, the role owns demo delivery to current and prospective customers.

• The solution architect will attend, participate in and lead activities for various on-site and virtual conferences and webinars.

Position Details:

• Compensation: 85% fixed salary + 15% bonus based on performance

• Travel: 0-50%

• Role Type: Individual Contributor

• Employment Type: Full Time

• Work site: Up to 100% work from home

• Profession: Engagement Manager

• Organization: Commercial (Customer Success)

Required qualifications:

• 7+ years of experience in data analytics, with at least 5 years in a leadership role

• Proven track record of managing and delivering large-scale analytics projects with diverse teams

• Experience in customer-facing roles and the ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships.

• Demonstrated ability to innovate and drive business growth through analytics

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

• Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders

• Prior experience using data analytics software and programming languages such as SQL, Python, R, and/or Tableau

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think strategically

Preferred Qualifications:

• M.S. or Ph.D. in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or related field

• 3+ years of Experience working at a big-3 consulting firm

• Knowledge of machine learning algorithms and predictive modeling techniques

• Familiarity with advanced technologies such as Hadoop, Spark, and cloud platforms like AWS or Azure

• Knowledge of manufacturing operations, supply chain, service operations or quality management a plus

Security and Privacy responsibilities

• Follow our policy and procedure documents related to security and privacy

• Follow the guidelines in the Employee Handbook

• Participate in new hire and annual training for security and privacy

• Treat data security and privacy as one of your primary job responsibilities

• Report Security Incidents you discover as bugs

Duffel

Create the future of travel with us.

Whether it’s visiting loved ones, starting an adventure, or a career-defining business trip, travel matters. And yet, anyone who’s booked a flight knows how painful it can be. Outdated systems, clunky tools, endless workarounds - it shouldn’t be this hard.

We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to help our customers get the most out of Duffel. You’ll own relationships, spot growth opportunities, and make sure our technology truly works for them, alongside Customer Success Engineers and Product Support Specialists.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Travel Operations teams to ensure our customers are happy, successful, and inspired by Duffel.

• Excellent communication, translating complex tech and business issues clearly

Bonus points if you have:

jobs.title: Semiconductor Markets - Senior Analyst
jobs.description:
Senior Research Analyst – Semiconductor Industry

Omdia, part of Informa TechTarget, Inc. (Nasdaq: TTGT)

Omdia is a leading market research and consulting group that delivers deep insights into the semiconductor industry and its major component markets, including MCU/MPU, memory (DRAM, NAND Flash), power semiconductors, and MEMS/sensors. Our research empowers the leadership of some of the world’s most influential companies to make informed decisions and shape the future of technology.

As a Senior Research Analyst within Omdia’s semiconductor research team, you will play a pivotal role in driving thought leadership and delivering actionable insights through the Application Market Forecast Tool (AMFT). This position is ideal for a research professional with a passion for uncovering trends, connecting the dots, and shaping the narrative of the semiconductor industry.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop Insightful Research: Conduct in-depth research to generate, maintain, and expand databases for semiconductor components and end-applications. Collaborate with colleagues and leverage your expertise to fill gaps where data is unavailable, ensuring clarity and transparency in assumptions.
• Forecast Market Trends: Use your industry knowledge and analytical skills to create market forecasts that reflect the evolving dynamics of the semiconductor industry. Articulate the rationale behind your forecasts to internal teams and external stakeholders.
• Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with semiconductor analysts to align assumptions and ensure consistency across projects. Partner with equipment analysts and other Omdia teams to gather data, validate assumptions, and build a cohesive view of the market.
• Thought Leadership: Establish Omdia as the definitive source of insight and innovation within the semiconductor industry. Contribute to a compelling research agenda that positions the team at the forefront of industry thought leadership.
• Engage with Stakeholders: Respond to inquiries from colleagues and clients, providing clarity on datasets, methodologies, and assumptions. Build strong relationships with clients to understand their needs and evolve the research offering accordingly.
• Adapt and Innovate: Take ownership of the AMFT model and datasets, demonstrating agility to adapt to changing market conditions. Transform data structures and incorporate new research areas driven by customer demand.
• Support Commercial Growth: Partner with sales and product development teams to identify new opportunities, support renewals, and evolve the research offering to meet client needs.

• Industry Expertise: 2-5 years of relevant experience in the semiconductor industry or research analysis, with a strong understanding of semiconductor components and the forces shaping the market.
• Analytical Depth: Ability to synthesise insights from multiple sources, connect the dots, and think strategically about market trends and dynamics.
• Collaborative Mindset: Proven ability to build relationships across teams and work collaboratively to achieve mutual goals.
• Thought Leadership: Confident in forming and expressing opinions on industry trends, backed by robust data and analysis.
• Technical Proficiency: Advanced MS Excel skills for data organisation, manipulation, and analysis, including pivot tables.
• Intellectual Curiosity: A passion for exploring new research areas, uncovering trends, and delivering insights that drive decision-making.
• Multitasking and Prioritisation: Strong organisational skills to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines effectively.

jobs.title: Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
YOUR NEXT MISSION

Shield critical radar innovations from sophisticated threats. Lock down our infrastructure – keeping our airspace defence rock-solid.

As our Technical Information Security Officer, you lead the technical defence protecting our defence-grade radar systems and intellectual property. You partner closely with IT, DevOps, and Development to design controls, roll out Zero Trust, and secure emerging AI workflows. You report directly to our Head of Information Security (CISO), acting as the central technical bridge between IT and security. Your work ensures our technology stays safe from state-level threats while operating in critical environments.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - IT collaboration and infrastructure: Collaborate closely with the Head of IT and the team. Design, implement, and optimise infrastructure controls like IAM, PAM, and endpoint protections.

 - Zero Trust execution: Drive the technical rollout of our corporate Zero Trust architecture. Enforce continuous verification across systems, cloud environments, and internal networks.

 - AI security and governance: Establish secure boundaries and technical governance for internal AI technologies. Enforce cryptographic data isolation and role-based access for RAG architectures.

 - Emerging threat mitigation: Spot and neutralise AI threat vectors like prompt injections and automated exploits. Guard company intellectual property against unintended exposure via public models.

 - Defence and radar connectivity: Build multi-layered security measures for remote radar management and data links. Protect radar systems deployed and operating within active conflict zones.

 - Incident response and monitoring: Serve as primary technical liaison for our Managed Security Services Provider. Lead technical investigations into complex security incidents alongside internal teams.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - BA/MSc or HBO degree in Computer Science, IT Engineering, Cybersecurity, or similar

 - Over 5 years of hands-on technical experience in Information Security, IT infrastructure, or Network Security

 - Deep technical knowledge and proven experience configuring and managing modern security tools and architectures, including Next-Gen Firewalls, XDR/EDR, SIEM, IAM, and PAM solutions

 - Strong understanding of modern cloud environments, API management, and the implementation of continuous verification and Zero Trust principles

 - Specific expertise in addressing the double-edged nature of AI in security, with a strong grasp of safe GenAI usage controls, LLM vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs), and data-residency isolation

 - Experience operating in defense, military, or critical infrastructure environments, with a strong understanding of the specialized protections required against state-sponsored threat actors

Nice to have

 - Familiarity with secure coding practices and integrating automated security testing into DevOps/SSDLC pipelines

 - Agile and proactive work ethic with strong analytical skills

 - Highly Desirable: CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)

 - Highly Desirable: CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional)

 - Desirable: Zero Trust / Micro-segmentation (e.g., GDSA, Forrester)

 - Desirable: DevSecOps / Offensive Security (e.g., OSCP, GWEB)

 - Office based role (remote work possible). No travelling required


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

 - Comprehensive pension plan;

 - Commuting allowance;

 - 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

 - Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

 - High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role

 - An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks!

Robin Radar is a defence technology leader in detecting, tracking and classifying drones and other small airborne objects. Our radars and software protect military sites, borders and critical infrastructure from drone threats, and also help prevent bird strikes in aviation and reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife. Our work shows up at defence and security sites, airports and wind farms around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning? You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat.

jobs.title: Associate Talent Lead - Commercial
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.



Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLpjeHyocsu3ZoDn3sfODjqIR2L_DW3dgb.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Omnea is scaling fast after raising our Series B in September 2025, and our Commercial Associate (CA) programme is the engine behind it. CAs build pipeline in their territory through events, cold outreach and cold calling, help on live enterprise deals, and earn a fast, meritocratic track to Account Executive. Many of our best AEs started as CAs.

We're hiring an Associate Talent Lead – Commercial to own the top of the funnel for CA hiring in New York. You'll report to our Head of Talent and work side by side with our GTM leadership, including our CCO and SVP Sales.

This is a hands-on, high-volume role. Your job is to find the people other recruiters miss: hungry, scrappy, high-intensity early-career talent who have done something harder than their peers, and to get them excited about the hardest, most rewarding first sales job they'll ever have.

We're building a very different kind of talent function, one focused on quality and care rather than volume for its own sake. If you want to learn recruiting inside a company that treats hiring as its most important lever, this is the seat.




WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT?

 - You'll own the CA pipeline in New York. You'll map talent pools, run sourcing campaigns and manage outreach at scale. The best CAs often don't come from sales: think early-stage startup operators, competitive athletes, consulting and banking analysts who want real ownership, and people who've built side hustles. You'll become the person who knows where to find them.

 - You'll run the first conversation. You'll screen candidates for the traits that predict success at Omnea: killer instinct, scrappiness, work ethic, charisma and composure. You'll use our structured scorecards, and you'll walk away from every great screen rooting for that candidate.

 - You'll keep the process fast and personal. You'll coordinate the sales interview, challenge and final rounds, keep candidates warm between stages, and make sure nobody waits on us. A slow process loses great people; you won't let that happen.

 - You'll write outreach like a salesperson. You'll craft personalised messages that cut through noise and make a passive candidate want to reply. You'll test, measure and iterate on what converts.

 - You'll help build our employer brand in the US. You'll work with the team on CA dinners, university and community events, and investor and referral networks to make Omnea the place ambitious early-career sellers want to start.

 - You'll learn fast. You'll sit alongside senior GTM leaders and an experienced talent team, calibrating on what "great" looks like and building the judgement to grow into a full-cycle recruiter.




ABOUT YOU

 - You've got 3–5 years in recruiting, sourcing, sales development or another target-driven role, ideally at a high-growth startup or agency. Experience hiring SDRs, BDRs or early-career GTM talent is a strong plus, but we care more about how you work than where you've been.

 - You're relentless and you love the hunt. You get energy from finding the one great person in a sea of profiles, and you'll make the extra call, send the extra message and go to the extra event to get there.

 - You're scrappy. You don't wait for inbound. You find creative ways to reach people, and you've built or hustled something yourself, whether that's a side project, a club, a team or a career pivot.

 - You can spot talent. You're curious about people, you read them well, and you can tell the difference between polish and real drive. You probe for specific moments, not adjectives.

 - You're a clear, persuasive communicator. You write outreach people actually reply to, and you can sell a hard, high-upside role honestly and with energy.

 - You're organised and you nail the basics. You manage a high-volume pipeline without dropping a ball, keep the ATS clean, and leverage AI throughout your process.

 - You're coachable and hungry to grow. You seek feedback, act on it quickly, and want to become a world-class recruiter.

 - And you're simply a great human. You're collaborative, kind, low-ego. You want to win, but not at others' expense.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.




A FEW THINGS TO NOTE: 

 - We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here https://www.notion.so/omnea/UK-Benefits-at-Omnea-36c88cce658781c39d08ee947693506f and our US Benefits Package here https://www.notion.so/omnea/US-Benefits-at-Omnea-36c88cce658781b49890e725794c0af1. 

 - We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here https://www.omnea.co/documents/why-omnea-is-not-fully-remote

 - We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here https://www.omnea.co/careers and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here https://news.crunchbase.com/startups/omnea-funding-employees-future-founders-freeman/!

If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer / Machine Designer
jobs.description:
About the role

Are you a skilled technician? At Thermopatch B.V., we are opening a brand-new, unique position for a serious and meticulous mechatronics professional who wants to own the production process from start to finish.

In this role, you won't just be a cog in a machine - you will be the one building them. You will bridge the gap between fine-tuned electronics and robust mechanical assembly. You will take loose components and turn them into fully operational, high-quality heat seal machines. If you have a passion for technology, a steady hand for precise soldering, and the flexibility to pivot from programming to light logistics, this role offers the ultimate technical variety.

Key responsibilities

• End-to-End Machine Assembly: Build our signature heat seal machines completely from scratch, seamlessly integrating both mechanical and electronic components.
• Testing & Calibration: Run comprehensive diagnostic testing and calibrate the finished devices to ensure they meet our strict performance standards before shipment.
• PCB Manufacturing & Finishing: Perform precise component-level work on printed circuit boards (PCBs), including soldering switches and displays, programming, and fine calibration.
• Spare Parts Production: Manufacture high-quality spare parts to support our customers, such as precisely fitting connectors to heating elements.
• Logistics Collaboration: Maintain a smooth workflow by handling light warehouse duties, which include collecting manufactured products and preparing them for the logistics department.

Qualifications

• Proximity: Currently residing in the Netherlands, in or within a reliable commuting distance of Almere (absolute must).
• Technical Aptitude: Strong mechanical insight and a genuine curiosity about how things work. A background in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a similar field is preferred.
• Soldering Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience with PCB soldering, specifically with delicate components like switches and displays.
• SolidWorks experience is highly desirable
• Meticulous Mindset: A serious, accurate approach to your craft. You are someone who takes pride in the details and ensures every calibration is perfect.
• All-Round Flexibility: An autonomous worker who thrives on variety and is equally happy programming a circuit board, building a machine frame, or helping out in the warehouse.

What We Offer

Here's a glimpse of the great benefits you can expect:

• Financial & Health Benefits: Benefit from our Pension Fund.
• Time Off & Flexibility: Enjoy Birth/Parental leave in accordance with Dutch labor law.
• Continuous Development: We invest in your growth with Individual Development Plans, regular Development Discussions, and customized training programs tailored to your needs.
• On-Site Perks: Take advantage of free parking and a commuting allowance (80km per day by car) /public transport reimbursement.
• Community Engagement: Opportunities to participate in volunteer activities to support Non-Profit Organizations.

Why join Avery Dennison

We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. As a science and innovation company, we believe that diverse teams are stronger teams. We are committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and courage, where you can grow your career with a company that has innovation in its DNA. Founded on creating real-world impact to enable a better future, we strive to provide an open, collaborative culture where diversity of thought is encouraged and respected. Hear from our employees about what it's like working at Avery Dennison. Learn more at www.averydennison.com.

Equal Opportunity Employer
