All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected status. If you are unable to use our online application process due to a disability, please contact us to request an accommodation at Requestaccomodation@eu.averydennison.com. In the EMEA region, we foster an inclusive culture through active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) like Elevate, Unite, and our Mental Health group. Please visit our DE&I page to learn more about our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach.

jobs.title: Deep Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
YOUR NEXT MISSION

Train the intelligence behind our radars – turning complex signal data into instant, real-world detection.

As our Deep Learning Engineer, you develop, optimize, and deploy neural networks that enhance real-time radar performance. You work side-by-side with AI, Software Engineering, Hardware, and Product Management colleagues – translating abstract radar signal modalities into models that spot small airborne objects in noisy environments. You report to the Team Lead AI, and your models directly safeguard critical sites around the globe.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Model design and architecture: Design, train, and optimize deep learning models for detection, segmentation, and classification. Tailor neural networks to process abstract, non-natural 3D, 4D, and 5D radar imagery.

 - Target classification and tracking: Build advanced neural network architectures to detect and track small objects like birds and drones. Ensure models perform reliably despite real-world background noise and weather.

 - Data engineering and automation: Prepare, preprocess, and augment large-scale radar datasets for training pipelines. Implement automated labeling strategies to streamline data preparation at scale.

 - Edge optimization and deployment: Optimize trained neural networks for high-performance inference on edge computing hardware. Collaborate with Software Developers and Radar Specialists to integrate models seamlessly into production systems.

 - Research and field validation: Evaluate emerging deep learning techniques to continuously lift our radar capabilities. Test model robustness under diverse field conditions and document design choices clearly.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - MSc in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field

 - 2-4 years of experience in Deep Learning, specifically within Computer Vision

 - Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience using PyTorch

 - Practical experience with edge deployment and model optimization tools like TensorRT or ONNX

 - Familiarity with non-natural signal modalities such as radar, sonar, LiDAR, or medical imaging

 - Fluent English, both written and spoken

 - A proactive mindset and strong problem-solving skills in a collaborative environment


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

 - Comprehensive pension plan;

 - Commuting allowance;

 - 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

 - Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

 - High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role;

 - An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks!

Robin Radar is a defence technology leader in detecting, tracking and classifying drones and other small airborne objects. Our radars and software protect military sites, borders and critical infrastructure from drone threats, and also help prevent bird strikes in aviation and reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife. Our work shows up at defence and security sites, airports and wind farms around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning?

You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat.

jobs.title: Risk Specialist

jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Crypto Risk team's mission is to identify, assess, and mitigate risk across Robinhood Crypto's products, operations, and platforms, protecting customers and the firm as the business scales. We work to deliver an excellent end-customer experience while upholding the safety and soundness of the business, so Robinhood can keep expanding access to crypto responsibly. The team partners with engineering, product, compliance, crypto operations, and enterprise risk to keep a consistent view of risk across the organization. It's an exciting time to join as we launch new products and expand our crypto offering!

As a Risk Specialist, you will support the execution of our crypto risk management program, partnering closely with Crypto Risk leadership to monitor, assess, and report on risk across the business. You will play a hands-on role in building and running operational risk management, with a particular focus on technical and product risk. Day to day, you will assess new products and business changes for risk, run risk and control self-assessments, and prepare reporting for governance forums. You will translate technical risks into clear terms for colleagues outside engineering and work closely with partner teams across the business. Your work will help us keep pace with new launches while protecting customers and the firm!

This role is based in our New York, NY and Menlo Park, CA offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

• Facilitate Technical Risk Assessments (TRAs) and product risk assessments for new and existing crypto products, features, and business changes: document and assess risks and controls in collaboration with engineering and product owners.

• Analyze incident and issue data to identify recurring root causes, control weaknesses and systemic themes; lead or support retrospectives on material events and translate findings into actionable risk insights for leadership.

• Mature the operational loss tracking process, including loss definitions, intake, taxonomy, linkage to incidents and issues, and trend reporting.

• Manage the issue management lifecycle, from identification and prioritization through remediation tracking and closure, ensuring issues are handled and escalated appropriately.

• Perform and refresh Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs) and support Business Impact Analyses.

• Monitor, refine and develop key risk indicators (KRIs), and prepare risk reporting for governance forums, including risk committee and board materials and escalations.Translate technical risks into clear, actionable terms for non-engineering stakeholders.

• Translate technical risks into clear, actionable terms for non-engineering partners.

• Partner with engineering, product, compliance, crypto operations, and enterprise risk teams to maintain a consistent view of risk across the organization.

What you bring

• 5+ years of experience in operational risk, enterprise risk management, or technology risk at a regulated financial services or crypto/fintech firm. (US-based ERM experience is preferred).

• Hands-on experience facilitating risk assessments (RCSA, technology or product risk assessments, process risk assessments), including working directly with business, product and engineering owners.

• Experience designing, running or materially contributing to business continuity or disaster recovery exercises, including scenario design, facilitation and after action reporting.

• Experience performing root cause analysis or thematic analysis across incidents, with the ability to identify patterns and systemic issues from operational data.

• Deep understanding of risk management methodologies, including risk taxonomies, control design, KRIs and issue management.

• Technical exposure and comfort working in a technical environment, with the ability to read engineering design documents and incident post mortems and extract the risk. A software engineering background is not required.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical colleagues and present risk findings to stakeholders across the organization.

• Detail oriented, with a proactive, independent approach to identifying and addressing risk.

Bonus points

• Direct experience in the cryptocurrency industry, with familiarity with crypto products, custody, and blockchain fundamentals.

• A computer science or engineering degree, especially if you have built a career in risk, compliance, or another non-engineering role.

• Experience building or operating an operational loss event program

• Exposure to third party and vendor risk management, particularly for critical technology or custody providers.

• Familiarity with operational resilience regulatory expectations such as NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500, DORA or MiCA.

• Experience with governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) tools such as LogicGate or similar platforms.

• Analytical background with knowledge of SQL, Python, or a BI tool.

What we offer

• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.

• Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.

• Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.

• Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.

• Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.

• Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

• Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

jobs.title: Vice President, Product and Solutions Engineering
jobs.description:
About Zeta:
Zeta is a globally recognized next-gen banking technology company. Our modern platforms enable financial institutions and fintechs to launch extensible and compliant banking asset and liability products spanning cards, loans, and deposits. Our cloud-native and fully API-enabled stack supports processing, issuing, lending, core banking, fraud, loyalty, digital banking, and agentic AI solutions amongst many other capabilities. 
Zeta has 1700+ employees with over 70% in technology roles across locations in the US, Middle East, and Asia - representing one of the largest and most capable teams ever assembled in banking tech. Globally, customers have issued 30M+ cards on Zeta's platform expected to grow to 60M+ in the coming years. Most recently valued at $2B, Zeta counts Softbank, Mastercard, and Optum amongst its investors. 
 
About the Role 
Zeta solves hard problems for financial institutions. We assemble solutions from our processing, issuing, payments, lending, core, and digital banking platforms to answer a problem an institution could not solve with what it already owns. 
Every processor now says modern, API-first, and cloud-native, so the words no longer separate vendors. Buyers compare proof, and each alternative asks them to accept a compromise: a provider too old to move fast, one too new to trust with credit, or a program that is never really theirs. 
This role joins two jobs that are usually split. The first is product: deciding which solutions go to banks, sponsor banks, and fintechs, how they are packaged and priced, and what gets built next. The second is solutions engineering: discovery, target architecture, proofs, and defending the design through architecture, security, and procurement review. 
You hold both jobs with equal weight: product owner for a defined portfolio of solutions, and the person who proves them in the room. You own the strategy for your solutions and the case for what the platform builds next, and you keep every deal from becoming a custom build. This is a hands-on, 0 to 1 role with no team at the start but requires mentoring and working teams of engineers and product managers.

• Actualización y mantenimiento de los planos de las redes de agua potable y alcantarillado en entornos GIS.
• Elaboración de diversos informes a partir de la informació GIS.
• Realización de planos para memorias valoradas y proyectos.
• Gestión de los servicios afectados.
• Formación a los operarios enel uso de las herramientas de gestión GIS.
• Soporte al departamento de Oficina Técnica.

• ArcMap d’Esri.
• QGIS.
• AutoCAD.
• Microsoft Office

• Grados universitarios: Geografía y Ordenación del Territorio, Ciencias Ambientales, Ingeniería en Geomática y Topográfica, Ingeniería Civil, Biología, Geofísica o Arquitectura.

jobs.title: Clinical Marketing Manager Portugal
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:

This position implements and executes marketing programs for the assigned territory and drive adoption and growth of da VinciÒ surgical procedures. The focus is in strategic growth areas for General Surgery, Urology, Gynecology and Thoracic Surgery with potential further expansion towards other clinical indications. The Marketing Manager is also expected to work with cross-functional sales and training teams, working closely with the Regional & European marketing group.

The primary function of this position is to be able to execute on the following global marketing standards at a local level:

• Understand the market – Open/MIS rate, National outcomes, surgeon/patient/hospital segments, reimbursement levels, incumbent surgical techniques and KOLs etc.
• Clinical Expertise – Knowledge of the OR environment and clinical applications of robotic surgery
• Develop Speaker/Teacher /Executive KOLs – with strong technique, outcomes, and use of advanced technology.
• Quantify the impact (QTI) – clinical, economic, strategic evidence - of key da Vinci surgeons/hospitals as references.
• Align with relevant Surgical and Executive societies on da Vinci surgery to ensure support and partnership.

The Marketing Manager works closely with regional Clinical and Capital team, EU Marketing as well Ecosystem functions, contributing to the regional marketing Strategy.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Understand your market

• Develop and execute marketing tactics with a focus on General Surgery, Urology, Gynecology and Thoracic Surgery. This includes detailed activities to be implemented in a defined timeline and budget alignment with Director Marketing Iberia and Event organization team, strong collaboration with the European marketing team and local sales leadership.
• Strong partnering with clinical and capital sales teams in a growing competitive environment for analysis, targeting and action planning purposes.

Technical and Clinical Expertise

• Demonstrated strong knowledge of the technologies included Intuitive's product portfolio.
• Solid clinical knowledge related to various applications and approaches relevant to our products.

Build Value Props Stories, Tools, Events and Engage 3Ps

• Deliver corporate clinical & capital marketing and sales tools to achieve short and long-term goals for procedures /sales quotas, products, and system sales.

Develop Speaker/Teacher/ CaseObs / Executive KOLs

• Partner with key surgeon champions (KOLs) to develop and implement leading robotic clinical education programs and symposia to drive competency and utilization of da VinciÒ Surgery.
• Develop proctors based on surgical, clinical, and teaching expertise to implement safe and effective reproducible surgical techniques with improve clinical outcomes.

Quantify the impact (QTI) – clinical, economic, strategic evidence

• Work closely with Market Access Manager team to assist in development and execution of cost effectiveness/ value strategies in key markets.
• Collect, analyze, and share competitive data for strategic positioning and initiatives.
• Validate Clinical and Economical data with reference case observation center, key surgeon champions (KOLs) and proctors.

Align with relevant Surgical and Executive societies

• Develop and implement Intuitive’s presence at key national conferences, including robotics symposia, postgraduate (PG) courses, live surgical broadcasts, tradeshow booth promotion and presence.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

• University's degree in life science or business discipline.
• Minimum 5 years of related experience or equivalent including Clinical/Product marketing experience in a therapeutic medical device company.
• General Surgery, Urology, Gynecology or Thoracic experience preferred.
• Strong Clinical, Surgical and/or Operating Theatre (Room) experience desired.
• Proven ability to effectively position and procedure/product messages and develop strong sales support to drive desired adoption.
• Demonstrated success in building and delivering clinical education and marketing programs to drive product/procedure growth.
• Proven success integrating business insights into broad Marketing strategies and plans
• Experienced managing departmental and cross-functional projects in the medical device or related industry.
• A keen ability to manage projects, keeping budget, organizing, prioritizing, and coping with multiple tasks.
• Proven ability to influence peers, build credibility with a highly educated customer base.
• Excellent verbal/written communication, teamwork, and interpersonal work across multiple constituents.
• Strong knowledge of the MS Office product suite.
• Fluent in Portuguese & English (Spanish is a plus).
• Ability to travel 50% (Domestic, international).
• The role will be based in Madrid with office days on Tue, Wed & Thu.

We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

jobs.description:

As a member of the Spanish & Portugal Marketing team, the primary functions of the Product Portfolio & Digital Marketing Manager role are to lead on the development, implementation and execution of marketing strategies and tactics for the Product and Digital portfolios. The product portfolio will include da Vinci systems, Advanced Technologies, Instruments and Accessories and Digital Solutions including Intuitive Hub, My Intuitive and SIMNOW.

You will be responsible for developing value messaging, KOL development and scaling the success of existing and newly launched products while accelerating the adoption of Intuitive’s product and digital portfolios across Iberia. This position will work collaboratively with Iberia and EU marketing, sales and ecosystem functions to drive utilization in targeted procedures for both portfolios.

You will have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills that will drive a collaborative and adaptable approach across business functions to execute on the commercial strategies.

• Integrate the digital portfolio into the commercial teams, to drive awareness and adoption of the entire Intuitive Ecosystem in alignment with business goals.
• Engage key customers to create and develop reference centers to accelerate technology adoption and utilization of da Vinci systems, Advanced Technologies and Digital solutions.
• Create clinical and economic reference stories (QTIs) and marketing collateral that articulates the value proposition associated with Intuitive’s technologies.

• Partner with European and Regional Marketing and Sales at conferences and tradeshows, Executive Education Events, Market Development Events, and Key Customer events, to deliver impactful product demonstrations (test-drives), technology presentations, and ensure the key product messaging is included in Intuitive-sponsored presentations and customer interactions.

jobs.title: Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer - Automation
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Sr. Staff Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role in Mohali, reporting to the Director, Software Development Engineering in the Engineering department. This unique and challenging position bridges software design engineering and test engineering to design, develop, and deploy wide-reaching tools and frameworks that automatically verify product quality at scale.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Own end-to-end System Integration Testing (SIT) and quality outcomes for key platform areas including UI, APIs, services, and data workflows

• Design and deliver effective, automatable test plans with strong coverage for functional, regression, and system integration scenarios

• Build and maintain UI and API automation using modern frameworks to ensure stability, maintainability, and fast feedback

• Validate large-scale systems including REST APIs, backend services, distributed workflows, and microservices

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

• You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

• You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

• You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

• You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• Advanced proficiency in automation testing using Python (pytest/unittest), JavaScript, or TypeScript

• Hands-on experience with UI automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright for end-to-end validation

• Deep experience testing distributed systems, microservices, and scalable cloud-native multi-tenant architectures in AWS, GCP, or Azure environments

• Solid understanding of CI/CD integration, Linux troubleshooting, and containerized environments including Docker and Kubernetes

• Technical knowledge of L2/L3 networking concepts, including routing protocols, VPN, IPSec, and WAN architecture

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Proven experience designing scalable test frameworks covering architecture, patterns, reporting, stability, and parallelization Proficiency with Git, test management tools like TestRail, and issue tracking systems such as Jira

• Hands-on experience with AI agent prompting and usage for productivity, test design, and automation support

jobs.title: Systems Engineer, WARP
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Lisbon, Portugal

About the role

• As a Systems engineer in the WARP team you will join a team that works on the backend system that allows our customers to manage their devices via our Zero Trust Network solution. In this role, you will work on the design, capacity planning, development, maintenance and enhancement of features that make our WARP and Zero Trust product, such as Device Posture, Orchestration and Notification. We are looking for engineers that are versatile and eager to contribute to the technical direction of the product, with a focus on growth, scalability and high-availability. You will collaborate with your team on the planning, priority, deadlines and deliverables of solutions to our customers requirements. Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience Experience managing high available systems with disaster recovery support. Experience in at least of the following languages: Go, Rust Experience in Typescript Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs at scale Knowledge of SQL and common relational database systems such as PostgreSQL and MySQL Knowledge on distributed NoSQL databases Excellent debugging experience and optimization skills Experience with Kubernetes Responsibilities Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance large scale software solutions. Own features end-to-end and contribute to the team projects and objectives Collaborate with a distributed team of engineers through code reviews, design discussions and knowledge sharing. Contribute to the team roadmap by identifying engineering opportunities and improvements for the success of the team and product. Collaborate with other Zero Trust teams on goals, outcomes, and timelines. Help the team meet project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables.

Compensation

• For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €54,000 - €75,000.

Equity

• This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: Ops Associate
jobs.description:
A LITTLE ABOUT US

incident.io http://incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.




THE ROLE IN ONE LINE

We're looking for ridiculously smart, ambitious grads who want to break into the startup world. No experience needed. Just serious drive, great instincts, and an appetite to build something big.




WHAT THAT LOOKS LIKE DAY TO DAY

If you want to get into startups, this is your foot in the door.

This role sits under our Talent team in SF, working closely with our founders and leaders to find the insane people who will help us build incident.io http://incident.io.

Talent is one of the few roles where you get to work across the entire business. You'll get a front-row seat to how a startup scales, and help us build one of the best teams in the world.

We're growing fast in SF, and we need to find insane talent to make it happen.

We're not a team that posts jobs and waits for applications. We're out hunting for exceptional people, building relationships, throwing events, dreaming up crazy campaigns, and finding creative ways to get incident.io http://incident.io on the map.

You'll have loads of ownership from day one, learn from some of the smartest people around, and get exposure to pretty much every part of building a company.

And where you take it from there is up to you. Talent is an incredible platform for a career in startups, whether you want to become a world-class recruiter, move into another part of the business, or eventually build something of your own.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You're ridiculously driven. You've got big ambitions, you work hard, and you're willing to do what it takes to get there.

 - You're a builder. You've started things, created things, made things happen. Maybe that's a business, a side project, a university society, or something completely different.

 - You're seriously smart. You learn fast, ask great questions, and figure things out quickly.

 - You make things happen. You don't need someone telling you what to do. You're resourceful, proactive, and find a way to get things done.

 - You're great with people. You're confident, curious, and can build relationships with just about anyone.

 - You've got big ideas. You're creative, think differently, and love trying things nobody else has thought of.

We don't care what you studied or whether you've ever worked in startups. We're looking for people with exceptional potential.

Maybe you've built an app, started a business, organised an event, or done something completely unrelated that shows you've got serious drive.

If you're hungry, ambitious, and want to throw yourself into the startup world, we want to hear from you.




SUPPORTING YOU

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

 - Market-leading private medical insurance. The proper kind, so you're never weighing up your health against a bill.

 - Competitive PTO. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

 - First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

 - Enhanced 401k. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

 - Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

 - Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

 - Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

 - Two budgets that have your back. $1000 to invest in your setup, $500 a year to invest in yourself.

jobs.title: Store Manager (Pančevo)
jobs.description:
ŠTA ĆEŠ RADITI

Kao Store Manager, nadgledaćeš čitavo iskustvo kupaca, obezbeđujući visoke vizuelne i komercijalne standarde koji su u skladu sa globalnim strategijama i kontekstom tvoje lokalne prodavnice. Postupajući u skladu sa našim vrednostima, doprinosićeš i svom, kao i kompanijskom uspehu.

Takođe ćeš:

• Voditi svoj tim u prodavnici, kako biste zajedno ostvarili izvanredno iskustvo kupaca, dok promovišete i prodajete naše artikle.
• Biti u toku sa prednostima i prilikama za razvoj svoje prodavnice, kao i ponudom konkurenata, uz snažno razumevanje lokalnog tržišta i potreba kupaca.
• Analizirati prodajne performanse, postavljati ciljeve i praviti planove za poboljšanje rezultata, profita i nivoa zaliha.
• Efikasno upravljati rasporedima i održavanjem prodavnice, u skladu sa prodajnim budžetom i komercijalnim prioritetima.
• Zapošljavati, obezbeđivati obuku i razvoj svog tima, negujući inkluzivnu kulturu punu saradnje koja promoviše razvoj i inovaciju.
• Biti u toku sa modnim trendovima, preferencama kupaca, kao i ponudom konkurentnih brendovima, kako bi se održala konkurentska prednost.
• Predstavljati sebe i brend na pozitivan način tokom svake interakcije sa kupcima.
• Obezbeđivati ukupno OMNI iskustvo kupaca, promovišući aktivno naš program lojalnosti.

SA KIM ĆEŠ RADITI

Naše prodavnice su srce naše kompanije, gde naši kupci imaju direktan dodir sa našim brendom. Kao deo dinamičnog tima u prodavnici, svaka uloga – od prodajnih savetnika, menadžera odeljenja, menadžera prodavnice i aranžera, do glavnog blagajnika — doprinosi stvaranju inspirativnog okruženja punog dobrodošlice.  Takođe ćeš sarađivati sa širim timom područja, kao i između prodavnica, kako biste delili iskustva i podsticali uspeh zajedno. Zajedno sa svojim timom, imaćeš ključnu ulogu u pružanju pomoći kupcima da se osećaju samouvereno i ističu svoju individualnost uz najnovije trendove i beskrajne stilske mogućnosti. Gradeći značajne veze sa kupcima u našim prodavnicama, mi modu činimo dostupnom i održivom za sve.

KO SI TI

Tražimo osobe sa…

• Iskustvom u prodajnom menadžmentu i operativnosti.
• Dokazanim snažnim liderstvom, sa strašću prema podučavanju i razvoju timova, ilustrujući kompanijske vrednosti i kulturu.
• Dokazanim rezultatima u korišćenju alata orijentisanim prema kupcima i izveštavanju.
• Ekspertizom u planiranju prodaje, analiziranju i praćenju.

I osobe koje su…

• Snažni i samouvereni lideri, koji inspirišu, podučavaju i razvijaju svoje timove sa integritetom.
• Motivisani da stvaraju odlično iskustvo kupaca, dok promovišu i prodaju naše atikle.
• Ambiciozni i motivisani performansom i postizanjem ciljeva.
• Analitični, usmereni ka rešavanju problema, sa odličnim veštinama u komunikaciji i smislom za rad sa brojevima i statistikom.
• Fleksibilni i orijentisani prema rešenjima.
• Strastveni kada je reč o modnim trendovima, komercijalnosti i vizuelnoj prezentaciji, sa snažnom svešću o konkurentima.
• Dobro poznavanje engleskog jezika smatraće se prednošću.

KO SMO MI

H&M Grupa je globalna kompanija snažnih modnih brendova i poduhvata. Naš cilj je da dokažemo da ne postoji kompromis između odličnog dizajna, pristupačnih cena i održivih rešenja. Želimo da oslobodimo modu za sve, a naši kupci su srce svake odluke koju donosimo.

Naš tim čine hiljade posvećenih i talentovanih kolega, koje su ujedinjene našom kulturom i vrednostima. Zajedno, želimo da koristimo našu moć, našu veličinu i znanje da usmerimo modnu industriju kao inkluzivnijoj i održivijoj budućnosti.

ZAŠTO ĆEŠ OBOŽAVATI DA RADIŠ OVDE

U H&M Grupi, ponosni smo na to što smo energična kompanija puna dobrodošlice. Našim zaposlenima nudimo atraktivne benefite i beskrajne mogućnosti za razvoj širom sveta.

• 10 popusta za zaposlene u svim brendovima H&M grupe, u prodavnicama i onlajn (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories i ARKET).​
• H&M Incentive Program (podsticajni proram) – HIP. Više o programu saznaj ovde.​
• Privatno zdravstveno osiguranje
• Dodatni dani godišnjeg odmora na ukupan staž
• Bonus za perporuku prijatelja u iznosu do 120 evra u dinarskoj protivvrednosti
• Online i uživo treninzi za zaposlene u cilju učenja i razvoja
• Mogućnost napredovanja i razvoja u okviru kompanije
• Poklon kartica za rođenje deteta
• Nagrada za dugogodišnji rad
• Novogodišnji pokloni za decu zaposlenih

PRIDRUŽI NAM SE

Naša jedinstvenost potiče iz kombinacije mnogo stvari – naše kulture pune inkluzije i saradnje, naših snažnih vrednosti i mogućnosti za razvoj; ali najviše iz ljudi koji nas čine onim što jesmo.

Neka tvoj sledeći korak u karijeri bude sa nama. Putovanje počinje ovde.

​*Posvećeni smo procesu zapošljavanja koji je pošten, zasnovan na jednakosti i kompetencijama. Zbog toga te molimo da u svojoj prijavi ne šalješ motivaciono pismo.

jobs.title: Helix, Vice President, Technical Lead – AI Infrastructure
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

Helix is KKR's newly established investment platform focused on building the integrated infrastructure that powers the digital economy including data centers, fiber networks, wireless infrastructure, and power generation assets. This new confidential company will be led Adam Selipsky. The organization is supported by a bench of operators, advisors, and KKR resources, creating a world class team spanning power, compute, connectivity, and applications. Together, the team combines hyperscale execution experience with KKR’s global operating and governance backbone. This is an investment under KKR's infrastructure strategy. KKR established its global infrastructure strategy in 2008 and has since been one of the most active private infrastructure investors globally across a broad range of critical infrastructure assets. With a team of more than 115 dedicated investment professionals possessing an unrivaled track record, the strategy currently oversees approximately $60 billion AUM globally across Core, Energy, and Climate investments.

ROLE SUMMARY

Helix is seeking a Vice President, Technical Lead to serve as the in-house technical authority on AI infrastructure across the full stack: electrical, mechanical and rack-level. The role is also the primary technical interface with hyperscaler, chip and supply chain counterparties. Investing in AI infrastructure increasingly requires judgment on questions that are genuinely technical, not just financial. These include power density and cooling architecture choices, rack-level design trends driven by next-generation silicon, and how quickly today's design assumptions will become obsolete. The role must also look forward and advise on where the platform should build, partner or acquire capability, such as supply chain positioning or manufacturing integration. The aim is to compound Helix's advantage rather than simply underwrite today's assets. Its value lies in judgment and external credibility. The successful candidate will be treated as a peer in a hyperscaler's or chip vendor's design review. They will also have the pattern recognition to tell which technical trends are durable and which are faddish. That requires someone who has already operated at a senior level inside a leading technical organization.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own end-to-end technical diligence on data center investments, from initial screening through to investment committee

• Assess the technical fit and capability of vendors across the supply chain

• Evaluate power, cooling and rack-level design assumptions, and how well they will hold up as silicon and workload requirements change

• Act as the technical counterpart to hyperscaler engineering and design teams, and to chip vendors (NVIDIA, AMD, etc.), on next-generation data center solutions

• Build and maintain senior relationships across the ecosystem so that Helix has early visibility into design and technology shifts

• Evaluate and advise on productization and scaling strategy, identifying where supply chain investment or manufacturing integration creates a durable edge

• Bring product and innovation experience to identify and anticipate new operating models and designs

QUALIFICATIONS

• Senior design or engineering leadership at a hyperscaler or large-scale data center operator (infrastructure, facilities or systems design organization), or senior technical leadership at a neocloud

• Demonstrated experience translating technical roadmaps into business and product decisions, not purely an engineering execution background

• Deep working knowledge of data center electrical and mechanical systems, cooling architecture and rack-level design

• Credibility with senior technical counterparts, with the ability to engage as a peer in design reviews

• Strong judgment in separating durable trends from short-lived ones

• Clear communicator who can explain complex technical trade-offs to investment professionals and decision-makers

• Collaborative, and comfortable working across investment, operating and external advisory teams

This is the expected annual base salary range for this New York-based position. Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, and qualification for the role. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, based on factors such as individual and team performance.

Base Salary Range

$300,000—$400,000 USD

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the EVP of Operations - Hybrid
jobs.description:
Role Overview
The Executive Assistant to the EVP of Operations provides administrative and operational coordination support to help the EVP manage priorities, stay informed, and drive timely execution across the Operations team.
This role goes beyond calendar management. The assistant organizes information, prepares meeting materials, tracks commitments, and follows up with stakeholders to ensure operational priorities move forward. The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, discreet, and comfortable working with senior leaders in a fast-paced environment.
Key Responsibilities
Executive and Administrative Support
Manage the EVP’s calendar, appointments, and meeting schedules, prioritizing requests based on business needs.
Prepare daily and weekly briefings covering upcoming meetings, deadlines, pending decisions, and outstanding commitments.
Draft correspondence, presentations, reports, and other materials on behalf of the EVP.
Coordinate travel arrangements, itineraries, and expense documentation as needed.
Handle confidential business, employee, and client information with discretion.
Meeting Management and Follow-Through
Prepare agendas and collect relevant updates and supporting materials before meetings.
Document key discussions, decisions, action items, owners, and deadlines.
Maintain a centralized action tracker and follow up with stakeholders on outstanding commitments.
Flag overdue items, unresolved issues, and decisions requiring the EVP’s attention.
Coordinate leadership meetings, operational reviews, and planning sessions.
Operational Coordination and Reporting
Collect and consolidate updates from Operations leaders, TA Team Leads,  into clear, timely summaries.
Support the preparation of performance dashboards, KPI reports, and business review materials.
Check submitted reports for completeness and consistency, coordinating corrections with the relevant owners.
Track milestones, dependencies, and deliverables for initiatives sponsored by the EVP.
Surface potential delays and execution gaps early, with relevant context for review.
Stakeholder Communication
Serve as a coordination point between the EVP and internal stakeholders.
Communicate the EVP’s approved instructions, priorities, and decisions accurately.
Route requests to the appropriate owners and follow up until a response or resolution is received.
Maintain professional working relationships across departments to support timely collaboration.
Documentation and Process Improvement
Organize files, meeting records, reports, and operational documentation for easy access.
Maintain templates and trackers that improve consistency and reduce administrative work.
Identify opportunities to improve scheduling, reporting, communication, and follow-up processes.
Support special projects and other assignments aligned with the EVP’s priorities.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
About Brandlight
Brandlight is the leading enterprise AI visibility platform, built to help the world’s leading brands understand, manage, and optimize how they appear across AI-driven search, commerce, and advertising. As AI rapidly becomes a trillion-dollar marketing and distribution channel, Brandlight is defining the systems that decide what brands are surfaced, trusted, and chosen.
Join our team and help build the next generation of tools shaping the future of brand management in an AI-first world.

About the Role
We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer who combines strong product thinking with excellent visual craft and uses AI tools regularly throughout their work.
You’ll turn ambiguous problems and early ideas into clear, polished product experiences. Working closely with Product and Engineering, you’ll help shape what we build and own your work from exploration through launch and iteration.

This is a hands-on role with high autonomy. You should be comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, moving quickly, and using AI tools to build realistic prototypes with components from our design system’s GitHub repository.

Responsibilities

 - Translate customer needs and business goals into intuitive product experiences

 - Design complex, data-rich interfaces with clear hierarchy, thoughtful interactions, and attention to edge cases

 - Help define problems, challenge assumptions, and make informed product decisions

 - Partner closely with Product and Engineering to ship practical, high-quality solutions

 - Use customer feedback and product data to evaluate and improve what ships

 - Work with our design system in Figma and GitHub, reusing existing components and identifying gaps

 - Use AI tools regularly to explore ideas, build prototypes, and accelerate iteration

 - Communicate your thinking clearly and give and receive constructive feedback



Requirements

 - 7+ years of product design experience, including work in startup or high-growth environments

 - A portfolio showing shipped products, strong product thinking, and polished execution across complex interfaces

 - Strong typography, layout, and interaction design skills

 - Regular, hands-on use of AI tools in your design workflow, with examples of how they improve your work

 - Experience working with design systems maintained in GitHub repositories, including finding components, understanding their usage, and applying them in prototypes

 - Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and turn early ideas into buildable solutions

 - A collaborative approach, curiosity, and willingness to adapt as you learn



Why Join Us?
At Brandlight, you’ll build and shape a new category at the intersection of AI, marketing, and commerce.
We’re a fast-growing startup led by repeat entrepreneurs, world-class engineers, and marketing leaders, all driven to reinvent how brands are built, discovered, and chosen in the age of AI.

About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

• Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.

• Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.

• Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.

• Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.

• Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.

• Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.

• Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.

• Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit.

Want to learn more? Read and listen:

We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take.

About the role

The Field Officer - Internal Audit will play a critical day-to-day role in ensuring that GiveDirectly is able to deliver cash transfers to recipients safely. The Field Officer - Internal Audit will be part of the team that is responsible for preventing, detecting, mitigating and investigating field-based risks for GiveDirectly.

The role will reward high-quality judgment on operational questions and challenges, work ethic, communication skills, and a strong commitment to GiveDirectly’s mission and model. In brief The Field Officer - Internal Audit will be expected to audit the work of the enrolment team, whose core responsibility is surveying households and enrolling them in our programs.

jobs.title: Build Engineer
jobs.description:
About Etched

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.


Job Summary

Etched is building a new category of AI hardware: frontier inference clusters. To bring them up at the pace this market demands, we build and integrate our own server racks in-house, and that work is growing fast as we move from early builds into NPI and production.



As a Build Engineer, you'll own our internal builds end to end. Think of the role as an operations program manager for internal builds who is also a hands-on engineer: you'll plan each build, get the parts, tools, and people in place, run it on the floor, and fix whatever slows it down. You'll work closely with our mechanical, electrical, thermal, test, inventory, and lab operations teams, and the processes you set up will become how Etched builds hardware as volume ramps.



Key Responsibilities

 - Own internal rack and subassembly builds from kickoff to delivery, including schedule, material readiness, staffing, and on-time completion

 - Run clear-to-build checks against the BOM and work with inventory and supply chain to close shortages before they stop a build

 - Write and maintain build procedures, work instructions, and travelers, and manage the transition of assemblies from development builds to production

 - Review CAD models and drawings with design engineers to flag manufacturability, assembly, and serviceability issues early

 - Design or specify the fixtures, tooling, and build stations the team needs

 - Integrate mechanical, thermal, power, and electrical subsystems into full rack assemblies, and develop and run the test procedures that go with them

 - Lead build technicians on the floor and be the first engineer on the problem when a build hits an issue

 - Question requirements, remove unnecessary parts and steps, and simplify the build flow to cut cycle time

 - Track build status, risks, and blockers, and give leadership a clear read on what will ship and when

 - Turn lessons from each build into the processes and documentation we'll use as we scale into NPI and higher-volume production



You may be a good fit if you have (Must-have qualifications)

 - A bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, or aerospace engineering, physics, or equivalent hands-on experience

 - Hands-on experience building hardware

 - A track record of owning a build or hardware program end to end and delivering it on time

 - Working knowledge of manufacturing and assembly processes, reading drawings, and GD&T

 - Comfort working on the floor alongside technicians, and clear communication with technicians, engineers, and leadership

 - The ability to move fast with incomplete information and stay calm when a build goes wrong



Strong candidates may also have experience with (Nice-to-have qualifications)

 - Server, rack, data center, or other electronics hardware integration

 - Building hardware at a high-rate company in aerospace, automotive, or consumer electronics

 - Designing fixtures and tooling in CAD

 - PLM, MES, or ERP systems such as Teamcenter

 - Scaling a build from prototype to volume production

 - Python, Excel, or other scripting for build tracking and analysis




Benefits

 - Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage
   
   - $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits

 - Housing subsidy of $2,500 per month for those living within walking distance of the office

 - Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)

 - Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more

 - Daily lunch and dinner in our office

 - Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification



How we’re different

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson http://www.incompleteideas.net/IncIdeas/BitterLesson.html. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system, betting early on transformer and transformer-like architectures and on increasing model sizes. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.



We are a fully in-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

jobs.title: Technical and Process Manager, LTP, Biogas and Biogas-to-Energy
jobs.description:
Main Accountabilities

The Technical and Process Manager will oversee the operation, optimization, construction, commissioning, and

performance of landfill gas, biogas-to-energy, and leachate treatment systems across all Veolia sites in Oman. The role includes regional operational leadership, project management, HSE and environmental compliance, maintenance coordination, budget management, resource planning, emergency response, and continuous improvement.

Detailed Job Description

Technical and Operation Management

• Oversee the operation and performance of landfill gas, biogas, biogas-to-energy, and leachate treatment systems across all Veolia sites in Oman.
• Establish consistent operating procedures, reporting systems, performance standards, and HSE requirements across all sites.
• Lead and support site-based site managers, supervisors, operators, technicians, and contractors.
• Conduct regular site visits, operational reviews, inspections, and performance assessments.
• Coordinate manpower, equipment, maintenance, technical support, and operational resources across the sites.
• Report operational risks, performance issues, budget requirements, and improvement opportunities to management.

Biogas and Landfill Gas Management

• Oversee landfill gas collection, gas treatment, flaring, and biogas utilization systems.
• Monitor and optimize gas production, collection efficiency, gas quality, methane emissions, flaring, and energy generation.
• Manage the operation and maintenance of gas wells, pipelines, blowers, condensate systems, flares, gas treatment equipment, and energy recovery systems.

Biogas-to-Energy Projects

• Manage biogas-to-energy projects from planning and design through construction, commissioning, handover, and operation.
• Develop operating structures, staffing plans, procedures, training requirements, maintenance arrangements, and budgets for biogas-to-energy facilities.
• Monitor energy production, gas utilization, equipment performance, availability, operating costs, and maintenance requirements.
• Review process designs, equipment specifications, operating philosophies, commissioning plans, and project schedules.
• Coordinate with engineering, construction, procurement, HSE, finance, contractors, suppliers, and clients.
• Ensure that operating manuals, maintenance documents, drawings, spare parts, training records, and handover requirements are completed.
• Lead performance testing, start-up, stabilization, and operational acceptance of new facilities.

Biogas System Construction and Commissioning

• Lead the construction, installation, testing, commissioning, and handover of new landfill gas, biogas, gas treatment, flaring, and biogas-to-energy systems.
• Review technical designs, construction plans, method statements, risk assessments, inspection plans, and commissioning procedures.
• Ensure that construction activities comply with approved designs, technical requirements, quality standards, HSE procedures, and environmental controls.
• Coordinate contractors, consultants, suppliers, project teams, site operations, and authorities.
• Identify technical risks, design gaps, construction issues, non-conformances, and operational concerns.
• Ensure that all new systems are safely handed over to operations and maintenance teams.

Leachate Treatment and New Plant Development

• Oversee the operation and maintenance of leachate collection, pumping, storage, treatment, and disposal systems.
• Monitor leachate levels, flow rates, composition, treatment performance, permeate quality, treated water quality, and discharge requirements.
• Ensure compliance with applicable environmental regulations, permits, and water quality standards.
• Lead the process and operational requirements for new leachate treatment plants.
• Review treatment technologies, process designs, equipment selections, operating philosophies, commissioning plans, and staffing requirements.
• Coordinate the construction, commissioning, testing, start-up, and handover of new leachate treatment facilities.
• Identify opportunities to reduce chemical use, energy consumption, treatment costs, waste generation, and environmental risks.

Environmental Compliance, HSE, and Emergency Response

• Ensure compliance with environmental regulations, permits, company policies, client requirements, and HSE standards.
• Control and monitor risks related to methane emissions, gas leaks, fires, spills, odors, discharges, chemicals, electrical systems, confined spaces, and construction activities.
• Implement risk assessments, safe work procedures, inspections, toolbox talks, incident investigations, and corrective actions.
• Develop and maintain emergency response plans for gas, leachate, treatment, energy, construction, equipment, and environmental incidents.
• Organize emergency drills and ensure that employees and contractors are trained in emergency procedures.
• Respond promptly to incidents and coordinate containment, investigation, reporting, and corrective actions.

Maintenance and Asset Management

• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance for biogas, landfill gas, leachate, treatment, electrical, mechanical, control, and energy generation systems.
• Monitor equipment reliability, recurring failures, maintenance backlogs, spare parts, asset condition, and system availability.
• Support maintenance schedules, asset registers, inspection plans, equipment upgrades, and replacement strategies.
• Coordinate maintenance teams, contractors, suppliers, and service providers.

Reporting, Optimization, and Budget Management

• Establish regional reporting requirements for biogas, energy generation, leachate treatment, HSE, maintenance, projects, and financial performance.
• Review operational data, laboratory results, energy production, gas recovery, treatment performance, system availability, and operating costs.
• Prepare technical, operational, environmental, project, and management reports.
• Identify and implement opportunities for process optimization, cost reduction, energy recovery, methane reduction, water recovery, and improved system reliability.
• Prepare and manage operating, maintenance, project, and capital budgets.
• Monitor expenditure, manpower, chemicals, energy, contractors, maintenance costs, and project costs.
• Support procurement, technical evaluations, tender reviews, contractor selection, and supplier performance management.

• Bachelor’s degree in Chemical, Environmental, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
• 5 years of experience in landfill gas, biogas-to-energy, leachate treatment, or waste-to-energy operations and projects.
• Strong knowledge of HSE, environmental regulations, permit compliance, and emergency response.
• Experience managing teams, contractors, budgets, and multi-site operations.
• Proficiency in operational reporting, data analysis, CMMS.
• Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and project management skills.
• Fluency in English; Arabic is an advantage.
• Willingness to travel between sites.

Personal Attributes:

• Able to establish good business relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
• Good leading and communication skills, fosters teamwork to enable teams to deliver against objectives. Enthusiastic and team oriented; able to work well in cross-functional teams.
• Strong relationship building skills that support the ability to engage with a number of diverse work streams to ensure delivery and performance
• Able to work with people of varying abilities and nationalities; demonstrates cultural sensitivity

jobs.title: Account Executive, Enterprise (Remote)
jobs.description:
About Us

Qualio is an agentic quality and compliance management platform that helps regulated organizations get products to market faster with reduced risk. Trusted by biopharma, medtech, and diagnostics companies worldwide, Qualio eliminates fragmented systems that create audit delays and compliance blind spots. Our platform enables audit readiness in weeks through multi-standard automated gap analysis and evidence reuse across ISO and FDA requirements. Qualio is ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and ISO 27701 certified, reflecting our commitment to security, quality, and privacy.

The Qualio team is all-remote, and currently distributed across North America, Europe and Australia.

What’s the opportunity?

This is a foundational role on our sales team. As our first Enterprise Account Executive, you'll help shape how Qualio sells into larger, more complex life sciences and medtech organizations. You'll work closely with leadership, marketing, and product to build the playbook from the ground up, refine our ICP for this segment, and set the standard for how we win strategic accounts.

If you're a self-starter with a consultative, multi-threaded approach to selling, a track record of closing complex deals across long buying cycles, and the patience and creativity to navigate larger buying committees, this role is for you.

What will I be doing?

You are passionate about driving company growth by landing and growing strategic new logos. You have a consistent track record of exceeding quota with a consultative, value-based approach, and you know how to navigate the buying processes of larger, regulated organizations where decisions involve regulatory leaders, compliance, quality, IT, security, finance, and the C-suite.

What skills do I need?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they meet every single one of the qualifications as described in a job description. jobs.title: TMF Lead I
jobs.description:
Job Summary and Purpose:

TMF Lead is responsible for supporting project teams in maintaining a high quality TMF in accordance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), other guidance documents, and Precision Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Senior TMF Lead takes on responsibility for the complex or challenging studies requiring an experienced TMF Lead. Additionally, the Senior TMF Lead supports and mentors more inexperienced TMF Leads.

Main Duties & Responsibilities:

• Ensure that TMF document review and processing, periodic quality review, set up, maintenance, finalization and archival of study TMFs is completed in a timely manner and with a high quality.

• Create and execute the study TMF Plan and project TMF Document Index. Ensure entire study team understands expectations, project-specific aspects of the TMF, and manage communication of any changes in the TMF Plan or Index to the project team.

• Ensure that TMF documentation (e.g. TMF Plan, TMF Index, Periodic Quality Review documentation) is filed in the TMF.

• Attend and contribute to project kick-off meetings, project internal or external meetings, and ad hoc meetings as needed to ensure the project team is aware of the status of the TMF, potential gaps and escalations.

• Engage and collaborate with the Project Manager and Functional Leads to ensure TMF documentation is submitted in a timely manner and with high quality in order to maintain the TMF in an inspection-ready state.

• Proactively anticipate challenges to TMF compliance and identify early signals of risk. Develop and implement plans to increase compliance and follows-up on non compliance. Follows TMF escalation process as needed.

• Ensure that TMF Risks are identified and appropriately documented and mitigated.

• Monitor and report on TMF Health and Metrics and escalate non-compliances and potential issues to internal team and Senior Leadership as required. Identify trends, risks, and overall status of the TMF and suggest mitigation strategies.

• Serve as point of contact and Subject Matter Expert (SME) for project audits or inspections and support in the report responses. Participate in Audit/Inspection interview. Escalate to TMF management in cases of significant risk to Precision.

• Ensure provision of TMF analytics and expertise to Sponsors.

• Ensure that Periodic Quality Review for assigned projects is initiated and performed by the Quality Review Specialists and ensure proper documentation.

• Ensure that document review and processing for assigned projects is performed by the Document Specialists on a timely and consistent basis.

• Identify project team TMF training needs and provide or support team re-education.

• Manage the close-out activities of assigned studies, including defining the timeline for final document submission, final document processing, close out of all outstanding queries, requesting the eTMF export from the vendor, transfer to the sponsor and collect the Acknowledgement of Receipt.

• Manage projects within the Sponsor eTMF System and actively listen to deliver insightful solutions for challenges.

• Monitor and report potential out of scope activities related to Records Management, communicate these to the TMF manager and Project Manager, and ensure out of scope tasks are properly added to change orders, if needed.

• Support and mentor less experienced TMF Leads on the performance of their role and problem-solving study-specific issues.

Minimum Education & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) +5 years of related experience or equivalent combination of education, professional training and experience that provides the individual with the required knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job.

Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies:

• Working knowledge of FDA & ICH/GCP regulations and guidelines

• Demonstrates solid interpersonal skills

• Ability to identify issues and escalate appropriately and effectively

• Excellent organizational skills, time management, and ability to coordinate workload and meet established deadlines

• Manage competing priorities effectively

• Demonstrates, or is able to be trained and retain a working knowledge of ICH-GCP, and relevant Precision SOPs and regulatory guidance

• Exhibits strong self-motivation, is detail-oriented and able to work and plan independently as well as in a team environment

• Demonstrates professionalism, as evidenced by punctuality, ability to deliver on commitments, and maintain positive interactions with internal and external stakeholders

• Communicates both verbally and in written form in an efficient and professional manner

• Demonstrates values and a work ethic consistent with Precision Values and Company Principles
