jobs.title: AI Outcomes Manager, Strategic Tech (Spanish-speaking)
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | New York City, NY | Washington, DC
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Join Anthropic's Customer Success team in a high-visibility & high-impact role driving AI adoption across a small number of strategic accounts in our Enterprise Tech segment. As our dedicated Outcomes AI Manager for Strategic Tech Customers  you’ll be their partner and trusted advisor helping them harness the full potential of all our Claude capabilities - API, Claude Code, Cowork, and other surface areas.

You'll work with a book of global technology leaders to actively deploy AI and reshape the technology landscape. You’ll be working with key partners who are moving fast and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with LLM technology. Your role will entail developing genuine partnerships with the customer and key stakeholders, gaining a deep understanding of their multi-pronged business objectives, strategic direction, AI vision, and technical needs. You'll draw on both your business acumen and technical expertise to serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us.

In partnership with the broader account team, you will help customers identify the right Claude capabilities for their specific business objectives, working closely with them to provide best practices and guidance while supporting them as their usage grows and evolves.

Your role focuses on helping customers scale their usage effectively, drive model and use case optimizations, implement change management strategies, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization.  The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and go-to-market strategies — making you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a business.

Responsibilities:

• Build trusting, strategic relationships with key customer decision makers in complex, matrixed organizations; understand their business and objectives and identify opportunities for optimization and expansion

• Own customer operations across the lifecycle of each account, maintaining a structured operational assessment (customer readiness, operational health, strategic alignment, enablement strategy, adoption intelligence) that grounds comprehensive account and success plans and Executive Business Reviews

• Become an expert in Anthropic's products across API, Claude Code and Cowork, understanding the technical nuances and best practices for each to guide customers to the right solutions

• Leverage your deep knowledge of each customer, and the patterns you see across your other Tech accounts, to proactively drive consumption planning and the value story behind it, developing credible ROI hypotheses and quantifying outcomes that build the case for continued and expanded investment.

• Monitor usage patterns and identify optimization opportunities across Claude surface areas (API, Claude Code, Cowork) to drive full value from contracted commitments

• Serve as the customer’s thought partner, enhancing their knowledge of Claude products by socializing Anthropic’s product roadmap, driving awareness on new products and engaging Product PMs

• Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end-user adoption and maximize value within customer organizations, including Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and organizational enablement

• Ruthlessly prioritize across the account's many business units and workstreams, building programmatic, repeatable motions

You may be a good fit if you have:

• 6+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, or Strategy Consulting

• Native English and Spanish

• Experience working with F500 technology companies, SaaS platforms, or digital-first businesses at the exec level—ideally including high-growth and established tech companies.

• You understand what it means to lead organization-wide change or adoption programs (multiple functions, hundreds of users) for a product that requires C-suite sponsorship

• Technical fluency with ability to understand and articulate AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and software implementation patterns across a set of diverse stakeholders—from developers and product managers to executives and end users

• Proven track record managing a portfolio of accounts while maintaining strong relationships and driving measurable outcomes — you can run multiple enterprise motions in parallel without letting any account go quiet.

• Cross-functional collaborator who represents the customer in a positive, proactive manner, rallying everyone around paths forward that solve customer needs

• Passion for AI and interest in responsible development of advanced systems. You have built with Claude Code, automating your own workflows with agents, skills, and tooling.

• A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$200,000—$265,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Senior Support Specialist, Customer Satisfaction
jobs.description:
Senior Support Specialist, Customer Satisfaction & Incident (CSI)

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people with destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About the team

Our Customer Satisfaction & Incident (CSI) team protects the Agoda brand while delivering exceptional customer satisfaction. We are the final line of support, handling the most complex and challenging escalations across Agoda's core business. Our specialists work with a wide range of stakeholders, from customers and partners to senior leaders and external authorities, to resolve high-impact issues and make every engagement an opportunity to improve.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Support Specialist based in Chicago or Dallas, you will own our most complex, sensitive and high-risk escalations from first contact to final resolution. This includes frontline and executive escalations, regulatory matters, partner and supplier complaints, and technical or pricing issues. You would also be a direct point of contact for our partners when a situation calls for it, and you will work closely with our Partner Success, Commercial and other teams based in multiple locations across the world.

This role calls for sound judgment, strong ownership and calm, decisive communication in high-stakes situations. You will often work in grey areas where standard processes need careful, case-by-case handling, and you will make well-reasoned decisions that balance customer satisfaction with financial, legal and reputational risk.

What you'll do

• Own high-risk cases end to end, from intake to final resolution, including escalations from frontline teams, senior leadership, partners and third parties such as government bodies or attorneys. Cases can run for days or weeks and need persistence and clear accountability.

• Speak with customers/partners by phone, video or in person when needed, to resolve escalations, explain outcomes and protect the relationship.

• Work closely with Partner Success, Commercial and other teams in multiple locations, joining regular calls to align partner issues, risks and follow-ups.

• De-escalate and negotiate with highly emotional, frustrated or sensitive customers who have already been through standard support, reaching resolutions that protect the customer relationship, our partners and the business.

• Investigate complex situations by gathering and reconciling information from many, often conflicting, sources, and keep thorough, accurate and timely records of every action and decision.

• Make sound, defensible decisions within your authority, and escalate promptly when financial, legal, regulatory, privacy, safety or reputational thresholds are reached.

• Turn complex cases into short, factual updates for senior leaders and, where needed, regulators, focused on impact, resolution and preventing recurrence.

• Partner with teams such as Legal, Fraud, Finance, Public Relations, Product, Technology and Supply, clearly explaining what you need and why it matters, and influencing action without direct authority.

• Identify major errors, fraud indicators or suspicious customer or property behavior, and act to reduce risk to customers, partners and the company.

• Respond quickly to critical incidents and urgent escalations, coordinating stakeholders and keeping communication clear under pressure.

• Prioritize a complex caseload by business risk, financial impact and deadlines rather than arrival order, and adjust quickly as new information comes in.

• Analyze case trends and run root-cause analysis to find systemic gaps, take part in post-incident reviews, and propose preventive improvements.

• Turn new or unusual case resolutions into clear, reusable guidance for the wider team, and flag procedures that need updating.

• Give respectful, constructive feedback to frontline teams to improve case handling and prevent repeat errors, and ensure smooth handover of cases.

What you'll need to succeed:

• At least 4-5 years of relevant experience in customer escalations, complaints resolution, incident management or partner-facing support.

• Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain complex situations clearly and confidently to anyone, from upset customers to partners and senior executives.

• Confidence speaking directly with business partners and senior stakeholders, with excellent phone and email manner.

• Strong listening, negotiation and de-escalation skills, and emotional resilience to stay objective and professional under pressure.

• Sound judgment in ambiguous situations, with a critical-thinking, investigative approach and close attention to detail.

• A data-driven approach: comfort using data and case trends to spot systemic issues and support recommendations.

• A strong understanding of compliance, data privacy and risk, and a commitment to keeping actions and communications within legal and regulatory requirements.

• A high degree of integrity, impartiality and confidentiality when handling sensitive cases.

• The ability to manage your own caseload independently and to work well in a diverse, cross-functional team.

• Based in, or within commuting distance of, Chicago, IL (USA) or Dallas, TX (USA).

Nice to have

• Spanish language skills.

• Experience leading or coordinating major incidents across multiple stakeholders with limited information, and knowledge of incident management processes.

• SQL or similar data skills to analyze trends in customer issues and support data-driven decisions.

• Experience in travel, hospitality or online marketplaces.

Working hours and location

• Core working hours follow US Central Time including weekdays and weekends. On-call or extended hours may be needed on an ad hoc basis to meet business needs.

• Hybrid working with office 3 days a week.

jobs.title: SW Engineer Intern, AI Engineering
jobs.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

About the role

Join Roku as an Engineering Intern and help build the agentic AI powering America’s #1 TV streaming platform. Roku reaches more than 100 million households worldwide, and we’re building production-grade AI agents across the products and platforms that serve them. We offer a paid 12-week internship, running from June to early September 2027.

As an Engineering Intern, you’ll be assigned a scoped project with one of our engineering teams and matched to the team that best fits your skills and interests. You’ll work on real problems, such as agents that investigate failures, automate workflows, review or generate code, or help people make complex decisions. You’ll learn how to take an AI-powered idea from prototype to something people actually use, with a mentor alongside you and real ownership from day one.

Our teams work across a variety of languages and technologies, from user interfaces and embedded software to platform services, automation and developer tooling, and embrace AI-assisted development to boost productivity and quality.

What you’ll be doing

• Own a well-defined project that contributes to the success of your team, from defining the problem through to delivery.

• Build and test AI agents, copilots and automated workflows that perform meaningful, multi-step work.

• Connect agents to trusted data, services and internal tools, using approaches such as retrieval, tool calling and orchestration, and help define what an agent may do on its own and when it should hand over to a person.

• Evaluate your work: measure whether it does the job well, check its reliability and failure modes, and keep improving it based on real feedback.

• Use AI coding tools every day to move faster, and validate everything they produce through testing, review and your own judgment.

• Write clean, well-tested, documented code, take part in code reviews, and collaborate with engineers, mentors and cross-functional partners.

Apply if

• You are a penultimate-year student, or a final-year student planning to go on to a one-year master’s course.

• You hold a permanent right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider candidates on a student visa.

• You are available for full-time work for the whole 12-week program, from June to early September.

• You are keen to work with AI technologies and have previous experience building AI agents and automated workflows.

We’re excited if you have

• Currently enrolled in a degree program in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.

• Proficiency in Python, ideally with projects, open source or hackathon work beyond your coursework.

• Hands-on experience building an LLM-powered or agentic system that does multi-step work, and ideally that someone other than you has used.

• Familiarity with agentic patterns such as grounding and retrieval, tool use, orchestration, memory or conversational interfaces.

• Sound engineering judgment: you check AI-generated work, understand how it can fail, and recognise when simple automation or a human review is the better approach.

• A solid grounding in computer science fundamentals such as data structures, algorithms, and operating systems or networking concepts.

• Strong problem-solving and technical communication abilities, and the ability to break down ambiguous problems and deliver in small steps.

• Proactive mindset with passion for continuous learning and fast iteration.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.

We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks.  You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp up on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

We're looking for a finance person to join our team and run the money side of an unusual anime company.

We train state-of-the-art anime diffusion models (like the world's leading anime model, niji・journey https://nijijourney.com/), and then we build anime video games using these models.

You'll report directly to the CEO and help make sure that our books add up and our contracts pencil out.

We're looking for somebody who loves anime and video games as much as we do.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Do the books. We are looking for somebody to close, reconcile and do financial statements across a US parent and a Japanese subsidiary.

 - Run spend and controls. Own Ramp, expense policy, bill pay and approvals.

 - Keep us compliant in US and Japan. We need help with our US federal and state taxes, Delaware, Japanese filings, tax treaties, R&D credits, transfer pricing and audits.

 - Game launch finance. App store payouts, global sales tax/VAT/JCT on digital goods, multi-currency revenue and live-ops monetization reporting for our upcoming mobile title.

 - Compute economics. Help keep our combination of cloud and on-prem GPUs running through vendor negotiations, multi-year contract modeling, and even capex + realestate transactions.

 - Strategic M&A. We have capital set aside for strategic acquisitions. Help us find, diligence and close them.
   
    


YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF:

 - You genuinely love anime and games.
   We're really looking for somebody who is a consumer of the media we make, because it is important to understand why people pay money for it.

 - You’ve been the finance lead at a startup before.
   You've made finance models involving multiple entities, international teams, or heavy infrastructure spend.

 - You hate politics and management in general.
   You're comfortable running finance solo with a fleet of agents. Our company is very flat: many of our departments are of size one, and we want more people who prefer it this way.

 - You’re comfortable with in-person.
   We do require you to be on-site for most of the week in San Francisco. Our office culture is embarrassingly adorable, so we think it's not too bad.
   

To apply - please share your resume and the name of the best waifu or husbando in your message!

jobs.title: IT Helpdesk Engineer
jobs.description:
The IT Helpdesk Engineer is responsible for following and supporting IT policies and providing comprehensive technical support to end users. This role involves assisting employees with a wide range of IT needs, ensuring smooth and efficient use of technology resources. The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of IT systems, including software, hardware, and networks, and the ability to diagnose and resolve both routine and complex issues. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are essential to effectively support users and ensure adherence to IT best practices. This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• User Support & Troubleshooting: Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve user system issues, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.

• Onboarding/Offboarding: Manage onboarding and offboarding workflows globally, ensuring seamless access and account setup.

• Vendor Management: Collaborate with vendor contacts to resolve technical problems related to third-party equipment and software.

• System Administration: Administer Microsoft 365 and manage Microsoft Entra ID integration, including automated provisioning and de-provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (SAML).

• Asset Management: Maintain asset inventory, software license management, and asset tag auditing.

• Mobile Device Management: Leverage MDM (Mobile Device Management) tools to streamline user experience and ensure secure device usage.

• Network & Infrastructure: Support and troubleshoot consumer and business routers, switches, CCTV, and office access control systems.

• Cloud Management: Manage cloud subscriptions and related IT resources.

• Documentation & Reporting: Prepare and maintain documentation, records, and reports related to assigned systems, service requests, and project status.

• Security Management: Support security measures, including spam filtering, antivirus solutions, and end-user security awareness.

• Process Improvement: Identify recurring issues and help put fixes in place that improve user satisfaction.

• Research & Innovation: Stay current on the company's existing tools and share tips that help users get more out of them.

• AI & Automation: Use the company's existing AI tools and automation platforms to streamline routine helpdesk tasks and IT workflows. Help employees use these tools safely and effectively, and make sure their use follows company policies on security, data privacy and acceptable use.

Qualifications:

• 3 to 6 years of experience in an IT support or helpdesk role.

• Proficiency in troubleshooting for Windows and Mac desktops and laptops.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills for effective interaction in person, over the phone, and in documentation.

• Customer service-oriented mindset with a passion for providing support.

• Ability to work well within a team environment, being receptive to feedback and input.

• Experience with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Group Policy, and Microsoft 365.

• Ability to translate technical terminology into user-friendly language while maintaining confidence in resolving issues.

• Familiarity with ITSM/ITIL best practices.

• Experience working in a ticketing system

• Experience with MDM tools and basic networking (DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi troubleshooting).

• Working knowledge of AI tools such as Claude, including how to apply them to everyday IT work and how to spot their limits and security risks.

jobs.description:
The Role

You’ll partner with plaintiff U.S. law firms, from small and mid-market practices to select enterprise accounts, to drive software adoption, retention, and account growth. In this role, you'll act as a strategic advisor and change management partner, helping legal teams transform their workflows and leverage our platform—including generative AI capabilities—to achieve meaningful business outcomes on their most critical matters.

This is a full-time, exempt position based in our New York City, NY or Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.

What you'll do

• Own retention and growth across your book of business, driving renewals and identifying opportunities to expand usage

• Build multi-threaded relationships across law firm stakeholders, including day-to-day users, administrators, practice group leaders, and executive sponsors.

• Conduct regular check-in calls, strategic success reviews, and product demonstrations centered on usage data, business impact, and strategic alignment.

• Teach customers how to use platform features and workflows effectively, guiding them on best practices for adopting generative AI capabilities.

• Proactively identify retention risks, solve complex workflow challenges, and partner closely with Sales, User Education, Product, and Support to deliver a seamless customer experience.

• Share customer feedback, document best practices, and contribute to the continuous improvement of the Customer Success team.

About You

• You have at least 4 years of customer success experience managing a large book of mid-market and enterprise accounts within SaaS or consumption-based technology companies.

• You act as a strategic advisor and change management partner, using workflow expertise and data-driven account plans to influence customer behavior and drive adoption.

• You navigate complex client organizations effectively, building credibility, trust, and strong executive presence with senior leadership.

• You manage competing priorities proactively and possess exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

• You are authorized to work in the United States. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring U.S. employment visas for this role.

Bonus points

• Experience in legal tech, litigation software consulting, or related legal industry workflows.

• Experience working with AI tools (Claude, Glean, etc.) to optimize your day-to-day responsibilities

Think you're missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that's a better fit.

The Team — Customer Success

The Customer Success team helps customers turn Everlaw's powerful technology into meaningful outcomes on their most important matters. As trusted advisors, the team builds lasting partnerships, guides adoption, and helps organizations integrate Everlaw into the way they work. By connecting customer priorities and feedback with teams across Everlaw, Customer Success helps customers realize sustained value while strengthening the relationships that drive retention and growth.

Total Rewards & Benefits

The annual base salary for this position is between $116,000 - $148,000, with a total On-Target Earnings (OTE) of between $145,000 - $185,000, representing a 80/20 compensation split. Eligibility for the commission portion is performance-based and subject to the achievement of specific performance metrics, which are governed by Everlaw's policies and incentive plans. The final offered salary will be dependent upon many factors including the candidate’s experience and skills. The role's compensation is subject to change in the future.

• Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses

• Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness

• Paid parental leave

• Company-sponsored life and disability insurance

Financial rewards

• 401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation

Growth & everyday perks

• 17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave

• Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company-wide days off) per year

• Annual allocation for learning & development and relevant professional membership dues

• Hybrid work with regular work-from-home days and flexibility for life's logistics

• Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup

• Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company-wide events in our offices

About Everlaw When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence — emails, documents, chats, files — to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of messy data into the handful of facts that win or lose a case, compressing weeks of work into hours.

We're the kind of place that's ranked #1 on G2 in our category and named a Great Place to Work™ by our own team. So if you want a front row seat to an industry in transformation, career-defining work you'll be proud to tell people about, and real upside at a company in control of its own destiny, we'd love to get to know you.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer/Cloud Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Skyflow secures the flow of data across datastores, models, and agents. Enterprises turn to Skyflow as their runtime AI data control layer to protect sensitive data, enable safe AI deployment, and unlock full value from their applications, data platforms, and AI systems. 

Skyflow is trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises, and leading SaaS companies in financial services, healthcare, retail, travel and hospitality.



Skyflow is headquartered in Palo Alto, California and was founded in 2019. For more information, visit www.skyflow.com http://www.skyflow.com or follow on X https://twitter.com/SkyflowAPI and LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/skyflow/.

 

About the role



We're looking for a Platform Engineer to help build and run the infrastructure that powers a multi-tenant, security-sensitive B2B cloud product used by enterprise customers around the world. Our platform spans multi-tenant environments and single-tenant (BYOC) deployments into customer cloud accounts, so the bar for automation, consistency, and reliability is high — every environment needs to be provisioned, upgraded, monitored, and recovered the same way, at scale, with minimal manual intervention.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a ticket-queue ops role. You'll spend most of your time writing Go and Python to turn repeatable infrastructure work into platform capabilities — provisioning pipelines, internal CLIs, self-service tooling, and automation that lets the rest of engineering ship without waiting on infrastructure as a bottleneck. You'll also carry deep operational ownership: on-call, incident response, and root-cause analysis on the systems you build.

Collaborate with enterprise customers to understand their infrastructure and security needs, then build reusable, scalable solutions using Terraform, Helm, and self-service tools that can be standardized across customer environments with minimal customization.





You have:



 - 8+ years of experience in platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with real ownership of production cloud infrastructure.

 - Strong software engineering skills in Go and/or Python — you write tested, maintainable code and think of infrastructure automation as software, not scripting.

 - Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production (workload scheduling, networking, autoscaling, upgrades) and Infrastructure-as-Code tooling such as Terraform, Pulumi, or OpenTofu.

 - Solid experience with at least one major public cloud (AWS or GCP or Azure); experience operating in all the three is a strong plus given our multi-cloud footprint.

 - Track record of building tools or platforms that other engineers use — internal CLIs, provisioning frameworks, self-service portals, or automation pipelines — not just maintaining existing infrastructure.

 - Comfort operating in a B2B environment with enterprise customers, where infrastructure changes carry compliance, security, and contractual weight (e.g. dedicated/BYOC deployments, uptime SLAs, audit requirements).

 - Strong incident-response instincts: you can debug distributed systems under pressure, drive a root-cause analysis to a real fix, and communicate clearly during and after an incident.

 - A bias toward root-causing and automating away recurring problems over repeatedly firefighting the same issue.

 - Lead, mentor, and technically guide a team of junior/early-career platform engineers.





You will:



 - Design and build automation that provisions and manages cloud infrastructure end-to-end — new environment onboarding, upgrades, scaling, and decommissioning — across multiple cloud providers (AWS, GCP) and multiple deployment models (multi-tenant and dedicated/BYOC).

 - Write production-grade Go and Python services and CLIs that turn infrastructure operations into self-service platform capabilities for other engineering teams, rather than one-off scripts or manual runbooks.

 - Own and evolve the Infrastructure-as-Code stack (Terraform/OpenTofu, Helm, GitOps/ArgoCD) that defines every environment, and drive migrations across the fleet (Kubernetes version upgrades, node pool migrations, service mesh changes) with minimal customer impact.

 - Operate and scale core platform services — Kubernetes clusters, service mesh (Istio), data stores (Aerospike, PostgreSQL), messaging (Kafka), and GPU-backed inference workloads — with a focus on capacity planning, cost efficiency, and right-sizing.

 - Build and improve observability and alerting (metrics, logs, synthetic monitoring) so that failures are caught before customers notice, and drive the automation that turns repeat incidents into permanent fixes.

 - Work directly with large enterprise customers and their infrastructure, security and platform teams to gather platform requirements. Design solutions that are built once for one customer and then reused across all environments as standard Terraform modules, Helm charts or self-service tooling, with minimal custom work.

 - Own the infrastructure side of customer onboarding, from technical discovery to go-live, and act as the bridge between customers and engineering. Anticipate integration gaps early, turn customer requests into well-scoped platform features, and drive feature expansion based on customer demand while keeping the architecture consistent.

 - Participate in an on-call rotation, lead incident response for the systems you own, and write root-cause analyses that result in concrete corrective action — not just documentation.

 - Partner with security and compliance stakeholders to build guardrails (secrets management, access control, network policy, audit logging) directly into the platform, so secure-by-default is the path of least resistance for every team.

 - Continuously identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone infrastructure work and eliminate it — the measure of success in this role is less manual toil across the org, not more tickets closed.




Nice to have



 - Experience with service mesh (Istio/Envoy), GitOps workflows (ArgoCD/Flux), or policy-as-code (OPA).

 - Experience operating stateful systems in production — distributed databases (Aerospike, PostgreSQL, Cassandra), message queues (Kafka), or GPU-backed inference workloads.

 - Experience with security-sensitive or regulated environments (PCI, SOC 2, HIPAA) and building compliance controls into infrastructure by default.

 - Experience with cost optimization and capacity planning at fleet scale (right-sizing, autoscaling policy design, spot/preemptible usage).

 - Contributions to open-source infrastructure tooling, or experience building an internal developer platform (IDP).





Our stack (roughly)

Go, Python · Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD · Terraform/OpenTofu · AWS, GCP · Istio · Aerospike, PostgreSQL, Kafka · Coralogix/Prometheus-style observability · GitHub Actions and Spacelift-style CI/CD for infrastructure changes.

 - Work from home expense

 - Excellent Health Insurance Options

 - Very generous PTO

 - Flexible Hours

 - Generous Equity

jobs.title: Vice President, Product Marketing
jobs.description:
Zenoti provides an all-in-one, cloud-based software solution for the beauty and wellness industry. Our solution allows users to seamlessly manage every aspect of the business in a comprehensive mobile solution: online appointment bookings, POS, CRM, employee management, inventory management, built-in marketing programs and more. Zenoti helps clients streamline their systems and reduce costs, while simultaneously improving customer retention and spending. Our platform is engineered for reliability and scale and harnesses the power of enterprise-level technology for businesses of all sizes

Zenoti powers more than 30,000 salons, spas, medspas and fitness studios in over 50 countries. This includes a vast portfolio of global brands, such as European Wax Center, Hand & Stone, Massage Heights, Rush Hair & Beauty, Sono Bello, Profile by Sanford, Hair Cuttery, CorePower Yoga and TONI&GUY.

Our recent accomplishments include surpassing a $1 billion unicorn valuation, being named Next Tech Titan by GeekWire, raising an $80 million investment from TPG, ranking as the 316th fastest-growing company in North America on Deloitte’s 2020 Technology Fast 500™. We are also proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work CertifiedTM for 2021-2022 as this reaffirms our commitment to empowering people to feel good and find their greatness. To learn more about Zenoti visit: https://www.zenoti.com

Description

As Vice President of Product Marketing, you will own the go-to-market (GTM) growth strategy and execution for Zenoti’s product offerings. You will create compelling value propositions, product positioning and messaging to our global customer base. You will work closely with key executives in sales, marketing, product management and support teams to roll out new product offerings by creating high-impact campaigns. You must enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, be able to multitask and thrive in an environment that rewards high-quality work. This role will report directly to the SVP of Product Management.

What will I be doing?

• Collaborate with company executives, product management, sales, support, and marketing teams on GTM priorities, strategy, and execution

• Partner with key stakeholders to properly position the Zenoti value proposition and competitive differentiation

• Be a strong partner in leading GTM strategy - understanding trends and customer needs, identify new target markets for Zenoti - and building differentiated product strategies

• You will both manage product marketing creative team as well as create product marketing content, while prioritizing work to drive customer acquisition

• Partner with the Customer Success team to drive adoption through supporting materials and campaigns

• Drive the overall GTM activities around new product releases and launches

• Be a master of leveraging data to assess market viability and develop GTM strategy for different product offerings

What skills do I need?

• You have a demonstrated track record of creating & delivering compelling content and breakthrough product marketing programs (with fantastic portfolio)

• You have a history of delivering results in high growth, innovative and fast paced environments

• You are Fluent in Salesforce, analytics software (ex: Tableau, Google Analytics), and project management software

• You have a solid understanding of Zenoti applications, cloud-based enterprise and SaaS applications

• You have a process-driven approach and the ability to lead internal alignment strategies amidst dynamic growth, ambiguity and change

• You have a strong executive presence and customer-facing skills, as well as the ability to manage a creative team and overall product marketing function

• You are equally comfortable with strategic thinking and detailed, creative execution

• You are a leader and mentor, you can collaborate and manage a team as well as multiple projects. Experience leading cross-functional, global teams

• You’re metrics-driven and focused on ROI. You can develop KPIs, dashboards and benchmark reports to measure success and advocate for effective product marketing strategies.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing or related field. MBA preferred.

• 12+ years relevant product marketing experience in B2B technology, SaaS or enterprise software, and go-to-market planning

• Experience building and managing teams of product marketers

• Experience seeing company through late-stage startup growth cycle

Zenoti Pay Range

$200,000—$250,000 USD

jobs.title: Per Diem Family Medicine Physician (Casual Employee) - West Portal
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

Employment type:

• “Casual Employee” (per diem, hourly clinician role)

• 8-23 patient care hours per week

What you'll be working on:

• Seeing patients with a broad array of patient needs; conducting a mix of acute, chronic, and well visits (not a panel-building role)

• Treating patients in-office as well as conducting occasional tele-health visits

• Ongoing collaboration with in-office teammates via daily huddles, as well as with virtual clinical teams

• Utilization of your specific clinical training and opportunities to perform in-office procedures

Education, licenses, and experiences required for this role:

• Enrolled in, or have completed, an accredited Family Medicine or Medicine/Pediatrics residency program

• Practiced at least 2 of the last 5 years in an outpatient primary care setting seeing all ages (0+)

• Board Certified in Family Medicine or Internal Medicine/Pediatrics. If not yet Board Certified, must presently be a Board Eligible Family Medicine or Internal Medicine/Pediatrics Resident, or have completed a Family Medicine or Internal Medicine/Pediatrics Residency Program within the last calendar year and scheduled to take the next available Board Exam

• State licensed in California, obtained before your One Medical start date

One Medical clinicians also demonstrate:

• A passion for human-centered primary care

• The ability to successfully communicate with and provide care to individuals of all backgrounds

• The ability to effectively use technology to deliver high quality care

• Clinical proficiency in evidence-based primary care

• The desire to be an integral part of a team dedicated to changing healthcare delivery

• An openness to feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into strengths and weaknesses

• The ability to confidently navigate uncertain situations with both patients and colleagues

• Readiness to adapt personal and interpersonal behavior to meet the needs of our patients

Casual/Per Diem clinicians receive:

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• One Medical Issued laptop (to allow for secure access to our EHR)

• Sick Time PTO eligible in accordance with local requirement

This is an hourly role in West Portal and surrounding offices in San Francisco, CA.

One Medical is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The hourly rate for this role is $177.00. Final determination of starting pay may vary based on factors such as practice experience and patient care schedule. Additional pay may be determined for those candidates that exceed these specified qualifications and requirements. The total compensation package for this position may also include benefits. For more information, visit https://www.onemedical.com/careers/

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

One Medical participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.  Please refer to the E-Verification Poster and Right to Work Poster for additional information.

Your work schedule could be subject to change based on business direction at any time.

jobs.title: Head of Global Material Movement & Warehousing
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Head of Global Material Movement & Warehousing will be responsible for developing and executing the warehousing strategy that optimizes material movement across the company. This role will oversee warehousing operations, ensuring efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and alignment with the organization’s supply chain goals. The role will need to improve and execute on today's challenges while also prepare the organization for hyperscale growth in a highly dynamic environment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Strategic Leadership: Develop and implement a comprehensive global warehousing strategy that aligns with the company’s overall supply chain objectives. Understand the future company growth outlook and ensure a strategy and plan are in place to efficiently deliver materials to enable production growth.

• Operational Excellence: Oversee daily warehousing operations, ensuring efficient material handling, storage, and distribution processes.

• Team Management: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing warehousing team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence.

• Cost Management: Monitor and manage warehousing budgets, identifying opportunities to reduce costs while maintaining service levels.

• Collaboration: Work closely with sites across Anduril, cross-functional teams(i.e., including logistics, procurement, accounts payable, finance, production) to ensure seamless, accurate and efficient material flow.

• Technology Integration: Evaluate and implement technology solutions to enhance warehousing operations, including warehouse management systems (WMS) and automation tools.

• Compliance and Safety: Ensure compliance with industry regulations and safety standards, promoting a safe working environment for all employees.

• Performance Metrics: Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to drive operational performance and optimize warehouse efficiency.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, industrial engineering, business administration, or a related field

• 10+ years of experience in warehousing and supply chain management, with a minimum of 5 years in a leadership role

• 5+ years of experience managing a team of supply chain professionals

• Proven track record of developing and executing successful warehousing strategies on a large scale across multiple sites

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions

• Expertise in warehouse management systems and emerging technologies in the logistics sector

• Ability to travel as needed

• Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Costa Mesa, CA

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Masters degree

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills

• Excellent collaboration skills with the ability to drive diverging thoughts to a conclusion

• Ability to command a room at all levels of the organization

• Proven ability to manage cross-functional projects and teams

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. TS or secret clearance

US Salary Range

$260,000—$345,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Senior Regional Estimating Manager
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Senior Regional Estimating Manager to lead and manage estimating services across our East Buildings + Places business. This position will be based in one of our regional offices and oversee estimating resources across multiple locations.

The successful candidate will manage regional estimating workloads, maintain estimating quality and consistency, support project delivery, and develop our regional estimating capabilities. This position will serve as the primary point of contact for estimating services and represent AECOM in client meetings, design charrettes, cost reviews, and other project discussions.

The ideal candidate will have a strong technical estimating background, proven leadership experience, and the ability to manage teams across multiple offices while building lasting relationships with clients, project managers, and regional leadership. The candidate will also be responsible for identifying, evaluating, and implementing new estimating tools and technologies, including AI, to improve efficiency, accuracy, and consistency, while keeping AECOM at the forefront of the industry.

Key Responsibilities

Team leadership

• Manage and mentor estimators across multiple offices, including hiring, performance management, and professional development.

• Balance workload across offices to meet project schedules, and engage subcontractors when additional support is needed.

• Expand the regional estimating group in line with business growth.

• Lead the evaluation and adoption of AI and other estimating technologies, and ensure staff are trained to use them effectively.

Estimating

• Oversee conceptual, parametric, and detailed cost estimates through all phases of design, including federal independent cost estimates and cost risk analyses.

• Establish estimating procedures and quality review standards and ensure they are applied consistently across the business.

• Prepare and review estimates on select projects.

Clients and business development

• Serve as the primary point of contact for estimating services across the region.

• Lead cost reviews and design charrettes with clients, including presenting estimates, explaining cost drivers, and resolving estimate differences.

• Develop the estimating portions of proposals, including scope, staffing plans, and fees.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field plus 10 years of construction cost estimating experience or demonstrated equivalency of education and/or experience.

2 years managing or supervising estimating staff or an estimating function.

Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance.

Demonstrated knowledge of construction methods, labor productivity, and material and equipment costs.

Experience leading client meetings and presenting estimates to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Due to the nature of the role, must be a United States Citizen.

Preferred Qualifications

• Active U.S. Government Secret clearance or higher.

• Estimating experience with USACE, NAVFAC, or Air Force clients, including MILCON projects and DD Form 1391 supporting estimates.

• Knowledge of UFC 3-740-05 and related DoD cost estimating criteria.

• Experience preparing Basis of Estimates (BOEs), Independent Government Estimates (IGEs), and cost and schedule risk analyses (CSRAs).

• Advanced proficiency in MCACES/MII, plus experience with PACES and RSMeans.

• Professional certification such as CCE, CCC, CPE, CCP, or CEP.

• Planning and Scheduling Certification (PSP)

• Autodesk Revit (BIM) software

• Experience leading teams.

• Experience with escalation, contingency development, and market conditions analysis.

• Experience bringing new technology or process changes into an estimating group.

This position is based in one of AECOM's regional offices. Travel of approximately 20–25% is expected to other offices, client meetings, design charrettes, and project sites.

Sponsorship for U.S. employment authorization is not available.

Relocation assistance is not available for this role.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.


ABOUT THE TEAM

We’re part of Plaid’s Data organization, building models and insights that help millions of people better understand and grow their financial lives. We use Plaid’s unique financial data to help lenders make more informed decisions and build better credit experiences.

We partner across data science, engineering, product, and Go-to-Market to turn complex data into practical customer recommendations and scalable solutions. We value technical rigor, creativity, user empathy, and teamwork.



ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Data Scientist on the Credit team, you’ll apply quantitative analysis and deep credit expertise to help lenders make better use of cash flow insights. You’ll work across customer problems, credit policy, and data products—translating Plaid’s data into recommendations and insights that drive business impact and inform product direction.

Your day-to-day responsibilities may include:

 - Deep-dive into model performance for clients, triage issues, and identify opportunities to improve outcomes.

 - Analyze Plaid’s unique data to identify emerging credit risk signals and build and evaluate credit retrospectives.

 - Create tailored recommendations for clients based on their data and Plaid’s insights.

 - Build and maintain data pipelines, including ETL processes using tools such as dbt.

 - Develop metrics, alerts, and dashboards to monitor production machine learning model performance.

In this role, you will:

 - Own the process of developing hands-on recommendations for incorporating cash flow insights into lending decisions, using best practices for account-level decisioning.

 - Improve customer adoption of Plaid Insights through custom analysis tailored to each customer’s needs.

 - Serve as a subject matter expert on credit insights and credit policy implementation, supporting Data Science, Engineering, and Go-to-Market partners.

 - Apply your expertise in quantitative analysis, data mining, and data visualization to develop models and actionable insights.

 - Identify useful signals that can inform machine learning models.

 - Inform and influence Product and Engineering teams through clear analysis and presentations.



WHAT EXCITES YOU

 - Applying data science and credit expertise to real-world lending decisions.

 - Working with Plaid’s unique financial data to uncover emerging credit risk signals and create useful customer insights.

 - Helping lenders make more informed decisions with cash flow data and account-level recommendations.

 - Partnering across Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Go-to-Market to turn analysis into customer and product impact.

 - Working on high-impact problems that can improve financial access and outcomes.



WHAT EXCITES US

 - 2–5 years of industry experience in a financial services Data Science role.

 - Deep familiarity with SQL and Python.

 - Deep understanding of credit risk and the development of underwriting models.

 - Hands-on credit expertise building and maintaining credit policies for lenders.

 - Knowledge of the lending lifecycle and how to optimize each step, including marketing, acquisition, customer management, and collections or recoveries.

 - Demonstrated ability to make data-driven decisions.

 - Nice to have: Experience building data pipelines and automating ETL processes with dbt or similar tools.

Clasp is a mission-driven, venture-backed startup transforming access to education and career pathways. A college education was always meant to lead to economic mobility. But with rising costs and shrinking loan availability, many working-class and first-generation students don’t have the money they need to finish school. That’s where Clasp comes in. We’re the market leader in institutionally funded gap loan programs. We partner with schools to design, launch and manage lending programs that keep students enrolled, graduating and thriving.

Fresh off our Series B, Clasp is entering its next phase of growth. Recent recognition includes:

 - TIME’s Best Inventions of 2026 (Loan-Linked Hiring)

 - Forbes Fintech 50

 - Business Insider: Top 14 Healthcare Startups to Watch in 2026 and 43 Startups to Bet Your Career On in 2025

Our work spans two business lines:

Clasp Talent helps healthcare employers attract and retain critical talent by connecting them with diverse candidates and using student loan repayment as a powerful recruiting and retention tool. We meaningfully connect employers, educational institutions, and learners to drive mutual benefit.

Clasp Student Finance equips colleges and universities with lending technology to launch and operate their own private student loan programs, enabling schools to step in and support their students directly with financial aid. Recent federal financial aid changes are reshaping how institutions think about supporting their students, and Clasp Student Finance is poised to meet this moment. This role is focused solely on Clasp Student Finance. You can learn more about this business line here https://www.clasp.com/studentfinance.




WHO WE NEED

We are hiring a Director of Product for the Clasp Student Finance business line. We’ve seen rapid acceleration since recent federal student loan policy changes. We’re landing deals with large, name-brand universities who are seeing that Clasp’s offering is crucial for filling gaps in student loan financing. We have real product market fit, but there is a lot to build when it comes to scale, excellent borrower experience, and the enterprise features that large universities need. We're hiring a Director of Product to make the right calls on our product strategy to make sure we can capitalize on this momentum.

You'll own the product strategy for Clasp Student Finance and work across our executive team, product, engineering, compliance and lending operations to deliver it. We want you to bring your own point of view, back it up with data, and push back when you think we're heading the wrong way. Some days you'll present the year's product plan to our executive team and board. Other days you'll be in refinement with engineering, making the call on a single feature. You'll manage PMs, hire and grow the team, and talk directly with customers.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the product strategy and roadmap for Clasp Student Finance, co-leading execution alongside the Director of Engineering

 - Build a repeatable way to onboard and integrate schools, including how they certify loans and how we connect to their student information systems. We need to launch enterprise university customers without custom builds

 - Decide where we make our product bets – prioritize across student application experience, university customer asks, and platform modernization

 - Pair deeply with Compliance and bring them in early on every decision. Shipping in a regulated environment requires a strong relationship between Product and Compliance

 - Represent Clasp's product vision to school partners, at higher-ed finance conferences and inside the company. This isn't a sales role, but you should be able to explain why a school needs what we're building.

 - Learn our lending platform end to end, from application and disclosures through school certification, data and disbursement with our bank and servicing partners. Become the person everyone goes to with product questions about it.

 - Become an expert on student loan policy and where Clasp can go to continue to meet the needs of students and universities. You should be deeply passionate about the problem space.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 7+ years in product management, including recent hands-on work. You're comfortable working across the spectrum from executive strategy to sprint planning.

 - Experience managing direct reports and building a team: you’ve hired, created an org chart, and coached PMs.

 - Experience with in-school student loans. You don’t need to have spent your entire career in this space, but we need someone who understands the basic mechanics of financial aid packaging, loan applications, certification and disbursement, and servicing.

 - Experience partnering with Compliance to balance risk with the Product vision.

 - The ability to learn a complex system quickly. You need to be able to look at diagrams, API docs, read docs, and then grok a complex system quickly.

 - Commercial judgment. You connect customer problems to revenue, and you can make a clear tradeoff when schools, students, and internal teams want different things.

 - You take a position and defend it. You've disagreed with senior leaders, done the research to back up your view, and changed decisions while keeping their trust.

 - You use AI deeply. You can show us how you’ve automated things to have an impact on teammates, customers, and your own workflows.

Nice to haves:

 - Experience at a startup or growth-stage company is a plus

 - Experience at a fintech that works with bank partners, such as a lending-as-a-service is a plus


WHAT WE GIVE IN RETURN

 - Competitive cash and equity compensation

 - Health benefits (health, dental, & vision)

 - Student loan repayment benefits

 - 401k + match

 - Opportunities to grow and perform in a fast-paced environment alongside a stellar team

Salary

The salary range for this position is competitive and will be commensurate with the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and industry knowledge, ranging between $160,000 to $190,000 annually. In addition to the base salary, we offer an attractive equity component as part of our compensation package, providing an opportunity for eligible employees to share in the success and growth of our company. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and benefits packages to attract and retain top talent.
