Position Summary

The Senior Electrical Engineer, Site Infrastructure serves as a technical owner and subject-matter expert for the site's critical electrical infrastructure. This individual will own and advance medium-voltage and high-power distribution, electrical system automation and controls, electrical system reliability, capital projects, commissioning, troubleshooting, and long-term infrastructure planning for a large-scale, continuously operating manufacturing campus.

We welcome candidates from biopharmaceutical manufacturing as well as adjacent industries such as semiconductor fabrication, data centers, utilities, advanced manufacturing, energy, and engineering or construction services. Direct GMP experience is helpful but not required. Candidates with strong critical-power and industrial electrical experience will be supported in learning the applicable regulated manufacturing requirements.

This is an onsite technical leadership role that is currently an individual-contributor position, with significant system ownership and cross-functional influence. The role may evolve in the future to include a reporting engineering team. The role is well suited for an engineer who wants to own systems through their full lifecycle, lead meaningful infrastructure investments, apply high-power and electrical automation expertise to critical systems, and support reliable operations connected to the delivery of medicines to patients.

Duties/Responsibilities

• Serve as the technical owner and electrical engineering subject-matter expert for assigned site infrastructure and utility systems.
• Provide engineering oversight for medium-voltage and high-power distribution, power infrastructure, electrical equipment, emergency systems, and associated site utilities.
• Lead the specification, integration, and lifecycle management of electrical system automation, controls, and monitoring (for example, power monitoring, supervisory control, and protection and metering systems) in coordination with controls and automation partners.
• Lead or support electrical projects from concept and scope development through design, construction, commissioning, startup, and operational handover.
• Develop and review technical requirements, specifications, drawings, equipment selections, and engineering documentation.
• Perform or oversee power-system studies, such as short-circuit, protective-device coordination, arc-flash, and load-flow analysis, to support safe and reliable operation and system changes.
• Troubleshoot complex electrical-system issues and partner with operations and maintenance teams to improve reliability and reduce downtime.
• Coordinate with internal stakeholders, engineering partners, contractors, equipment suppliers, and the local electrical utility provider.
• Support infrastructure planning, system-capacity assessments, equipment lifecycle strategies, and capital-investment recommendations.
• Provide electrical engineering support for site changes, investigations, inspections, and compliance activities.
• Review commissioning documents, system turnover packages, as-built drawings, preventive-maintenance requirements, and operating procedures.
• Promote effective collaboration and ensure engineering work is completed safely, reliably, and in alignment with site priorities.
• Provide technical direction and mentorship to project teams and peers. This role does not currently have direct reports but may include leading an engineering team in the future.
• Support a continuously operating facility, including participation in the established escalation or on-call model and occasional off-hours support for critical events, planned shutdowns, and major project activities.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant technical experience.
• Demonstrated technical leadership, including mentoring engineers and directing technical work across project teams, vendors, and contractors.
• At least 8 years of electrical engineering experience supporting large-scale industrial, manufacturing, utility, or critical-infrastructure operations.
• Hands-on experience with medium-voltage or high-voltage electrical distribution systems, including power distribution, switchgear, substations, transformers, protection systems, emergency power, or related infrastructure.
• Experience with electrical system automation, controls, or monitoring (for example, power monitoring, supervisory control, or protective-relay communications) for power distribution and electrical infrastructure.
• Working knowledge of applicable electrical codes and standards (for example, NFPA 70, NFPA 70E, and IEEE standards) and of power-system analysis, including short-circuit, protective-device coordination, and arc-flash studies.
• Experience serving as a technical lead, system owner, project engineer, or subject-matter expert for electrical systems.
• Experience troubleshooting electrical systems and supporting equipment reliability in an operating facility.
• Experience developing technical scopes, specifications, user requirements, or design requirements for electrical infrastructure projects.
• Experience supporting projects through design, installation, commissioning, startup, and operational handover.
• Ability to read and interpret single-line diagrams, electrical drawings, equipment specifications, and technical documentation.
• Ability to coordinate across operations, maintenance, engineering, safety, vendors, contractors, and other technical stakeholders.
• Ability to manage multiple technical priorities and provide support for a continuously operating site, including occasional off-hours support for significant electrical issues or planned project activities.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in biopharmaceutical, pharmaceutical, semiconductor, data center, utility, chemical, energy, or advanced-manufacturing environments.
• Experience working in a regulated or highly controlled operating environment.
• Experience leading, coaching, and developing engineers, including work prioritization, performance feedback, and team development, as the role may include direct reports in the future.
• Familiarity with GMP, commissioning, qualification, validation, change control, deviation, or CAPA processes.
• Experience with 13.8 kV electrical distribution or comparable medium-voltage infrastructure.
• Experience with fire-alarm, fire-suppression, emergency-power, or building utility systems.
• Experience with power-system analysis software (for example, ETAP or SKM) or 3D plant-design or engineering-modeling software.
• Professional Engineer license.

You may be a strong fit if...

You currently support electrical infrastructure in a data center, semiconductor facility, utility, power-generation environment, advanced-manufacturing site, large industrial campus, or engineering and construction organization. Prior pharmaceutical experience is not required if you bring strong experience in critical power, high-power and medium-voltage distribution, electrical system automation, system ownership, commissioning, reliability, and continuously operating facilities.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Network Engineer to design, implement, and operate our global network infrastructure across on-premises data centers and cloud environments. This role requires deep expertise in core networking technologies as well as hands-on experience with cloud networking. You'll leverage your strong understanding of routing, switching, security, and connectivity — spanning WAN/LAN, VPN, firewalls, and cloud network architecture — to ensure our environments are secure, resilient, and performant. You will also play a key role in driving and tracking the execution of complex projects and using data to guide decisions and improvements.

Responsibilities Include:

Network architecture & design: Design, build, and maintain robust, secure, and scalable network solutions across on-premises data centers and AWS cloud environments.

Core network engineering: Provide hands-on expertise across TCP/IP, routing and switching, VPN and tunneling technologies, site-to-site VPNs, and firewall installation and configuration.

Cloud networking: Configure and manage AWS network infrastructure including VPCs, VPC peering, transit gateways, CIDR block planning and allocation, security groups, route tables, and hybrid connectivity back to on-premises environments.

Monitoring & troubleshooting: Implement and maintain network monitoring toolsets; perform deep packet analysis and network tracing using Wireshark and similar tools to diagnose and resolve complex connectivity and performance issues.

Vendor management: Work directly with Cisco and other network equipment vendors on hardware selection, support escalations, lifecycle planning, and licensing.

Automation & optimization: Identify and implement opportunities to automate configuration, monitoring, and management tasks to increase efficiency and reliability.

Project execution: Drive and manage the successful delivery of complex network projects, ensuring milestones are met and issues are resolved promptly.

Stakeholder communication: Develop and deliver clear presentations to leadership and other teams to communicate strategy, status updates, and performance metrics.

Data analysis: Use strong data analysis and Excel skills to understand and reconcile cost, inventory, capacity, trend, risk, and performance metrics.

Collaboration: Work closely with systems, cloud, security, operations, and application teams to integrate best practices across the technology stack.

Documentation & support: Develop and maintain detailed documentation of network designs, configurations, topologies, and processes; provide technical guidance and support to other team members.

Continuous improvement: Research, evaluate, and recommend new technologies, tools, and best practices to advance our network capabilities.

Qualifications:

• 7–10 years of experience engineering and administering global network environments.
• Deep expertise in core networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, subnetting, routing protocols, switching, DNS, DHCP, and QoS.
• Strong hands-on experience with VPN and tunneling technologies, including site-to-site VPN design, implementation, and troubleshooting.
• Demonstrated experience installing, configuring, and managing enterprise firewalls.
• Hands-on experience with network monitoring platforms and packet-level tracing and analysis using tools such as Wireshark.
• Experience designing and managing network infrastructure in both on-premises data centers and AWS, including VPCs, VPC peering, CIDR block planning, route tables, and hybrid connectivity.
• Demonstrated experience working with Cisco and other network equipment vendors, including hardware deployment, configuration, and support escalation.
• Extensive experience working in CLI environments; scripting experience (Python, Bash, PowerShell, Ansible, or similar) is a plus.
• Demonstrated ability to drive execution of complex projects with multiple stakeholders.
• Excellent data analysis and advanced Excel skills.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to articulate ideas and thoughts clearly and easily in varied contexts and through multiple mediums.
• Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for continuous improvement.
• Familiarity with ITIL or other service management frameworks.
• Proven experience in directly and indirectly leading engineering teams and projects.
• Ability to quickly and independently learn, discover, and understand new technologies, products, software, and deployments.
• Bachelor's degree (4-year) required.
• Relevant Cisco (CCNP or equivalent) and AWS certifications preferred.

Job Summary

• Serve as a senior individual contributor reporting directly to the Executive Director, Accounting Research & Operations, acting as the authoritative technical accounting strategist for CME Group.
• Direct technical accounting research, formulate authoritative position papers, and advise business units on the financial implications of routine and non-routine corporate transactions.
• Partner cross-functionally with financial reporting, corporate accounting, and executive leadership to ensure seamless quarterly and annual SEC compliance and adoption of emerging accounting standards.

What You’ll Get

• A supportive environment fostering career progression, continuous learning, and an inclusive culture.
• Broad exposure to CME's diverse products, asset classes, and cross-functional teams.
• A competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package. Explore our full range of benefits

What You’ll Do

• Lead technical accounting research across routine and complex transactions under authoritative U.S. GAAP.
• Formulate robust, executive-ready accounting position papers that document methodologies, technical interpretations, and final conclusions.
• Advise business units and functional leaders on accounting implications, aligning strategic initiatives with corporate financial standards.
• Evaluate the financial structure of proposed mergers, acquisitions, new products, and strategic investments submitted for Executive Leadership and Board review.
• Author and review financial statement footnote disclosures and MD&A contributions for quarterly and annual SEC filings.
• Direct technical accounting interactions with external auditors to ensure alignment and timely resolution of accounting considerations.
• Curate and modernize the internal technical accounting research repository, synthesizing new standards and authoritative guidance for firmwide accessibility.
• Monitor emerging FASB and SEC regulatory initiatives, evaluate organizational impact, and draft formal comment letters representing CME Group’s position.
• Establish, update, and maintain a comprehensive corporate accounting policy manual reflecting current regulatory standards.
• Deliver targeted educational presentations and implementation frameworks to guide cross-functional teams through technical accounting transitions.
• Champion reporting technology enhancements and process automation to elevate research workflow efficiency.

What You’ll Bring

• Hold an active Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license (required).
• Bring 4+ years of progressive technical accounting, policy research, and SEC reporting experience.
• Possess a Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
• Apply comprehensive knowledge of U.S. GAAP authoritative literature (working familiarity with IFRS is a plus).
• Demonstrate a proven track record of writing concise, impactful technical memorandums and executive summaries for senior leadership.
• Leverage prior accounting experience within the financial services industry or public accounting serving financial sector clients.
• Lead cross-functional change management when interpreting and operationalizing new accounting standards across diverse business units.
• Utilize advanced proficiency across productivity platforms, including Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and Microsoft Office.

jobs.title: Assembly, Maintenance and Overhaul Technician – Drilling Services
jobs.description:
Assembly, Maintenance and Overhaul Technician – Drilling Services

Are you passionate about diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining electro‑mechanical equipment?

Would you like to contribute to the delivery of high‑quality technical solutions in a hands‑on manufacturing and service environment?

Join our team

Baker Hughes is a global energy‑technology company operating in more than 120 countries. We deliver innovative solutions that make energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient. Our Assembly, Maintenance & Overhaul (AMO) teams play an essential role in ensuring equipment reliability, quality, and operational performance through expert maintenance, repair, testing, and assembly activities.

Partner with the best

As an AMO Technician, you will troubleshoot, test, assemble, disassemble, inspect, and repair electro‑mechanical equipment and assemblies. You will support maintenance and overhaul activities while ensuring products and equipment meet quality, safety, and operational requirements.

Working closely with technicians, engineering teams, and operational stakeholders, you will help maintain high standards of equipment performance and support continuous improvement across operations.

As an AMO Technician, you will be responsible for:

• Troubleshooting, testing, assembling, and disassembling electro‑mechanical assemblies and equipment.
• Performing visual inspections of components and assemblies to verify quality and compliance.
• Supporting repair, rework, and modification activities for non‑conforming equipment.
• Conducting complex diagnostic and testing activities with minimal supervision.
• Applying logical troubleshooting techniques to identify and resolve technical issues.
• Communicating technical findings and recommended corrective actions clearly and effectively.
• Supporting maintenance and overhaul activities in accordance with established procedures and quality standards.
• Reading and interpreting Engineering drawings, Wiring diagrams, Assembly instructions, Parts lists and Technical documentation
• Following formal maintenance procedures and operational practices.
• Coaching and supporting other technicians in areas of demonstrated expertise.
• Ensuring compliance with all Health, Safety, and Environmental (HS&E) policies and procedures.
• Maintaining accurate maintenance, testing, and service records as required.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role, you will:

• Have a minimum of a technical diploma

• Have 5+ years of experience in maintenance in drilling services
• Demonstrate strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities.
• Have effective communication and teamwork skills.
• Show a commitment to quality, safety, and continuous improvement.

Work in a way that works for you

This is an on‑site role requiring hands‑on involvement in assembly, maintenance, overhaul, testing, and repair activities. You will work closely with manufacturing, engineering, quality, and service teams to support successful operational outcomes.

Working with us

At Baker Hughes, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a culture of innovation, safety, collaboration, and continuous development. We invest in our employees by providing opportunities to develop technical expertise while contributing to meaningful customer and business outcomes.

Working for you

We offer a competitive benefits package aligned with local market standards, including:

• Work‑life balance and wellbeing programs
• Comprehensive private medical care options
• Life insurance and disability coverage
• Competitive financial programs

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: ARMO Tech - Assem IV

jobs.title: Manager, Property Administration
jobs.description:
Join our community and experience Emerson College!

The Manager, Property Administration reports to the Director of Real Estate and Space Planning and is responsible for coordinating and overseeing the college's property administration, lease management, occupancy, and campus relocation functions. The position ensures the effective utilization of space, sound administration of property-related financial obligations, and efficient operation of college-owned and leased properties. Through financial analysis, operational oversight, and the development and implementation of procedures and internal controls, the Manager identifies opportunities to improve performance, optimize resources, control costs, and mitigate operational risks. The role also supports a positive tenant and community experience through tenant engagement, communication, and coordination across Finance, Facilities, Human Resources, and other campus departments. The role exercises independent judgment in resolving property-related issues, coordinating projects and service delivery, and maintaining effective relationships with tenants, landlords, vendors, and internal stakeholders. The position requires strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to coordinate multiple priorities in support of the college's operational needs.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES

●        Manage lease administration and property records for college-owned and leased properties, including monitoring lease terms, contractual obligations, critical dates, operating expenses, and occupancy information. Calculate, reconcile, and administer tenant allocations for real estate taxes (RET), common area maintenance (CAM), and other applicable occupancy-related charges.

●        Conduct financial analysis of property-related operating expenses, maintenance expenditures, and service delivery trends to evaluate financial performance, identify cost-saving opportunities, and develop and implement strategies to improve operational efficiency, control costs, and support budget planning and resource allocation decisions. Process and review building-specific vendor invoices and ensure timely, accurate payment details.

●        Develop, implement, and evaluate property management procedures and internal controls related to lease administration, operating expense tracking, vendor coordination, and service delivery. Identify operational risks, resolve process deficiencies, establish consistent work practices, and implement improvements to strengthen accountability, compliance, and cost-effectiveness.

●        Manage tenant relations and oversee the resolution of property-related issues and concerns, assess tenant needs, determine appropriate courses of action, coordinate corrective measures with property managers, vendors, and college departments, and monitor follow-up to ensure timely resolution and effective property operations.

●        Oversee the accuracy and maintenance of faculty and staff location data, coordinating updates associated with onboarding, departures, departmental changes, and space reassignments. Develop onboarding and orientation documentation for space, access, and furniture setup for new employees.

●        Manage campus moves and relocations, develop scopes of work, establish project plans and schedules, and coordinate budgets, resources, vendors, and internal stakeholders. Direct project implementation, resolve operational and logistical challenges, monitor progress and expenditures, and ensure projects meet established timelines, approved budgets, space requirements, and college design standards. Coordinate tenant-improvement and renovation projects with property managers and building staff, including budgets, lease terms, and communication to affected occupants.

●        Oversee the inspection and evaluation of college-owned and leased facilities to assess building conditions, cleanliness, safety, maintenance needs, and overall property standards. Identify deficiencies, prioritize corrective actions, coordinate with internal departments, property managers, and vendors to address issues, and monitor resolution to ensure facilities are properly maintained and operational requirements are met. Conduct regular walk-throughs of common areas and building frontage to proactively resolve safety hazards and maintain common-area standards.

●        Manage the campus furniture program, including procurement, delivery, installation, inventory control, allocation, and storage of furniture to support operational needs and optimize available resources.

●        Oversee the college's interior and exterior signage program, establishing implementation priorities, coordinating design, approvals, procurement, installation, and maintenance, and ensuring compliance with campus standards, accessibility requirements, and institutional branding. Evaluate signage needs, coordinate resources and vendors, and ensure consistent signage across campus facilities. Coordinate directory and wayfinding signage updates with design and signage vendors.

●        Oversee property operations and landlord relations for college-leased properties, monitor compliance with lease obligations and property management responsibilities, and evaluate the performance of property owners and management companies. Address service deficiencies, coordinate corrective actions related to maintenance, security, building access, and other operational requirements, and assess potential risks and disruptions to college operations, ensuring appropriate resolution and communication with relevant stakeholders.

●        Oversee after-hours response to property-related emergencies affecting tenants, assess reported incidents and their operational impact, determine appropriate response measures, and coordinate with tenants, property owners, management companies, emergency services, and contractors to address urgent issues. Ensure timely communication, appropriate escalation, and follow-up through resolution to minimize disruptions to tenant operations and maintain safe building conditions.

●        Manage campus building access needs and liaise with the Emerson Police Department to facilitate authorized building access.

●        Responsible for coordination with Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) to mitigate property and occupant risks. Support emergency and fire evacuation procedures and regulatory compliance.

●        Oversee key card issuance, mailbox access, and electronic security systems with security consultants, locksmiths, and vendors.

●        Responsible for daily coordination with security, janitorial, and building service vendors to maintain safety and cleanliness standards and resolve operational issues.

●        Manage meeting and event space logistics with floor plans and other support.

●        Perform other miscellaneous duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS – Qualifications are deemed required or preferred and represent what is needed to effectively perform job.

●        Bachelor's Degree in a related field required

●        5-7 years of experience in facilities management, property administration, commercial real estate, or a related field required. Experience in higher education or commercial office property operations preferred.

●        Professional certifications related to property management, facilities management, or real estate are preferred.

●        Experience coordinating with building managers, security, janitorial, and other vendors in a multi-tenant commercial property preferred.

●        Supervisory and real estate/facility management experience, with working knowledge of Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems and building automated control systems.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES – May be representative, but not all-inclusive, of those knowledge, skills, and abilities commonly associated with the job.

●        Exceptional accuracy and attention to detail required

●        Ability to read and understand legal documents such as leases, vendor contracts, and certificates of insurance

●        Good math skills, and experience with billing, chargebacks, and account reconciliations

●        Intermediate to Expert proficiency in MS Excel and the ability to learn new software easily

●        Ability to interpret architectural and engineering drawings.

●        Working knowledge of occupancy management, and facility utilization analysis.

●        Ability to tour a property and identify safety issues and construction flaws

●        Ability to schedule and supervise student workers

●        Strong customer service and tenant relations skills, with experience communicating building-wide projects and updates to occupants.

●        Ability to collaborate across Finance, Human Resources, Marketing, Facilities, and departmental leadership.

●        Experience developing process documentation, internal tracking tools, and orientation materials.

●        Excellent organizational skills and the ability to maintain multiple projects simultaneously and to prioritize tasks

●        Self-starter with excellent interpersonal communication and problem-solving skills

PHYSICAL ABILITIES – Activities commonly associated with the performance of the functions of this job. The physical demands described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

●        This position is moderately active in nature, movement throughout the college buildings is routinely required.

●        Ability to have continuous oral and written communication with clients, co-workers and supervisors is essential.

●        Repetitive movements, frequent lifting of up to 30 pounds, reaching, pushing, stooping, climbing, and the ability to read a computer screen, detect color-coding, and read fine print will be expected.

WORK ENVIRONMENT – Environmental or atmospheric conditions commonly associated with the performance of the functions of this job.

●        This position works in an office environment, event spaces, and in all areas of campus buildings

●        Exposed to moderate noise levels

●        Occasionally exposed to inclement weather conditions

IN-OFFICE EXPECTATIONS
This position requires an in-person presence on the Boston Campus during the work week.

Compensation: $74,500.00 - $91,350.00 annually, commensurate with experience.

Grade of Position: 23-09E

Employment Category: Regular

jobs.title: Manager, Seller Retention & Engagement Marketing
jobs.description:
Company Description
Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will address  unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What's the Role?

Etsy is seeking a highly analytical Manager to lead our Seller Retention & Engagement Marketing (REM / CRM) team. The team owns how Etsy communicates with sellers across email, push, and other owned channels, helping sellers get started, grow, and stay successful on the marketplace.

The ideal candidate has marketed to businesses (B2B) or to the supply side of a marketplace before, and brings rigor to every decision: what we send, to whom, how often, and whether it moved seller outcomes. You'll lead a cross-functional team spanning lifecycle marketing, strategy and planning, operations, and development. You'll decide how the team delivers against our seller priorities, turn those priorities into a clear quarterly plan, and build the operating practices that let teams across Etsy reach sellers with relevant, timely communications without over-messaging them.

This role sits at the intersection of lifecycle marketing, seller education, product, and analytics. It requires someone who can speak for the seller inside Marketing, find the signal in detailed analysis, and make sound calls when the data is incomplete.

What's This Team Like at Etsy?

Seller Marketing helps Etsy's sellers start, grow, and thrive. Within it, the REM team is a group of technical marketers and operators who deliver personalized, high-quality communications at scale through Braze and other owned channels. We work alongside Seller Content, Community and Product Marketing teams so that every message reflects Etsy's seller voice and tone. We care as much about getting the numbers right as getting the message right, and we hold ourselves to honest readouts, including when a test doesn't win.

What Does the Day-to-Day Look Like?

• Lead the team that owns seller lifecycle strategy and planning, operations, and execution, including coaching, goal setting, performance feedback, and equitable hiring, onboarding, and promotion practices
• Translate annual seller marketing priorities into a quarterly roadmap with clear KPIs, and report progress against them to senior leaders
• Manage the lifecycle portfolio, not just individual sends: inventory, relevance, prioritization, and per-seller frequency across onboarding, growth, peak season, reactivation, and policy or fee changes
• Define seller segments and turn them into targeted, personalized journeys across email and other owned channels
• Build a measurement approach that connects reach, delivery, engagement, and downstream seller behavior to incremental value, using holdouts and sound experiments rather than opens and clicks alone
• Oversee execution in Braze, including segmentation, journey design, QA, and deployment, with a high bar for quality and compliance
• Align work across Seller Content, Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Customer Support, and communicate performance, risks, and trade-offs to stakeholders
• Foster a culture of testing and learning that shapes where Etsy invests next in seller communications

Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities That Will Help You Thrive in This Role

Required

• Direct experience in B2B marketing or on the supply side of a marketplace (sellers, hosts, drivers, creators, merchants, or similar)
• Highly analytical, with a track record of using data to set strategy, size opportunities, and make prioritization trade-offs
• 7+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing, including end-to-end campaigns from strategy through measurement
• Hands-on experience designing and reading experiments (holdout, A/B, multivariate), with sound judgment about incrementality, cohort quality, retention, and lifetime value rather than delivery or click metrics alone
• Comfort working directly with data, including SQL and Cursor, or a strong working partnership with analytics teams
• 2+ years of experience managing people, with a track record of developing and retaining strong teams
• Hands-on experience with a marketing automation platform (Braze preferred), including segmentation, personalization, and deliverability, plus working knowledge of how AI can automate lifecycle work (for example drafting and QA of copy, audience building, reporting, and workflow automation) and good judgment about where human review is still needed
• Experience building processes and quality standards that increase team speed without sacrificing quality
• Success partnering across Content, Product, Engineering, and Analytics, and influencing stakeholders without direct authority
• A bias for action and the ability to turn detailed analysis into a clear recommendation, even when you don't have all the data

Nice to have

• Experience in a two-sided marketplace with a large, diverse, global seller base, including localization
• Experience managing a program budget and reporting ROI
• Familiarity with feature adoption analysis and churn prevention for business customers
• An entrepreneurial mindset: you enjoy building structure and finding creative solutions with limited resources
• A passion for Etsy's mission to keep commerce human and support the creativity of small business owners

Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.

Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. jobs.description:
Senior Lead Project Manager, Agentic AI Platform

The future of money is being built right now. At FIS, we help the world’s businesses, banks and communities move, manage and grow money with confidence. Join a team that values fresh thinking, works together to solve complex challenges, and creates technology that powers everyday life.

About the role

We are looking for a Project Manager Sr Lead, PMO to support the FIS Agentic AI Platform Product & Operations organization. In this role, you will lead planning, delivery governance and operational discipline across platform development, product onboarding, artificial intelligence workload migration and production readiness. You will work with Product, Engineering, Operations, Risk, Security, Compliance and business teams to turn priorities into clear plans, measurable results and reliable delivery.

Your key responsibilities

• Own the integrated program plan for the platform roadmap, onboarding and migration workstreams. Capture and manage all committed milestones, owners, dependencies and target dates, and report milestone variance through agreed review cycles.
• Run weekly risk, action, issue and dependency reviews. Maintain decision and action logs with owners and due dates, target at least 90% on-time action closure, and escalate overdue critical items with clear recovery plans.
• Coordinate work across Product, Engineering, Operations, Risk, Security, Compliance and portfolio teams. Assign an owner and resolution date to every critical dependency and escalate critical blockers within one business day.
• Lead release and operational readiness reviews using clear entry and exit criteria. Confirm that every production release has go/no-go evidence, service and support ownership, operational controls, and rollback and recovery plans before launch.
• Manage platform adoption, onboarding and migration against approved targets. Maintain one program tracker for all in-scope solutions, provide weekly progress, ageing and exception reports, and deliver monthly scorecards covering delivery, adoption, service health, risk, cost and value.

What you bring

Required qualifications

• 10 or more years of experience leading complex enterprise technology programs or Project Management Office delivery across teams, stakeholders and locations.
• Experience turning strategy and product roadmaps into integrated delivery plans, with strong milestone, dependency, risk, issue and decision management.
• Strong knowledge of Agile and product delivery practices, including demand, backlog, release and executive reporting across Product and Engineering teams.
• Proven ability to work across technology, operations, governance and business teams, influence without direct authority, and build accountability in a fast-moving environment.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex program information into clear executive updates and decisions.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience supporting artificial intelligence, cloud, platform engineering, developer platforms or enterprise technology transformation programs.
• Familiarity with agentic artificial intelligence platforms, technology governance, onboarding and migration, observability, operational readiness or production support models.
• Experience working in financial services or another regulated environment.

The impact you’ll make:

The Agentic AI Platform is building a common, governed foundation for artificial intelligence solutions across FIS, including secure model access, agentic workloads, controls and enterprise adoption. As Project Manager Sr Lead, PMO, you will connect strategy to delivery by creating the program discipline needed to scale the platform, speed up onboarding and migration, manage critical dependencies and give leaders a clear view of progress and risk. Your work will help FIS deliver artificial intelligence capabilities safely, consistently and at enterprise scale.

What we offer you

Bring your ideas. Build your future. At FIS, you'll find the support, resources and opportunities to develop your career while helping shape the future of financial technology.

We offer:

• Internal career growth opportunities
• Opportunities to innovate in fintech

• Support Australia's Defence mission.
• Operate the systems you maintain in a unique dual-role technical position.

Your mission starts here at Raytheon Australia! Right now, we are seeking a bright and energised Maintenance and Operations Technician. Join our team of outstanding people with expertise across a wide range of disciplines and position yourself at the forefront of tomorrow's capabilities.

You'll be supported by best-practice tools, systems and processes while contributing to a nationally significant Defence capability.

As a Maintenance and Operations Technician, you'll play a key role in the operation, maintenance and support of mission-critical Defence capability. Unlike traditional maintenance roles, you'll not only maintain and troubleshoot specialised equipment, but also operate the systems you support, providing a unique understanding of their capability and operational application.

Working as part of a skilled team, you'll conduct planned and corrective maintenance, fault diagnosis, equipment testing and operational support activities to ensure systems remain safe, reliable and ready to meet customer requirements. You'll contribute to equipment upgrades and sustainment activities while working closely with experienced technicians, engineers and Defence personnel.

This hands-on role offers a diverse mix of workshop, field and operational activities, allowing you to apply your technical skills while directly supporting the delivery of a nationally significant Defence capability.

Opportunities for travel throughout Australia and internationally may also be available in support of customer and operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities

• Operate mission systems and associated support equipment in accordance with approved procedures.
• Conduct planned and corrective maintenance activities to ensure equipment remains available and serviceable.
• Troubleshoot, diagnose and rectify equipment faults.
• Support equipment testing, commissioning and operational activities.
• Assist with the implementation of approved modifications and upgrades.
• Maintain accurate maintenance records and technical documentation.
• Support configuration management and equipment sustainment activities.
• Contribute to a safe working environment and comply with all safety requirements.
• Support field activities, exercises and operational tasks as required.
• Travel within Australia and internationally as required.

Skills, Experience and Qualifications:

We are seeking applications from suitably qualified tradespeople with either a Mechanical or Electrical trade background.

Mechanical Trade Experience:

• Cert III/IV qualification in a Mechanical trade discipline (Essential).
• Experience maintaining, repairing and supporting mechanical equipment in field, workshop or operational environments (Essential).
• Knowledge of mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems, including associated support equipment and assets (Highly Desirable).

Electrical Trade Experience:

• Cert III/IV qualification in an Electrical trade discipline (Essential).
• Experience maintaining, repairing and supporting electrical equipment in field, workshop or operational environments (Essential).
• Knowledge of electrical, control and power distribution systems, including fault-finding and diagnostic activities (Highly Desirable).

All Applicants:

• Experience within Defence, heavy industry, mining, transport or similar technical maintenance environments (Desirable).
• Ability to interpret technical manuals, maintenance documentation, technical drawings, schematics and fault diagnosis procedures relevant to your trade (Desirable).
• Proven ability to carry out preventative, scheduled and breakdown maintenance safely and efficiently (Essential).
• Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving and fault-finding skills, with the ability to identify and rectify equipment issues in a timely manner (Desirable).
• Experience working on operational, workshop and field-deployed equipment and support assets (Desirable).
• HC Licence (or ability to obtain).
• Successful candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Negative Vetting Level 1 Security Clearance (Essential).

We offer flexible work arrangements, a supportive team environment and unique opportunities to work with advanced technology in operational settings. This is your opportunity to join a fast-moving organisation delivering critical outcomes for the Australian Defence Force and supporting Australia's Defence mission.

This is your opportunity to join the brightest minds in the nation working for the mission on leading-edge technology to deliver Australia’s most significant Defence capabilities.

jobs.title: Auto Damage Trainee (Field)
jobs.description:
Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

Please note: This is not a remote role; you will be required to work in the territory listed on the job posting.

Your Impact at GEICO

As a Field Auto Damage Trainee, you’ll provide reassurance and solutions that make a difference in our customers' lives when they need us the most after an accident. You will inspect and assess vehicle damage, estimate vehicle repair costs, negotiate equitable settlements, and partner with body shops, rental companies, and parts providers.

What Makes This Opportunity Exciting?

• Compensation & Incentives: Starting Salary: $25.95 per hour / $52,275 annuallyBonuses: $1,500 sign-on for licensed candidates.
• Benefits: Health and wellness benefits starting Day 1 (medical, dental, vision, flexible spending accounts and more). Accrue Paid Time Off immediately, plus 13 paid holidays annually (8 fixed, 5 floating). 401(k) with up to 6% match, vested immediately. GEICO Strive, upfront tuition assistance program (up to $5,250 annually).
• Professional Growth: Licensing and continuing education at no cost, including hundreds of eLearning courses to enhance your skills. GEICO’s industry-leading paid trainee program includes 3 weeks of required hands-on experience at our Ashburn, VA training facility. In addition, 2 weeks in a field training center (NY, TX, CA), with mentors to help you learn and grow.
• Field Territory: GEICO Fleet vehicle assigned and responsible for the State College, PA area.

How You’ll Make a Difference

• Customer Interaction: Consult with involved parties, review insurance contracts, inspect vehicles, write estimates, and manage rental cars.
• Problem Resolution: Resolve customer concerns, ensuring a positive experience.
• Meaningful Impact: Drive customer satisfaction through meaningful interactions.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience & Qualifications: Customer-facing experience preferred. Experience in high-volume call centers with KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) and measurable goals preferred. Active Adjusters license preferred (training and exam fees provided). High School Diploma or GED required; College degree preferred. Valid driver’s license that meets company underwriting guidelines required.
• Core Skills: Strong customer service, interpersonal, problem-solving, and empathy skills. Adaptable, detail-oriented, and able to prioritize and multitask across platforms.
• Availability: Available to work evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Annual Salary

$25.95 - $40.19

The above annual salary range is a general guideline. Multiple factors are taken into consideration to arrive at the final hourly rate/ annual salary to be offered to the selected candidate. Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.

At this time, GEICO will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The GEICO Pledge:

Great Company: Protecting customers through life’s twists and turns with innovation and integrity.

Great Careers: Personalized development programs, mentorship, and certification assistance.

Great Culture: Inclusive and collaborative culture rooted in shared success.

Great Rewards: Competitive pay, benefits, and flexibility to support your well-being and future.

The equal employment opportunity policy of the GEICO Companies provides for a fair and equal employment opportunity for all associates and job applicants regardless of race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, familial status, disability or genetic information, in compliance with applicable federal, state and local law. GEICO hires and promotes individuals solely on the basis of their qualifications for the job to be filled.

GEICO reasonably accommodates qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to receive equal employment opportunity and/or perform the essential functions of the job, unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship to the Company. This applies to all applicants and associates. GEICO also provides a work environment in which each associate is able to be productive and work to the best of their ability. We do not condone or tolerate an atmosphere of intimidation or harassment. We expect and require the cooperation of all associates in maintaining an atmosphere free from discrimination and harassment with mutual respect by and for all associates and applicants.

jobs.title: Lead Product Service Engineer Controls Platform HMI & Network
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

The Lead Product Service Engineer - Controls Platform HMI & Network provides direct technical support to global GE Vernova Gas Power customers across three primary workstreams.

1) Resolving or mentoring team through customer technical inquiries via engineering request (ER) cases
2) Leading or engaging in complex issues involving Power Plant Control Systems, HMIs. Networks and associated product Cyber Security root cause analysis (RCA) investigations for high business impact issues, often with cross-functional teams.
3) Communicating GEV technical guidance to customers or site representatives via user conferences, customer webinars, and technical documents; additionally, communicating technical details and business risks to GE Vernova internal stakeholders

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

• Own the technical resolution to multiple complex Controls system issues including Mark VI/VIe Product line, Human Machine Interface (HMI) platform, Industrial communication interface (Modbus, Foundation Fieldbus, OPC, Profibus, CAN bus, EGD etc.), historians, and industrial cyber security at power plants with a sense of urgency.
• Identify trending issues and provide countermeasures to protect our customers’ fleet, then communicate to the relevant audience (TILs, PSxBs, ETCs, OnTheGo alerts, etc.)
• Collaborate with Design Engineering, Product Management, Regional Customer Engineering Centers, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Vendors, and/or Customers to provide sound technical resolution in a timely manner
• Drive complex RCAs through root cause and corrective action while communicating both internally (field teams, GEV leadership) and externally to end customers
• Lead and promote the GE Vernova Way traits, lean principles, and simplification into day-to-day activities

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s and/or Master's degree in engineering from accredited university.
• Minimum 7 years of direct experience with Human Machine Interface (HMI) platform, Industrial communication interface (Modbus, Foundation Fieldbus, OPC, Profibus, CAN bus, EGD etc.), historians, and industrial cyber security at power plants.
• Proven experience in a customer-facing role
• Strong oral and written communication in English language
• This role requires around 10-15% within and outside of the region

Eligibility Requirement:

• Applicants must have the legal right to work in KSA without company sponsorship or time restrictions.​

Desired Characteristics

• Proven experience with Mark VI/VIe Product line
• Self-starter and resourceful problem-solver that can navigate the GE Vernova resource databases and organizations to deliver a solution, with urgency
• Not afraid of being uncomfortable with the specific technical problem and willingness to apply engineering problem-solving methods to resolve the issue, under pressure
• Ability to communicate at all levels (field engineers, site engineers, plant managers, GE Vernova leadership, etc.)
• Ability to rapidly change directions for multiple concurrent projects based on emergent business priorities
• Industry Certifications such as GICSP, CCNP, or ISA/IEC 62443
• Humble, open, collaborative, and continuously learning
• Strong oral and written communication in Arabic language

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

jobs.title: CNC Dreher  (2-Schicht) (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Teil von GE Vernova werden!

Möchten Sie einen globalen Beitrag leisten und Probleme lösen?

Durch ungebremsten Innovationsgeist und in fortlaufender Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden sorgen wir bei Gas Power, einem Geschäftsbereich von GE Vernova, für eine fortschrittlichere, sauberere und effizientere Energieversorgung der Menschheit und entwickeln gleichzeitig Technologien zur Energiegewinnung für die Zukunft.

Als engagiertes Mitglied unseres GE Vernova Repair-Teams am Produktionsstandort in Birr werden Sie in einem 2-Schichtbetrieb aktiv an der Unterstützung der Produktionsabteilung mitwirken. Dabei bringen Sie Ihre Eigeninitiative ein und tragen maßgeblich zur Optimierung unserer Abläufe bei.

Job Description

Stellenbeschreibung:

Ihre Aufgaben

• Einrichten und Bedienen einer CNC-Maschine und einer konventionellen Drehbank zur Bearbeitung von Turbinenkomponenten

• Rüsten der Betriebsmittel (Vorrichtungen, Schleifscheiben, Fräswerkzeuge und Elektroden) zur Bearbeitung der Komponenten in verschiedenen Aufspannungen

• Überwachen der Anlagen und Beheben von Störungen auch in Zusammenarbeit mit der Instandhaltungsabteilung

• Durchführen von Wartungsarbeiten an den Anlagen und Peripherie-Geräten

• Entgraten und Kennzeichnen der Bauteile gemäss geforderten Spezifikationen

• Durchführen von selbstständigen Masskontrollen (Qualitätskontrolle) sowie Bestätigen der Qualitätsprüfungen durch Rückmeldungen im SAP-System

• Dokumentieren der Produktionskennzahlen

Was Sie mitbringen sollten (Grundqualifikationen)

• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung oder Erfahrung in der industriellen Fertigung

• Gute Kenntnisse in der CNC-Bearbeitung und dem konventionellen Drehen

• Gute Kenntnisse und Erfahrung in der Qualitätsprüfung

• Gute Kenntnisse im Lesen von technischen Zeichnungen und Dokumenten

• Gute PC-Kenntnisse und gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Was zeichnet Sie aus?

• Teamfähigkeit, Disziplin und Flexibilität für zusätzliche Einsätze

• Sorgfältige, qualitätsbewusste und exakte Arbeitsweise nach Vorgaben und Richtlinien

• Rasche Auffassungsgabe

Was wir Ihnen bieten

Mitarbeiter und Mitarbeiterinnen bei GE Vernova stellen sich der Herausforderung, an der Schaffung einer Welt mitzuwirken, der es gut geht. Um dieser Mission nachzukommen, bieten wir unterschiedliche wettbewerbsfähige Vorteile für unsere Belegschaft.

• Unser Vergütungssystem ist so ausgelegt, dass unsere Mitarbeiter und Mitarbeiterinnen Berufs- und Privatleben in Einklang bringen können und dass starke Leistung honoriert wird. Je nach Mitarbeiterstatus und staatlichen Vorgaben bieten wir ein attraktives Leistungspaket.
• Jeder Mensch hat eine individuelle Vorstellung davon, was für ihn ein ausgewogenes, gesundes Leben bedeutet. Wir haben Programme entwickelt, die Sie in Ihrer Lebens- und Arbeitsweise unterstützen.
• GE Vernova investiert, um seinen Mitarbeitenden im Rahmen von praktischen Fortbildungs- und Weiterentwicklungsprogrammen Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung zu bieten.

Wir bei GE Vernova glauben an den Wert der Identität, des Hintergrunds und der Erfahrungen jeder einzelnen Person. Wir legen Wert auf eine integrative Unternehmenskultur, in der jeder und jede einzelne ermutigt wird, sein bzw. ihr Bestes zu geben, weil er/sie sich akzeptiert, respektiert und zugehörig fühlt.

Inklusion und Vielfalt

Uns liegt es sehr am Herzen, ein integratives Arbeitsklima zu schaffen. Durch Wertschätzung der Ideen und Beiträge einer vielfältigen Belegschaft, regen und spornen wir andere zum Wachsen und zum Erfolg an. Kommen Sie zu GE Vernova Gas Power, wo Sie in einer Atmosphäre der Zugehörigkeit Erfolge erzielen können.

Über GE Vernova Gas Power

GE Vernova Gas Power entwickelt Lösungen für eine sauberere, leichter zugängliche Energieversorgung, auf die die Menschen angewiesen sind und die überall Wachstum und Wohlstand antreibt. Unsere führenden Gasenergietechnologien, die wir einem Team an talentierten Mitarbeitern und Mitarbeiterinnen zu verdanken haben und für unsere Kunden und Kundinnen, Anteilseigner und Anteilseignerinnen und die Welt tätig sind, produzieren einen Drittel des Stroms weltweit. Durch ungebremsten Innovationsgeist und in fortlaufender Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden und Kundinnen entwickeln wir Technologien zur Energiegewinnung für die Zukunft und sorgen gleichzeitig für eine sauberere und effizientere Energieversorgung für die Menschheit.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Job Description

Zakład Produkcji Turbin, część globalnego koncernu GE Vernova, zajmuje się produkcją kompletnych turbin parowych dla elektrowni parowych, gazowych i jądrowych. Produkuje kompletne turbiny parowe różnej mocy oraz moduły, podzespoły i części zamienne, stosując nowatorskie rozwiązania technologiczne.

Dzięki temu turbiny parowe wyprodukowane przez oddział GE Power sp. z o.o. w Elblągu trafiają do elektrowni na całym świecie.

W związku ze wzrostem ilości projektów produkcyjnych zatrudniamy pracowników zarówno na stanowiska produkcyjne, jak i biurowe.

Wszystkie otwarte stanowiska można znaleźć na stronie: careers.gevernova.com.

GE Power sp. z o. o. w Elblągu

poszukuje kandydatów/kandydatki do pracy na stanowisku:

Kierownik ds produkcji wydziału (M/K/N)

Miejsce pracy: Elbląg

Kierownik ds. Produkcji na Wydziale Produkcyjnym raportuje bezpośrednio do Kierownika Wydziału Produkcyjnego, współpracuje ściśle z Kierownikiem Produkcji Zakładu Produkcji Turbin i zarządza zespołem mistrzów na danym wydziale.

Główne zadania i odpowiedzialność:

• Bieżący nadzór nad produkcją w celu zapewnienia terminowej realizacji planu produkcyjnego zgodnie z wymaganiami jakościowymi, technologicznymi i bezpieczeństwa
• Współpraca z sekcjami: planowo - rozdzielczą, kontroli jakości, technologiczną i utrzymania ruchu oraz działem przepływów materiałowych w celu zapewnienia realizacji planu produkcyjnego
• Analizowanie realizacji planu produkcyjnego oraz podejmowanie działań w celu zapewnienia terminowej realizacji projektów
• Wyciąganie wniosków z realizacji planów produkcyjnych i inicjowanie oraz wdrażanie działań usprawniających
• Zarządzanie podległym zespołem
• Współpraca z działem infrastruktury pod kątem opracowywania planów i realizacji remontów maszyn
• Koordynacja wdrażania i kwalifikacji nowych procesów, produktów i maszyn
• Raportowanie i wizualizacja wskaźników (dostawy na czas, dostępność maszyn, produktywność)
• Optymalizacja kosztów produkcji z wykorzystaniem narzędzi Lean
• Budowanie kultury ciągłego doskonalenia, odpowiedzialności oraz współpracy w zespole

Nasze oczekiwania:

• Doświadczenie w zarządzaniu produkcją (przemysł maszynowy)

Function

Corporate Strategy

Our Company

We’re Hitachi Digital, a company at the forefront of digital transformation and the fastest growing division of Hitachi Group. We’re crucial to the company’s strategy and ambition to become a premier global player in the massive and fast-moving digital transformation market.

Our group companies, including GlobalLogic, Hitachi Digital Services, Hitachi Vantara and more, offer comprehensive services that span the entire digital lifecycle, from initial idea to full-scale operation and the infrastructure to run it on. Hitachi Digital represents One Hitachi, integrating domain knowledge and digital capabilities, and harnessing the power of the entire portfolio of services, technologies, and partnerships, to accelerate synergy creation and make real-world impact for our customers and society as a whole.

Imagine the sheer breadth of talent it takes to unleash a digital future. We don’t expect you to ‘fit’ every requirement – your life experience, character, perspective, and passion for achieving great things in the world are equally as important to us.

Job description

Hitachi has a history of large scale M&A and the Corporate Development team in the DEAI group (Digital Engineering & AI) play a key role in delivering the groups transactions, strategic investments and other growth initiatives across a global technology business. You will work across the full deal lifecycle, combining rigorous financial analysis with cross-functional leadership and senior stakeholder engagement.

What You’ll Do

• Manage multiple transactions and strategic projects across the M&A lifecycle.
• Build financial models and valuations, including DCF, comparable companies, precedent transactions and LBO analysis.
• Lead cross-functional due diligence with Finance, Legal, HR, IT and Operations, translating findings into clear risks and recommendations.
• Conduct market, competitor and technology-sector analysis to support investment decisions.
• Prepare business cases and proposals for senior leadership and board-level approval.
• Build strong relationships with global stakeholders, investment banks, consultants and other external advisers.

What You’ll Bring

• Significant experience in corporate development, private equity, investment banking, strategy consulting or a transaction-focused role.
• A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related analytical discipline.
• Strong financial modelling, valuation and financial statement analysis skills.
• Experience managing several projects at different stages of the deal lifecycle and working with stakeholders globally.
• Sound commercial judgement, strategic thinking and the ability to influence senior leaders.

Preferred: Experience in technology, software or IT services; an MBA; and familiarity with Capital IQ, PitchBook or similar platforms. Occasional travel may be required.

jobs.title: Night Replenishment Manager
jobs.description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

Position Purpose:

Night Replenishment Managers (NRM) are members of the store leadership team and oversees freight handling activities. NRMs supervise the freight unload, pack out, and pack down processes. NRMs communicate priorities, ensure nightly tasks are completed, and freight is moving smoothly throughout the store. This position will be expected to teach, coach, and train associates on The Home Depot policies and procedures and ensure all associates are working in a safe manner all the time. At times, NRMs may be the only Manager available and will be expected to make business and associate decisions in partnership with appropriate resources and following SOPs. NRMs will provide input to Store Manager and Assistant Store Managers on Associates performance through the ongoing performance management and talent planning discussions. Although the NRM does not have direct reports, they will participate in the selection process as needed.   Each associate has the responsibility of providing a safe working environment by following all safety policies & standards, completing specified safety training, immediately correcting hazards & unsafe conditions and working safely as to not endanger themselves, co-workers, vendors, or customers.

Key Responsibilities:

• 25% - People - Provide in the moment coaching based on observations and behavior. Partners with Night Operations ASMs regarding formal performance conversations and discipline. Recognizes associates for demonstrating expectations. Use recognition tools (BRAVO / Homer) to highlight associates demonstrating values-based behaviors and productivity. Conduct quality walks of recently completed tasks. Walk off-shelf merchandising locations; ensure areas are set according to MAP or regional direction. Ensure associates have completed training requirements of position. Give input to Night Operations ASM on associate performance and participate in talent planning for all hourly associates. Assist SM and Night Operations ASM with associate interview and hiring process. Approve and address missed punches, variances, schedule changes, receive "call outs" and communicate with Night Operations ASM and SM regarding follow-up actions. Communicate and ensure associates adhere to store standards. Adhere to all Company policies and procedures and holds associates accountable for the same.
• 25% - Replenishment - Partner with Night Operations ASM to determine responsibilities to drive efficiencies and overnight productivity. Direct supervision of the Consistent Unload, Directed Packout, and Purge Pack down processes. Execute Quality Walks to ensure associates are completing the Packout process correctly. Ensure all trucks and trailers are received and unloaded timely and efficiently. Ensure all freight is packed out or placed in overhead quickly and efficiently. Ensure that all trash is cleaned up and the store is Grand Opening ready at the end of the shift. Prioritize and communicate messages and tasks to all associates and leaders in store.
• 25% - Safety - Ensure associates follow all safety and hazmat procedures and Safety Matters guidelines at all times. Complete specified safety training courses applicable to role and follow all prevention policies and procedures. Use Proper PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) and guide associates on proper use. Utilize proper lifting techniques and educate store associates on these practices. Obey the required safe distances around Lift Equipment and guide other associates on the correct policies. Adhere to work rules identified in Standard Operating Procedures and inform store associates on these rules. Immediately correct unsafe conditions and offer assistance to customers who are shopping in an unsafe manner; ensure that aisles and flooring surfaces are safe. Ensure associates complete all store checklist in accordance with timing expectations. Provide input to associates, verify issue correction, and preventative action in put in place. Recognize store associates for safe behavior.
• 25% - Shared Manager On Duty - Perform Closing and MOD tasking as well as other whole store focus responsibilities. Conduct hand-off walk with the prior MOD before their shift ends; identify areas for focus or follow-up. Validate daily store priorities with ASMs and SMs. Ensure associates complete all store checklists in accordance with timing expectations. Provide input to associates, verify issue correction, and preventative action is put in place. Make sure all equipment and machines are functioning properly. Review current and upcoming events and ads to determine if any action is required; partner with appropriate DS or ASM as required.

jobs.title: Operations Business Analyst- Rental Recovery
jobs.description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

Position Purpose:

Must live within 50 miles of the Store Support Center

Serve as the subject-matter specialist for Rental vehicle and truck recovery, protecting Home Depot Rental assets by identifying, vetting, and driving the recovery of stolen, converted, and slow-rent vehicles. Analyze GPS, claim, and system data to determine asset status and recovery priority; manage NCIC and Legal Lock processes in partnership with Law Enforcement, Legal, and the Vehicles team; coordinate third-party recovery vendors to return assets to stores and revenue faster. Execute a structured daily and weekly recovery cadence, maintain data integrity across recovery and asset systems, and communicate status, issues, and roadblocks to leadership and cross-functional partners.

Key Responsibilities:

• NCIC Monitoring, Clearing & Legal Lock: Conduct daily NCIC reviews to identify NCIC-active vehicles and initiate Legal Lock with the Vehicles team. Own the NCIC clearing process—review the Legal Lock dashboard weekly, partner with law enforcement to clear recovered assets, and complete transfers and status updates in the asset management system.

• Slow Rent Vetting & Recovery Dispatch: Vet the weekly Slow Rent report using GPS data and claim notes to confirm asset location and status; upload validated units to third-party recovery vendors and follow up on dispatched units.

• Recovery Vendor Management & Billing: Manage vendor partnerships, pull truck rental contracts to support assignments, and submit and reconcile weekly recovery billing for accuracy and cost control.

• Recovery Validation & System Status: Vet recovered units and confirm recovery details (VIN, location, condition, date); partner with IT to check units in and move them to Out on Repair so assets return to revenue quickly.

jobs.description:
Your Impact at Lowe's

Within our warehouse team, you play a key role in making sure our products are accurately received, organized, and shipped. As part of a team dedicated to delivering excellence in supply chain operations, your work directly affects our success in achieving our mission.

How We Support You

As an industry leader, we invest in the people and technology needed to grow and win as a team.

• Culture of Belonging: Our teams enjoy a positive work environment where leaders support and respect you, and associates genuinely appreciate each other.
• Financial Future: We invest in you – own part of the company with our optional Employee Stock Purchase Plan, or participate in our matching 401k plan.
• Bonus Potential: When we win, you win. We award front line workers discretionary and profit-sharing bonuses when we succeed.
• Health and Wellbeing: We offer paid time off for vacations, holidays and sick time, as well as access to top-tier medical, dental and vision insurance.

For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits.

Your Day at Lowe's

As a warehouse Team Member, you'll build a range of skills and play a crucial role in ensuring that our stores, customers, and communities receive the products they need. You will be expected to consistently perform your tasks efficiently and work with others as part of a team. In addition, all team members are expected to follow safety regulations and procedures.

Team Members work in diverse departments, each contributing to our supply chain operations. These departments include Building, Shipping, and Receiving.

Key Responsibilities

• Receive, organize, and ship products accurately and efficiently.
• Prioritize safety by adhering to proper procedures and conventions.
• Perform tasks in various departments as assigned by the Operations Supervisor.
• Conduct safety inspections of equipment and adhere to safety regulations.

Minimum Qualifications

• Team members may work evening, overnight, and weekend shifts, with voluntary and scheduled overtime as needed (additional pay for overtime).
• Physical fitness to move continuously throughout the facility, lift up to 70 pounds, and operate power equipment.
• Adherence to safety protocols, wearing necessary personal protective equipment.
• Ability to work in varying conditions, from extreme temperatures to noisy environments.
• Strong safety orientation and ability to work independently or within a team.

Preferred Qualifications

• High school diploma or GED equivalent.
• Previous experience in distribution center operations or warehouse settings.
• Proficiency in operating power equipment (e.g., forklift, reach truck).
• Detail-oriented with experience in a fast-paced environment.
• Basic math, reading comprehension, and computer skills.
• Spatial reasoning for effective product positioning.

Shift Schedule

This location has the greatest need for the below shifts:

• Weekend Shift: Friday-Sunday 6:00am-6:30pm
• Night Shift: Sunday 6:45pm-5:45am, Monday & Tuesday 4:45pm-5:45am
• Wednesday & Thursday 4:45pm-5:45am, Friday 6:45pm-5:45am

Working Conditions

Environmental factors vary by location. You may be working in both inside and outside weather conditions. Exposure to varying climates, including extreme heat or cold, wet, damp, humid, windy, or drafty conditions, is possible. You may be exposed to constant or intermittent noises in addition to moving or shaking objects and equipment.

Lifting methods vary based on role, weight, and volume. Associates must follow guidelines, limiting single lifts to 70 pounds. Team lifts are used minimally starting at 70 pounds or when needed. Powered equipment should be used as required, with proper training or assistance from a trained coworker.

You'll be expected to listen to customers and answer questions, communicate product or warranty information, and assist in locating or handling merchandise.

The Sales Floor Department Supervisor is primarily responsible for leading and enabling a team of associates to deliver the best possible customer experience in the store. This includes coaching and training associates, delegating, following-up on daily tasks, managing performance, and ensuring adequate department coverage. Sales Floor Department Supervisors are responsible for customer-facing activities (e.g., greeting customers, clarifying needs and identifying solutions, closing sales), non-customer-facing activities (e.g., down stocking, inventory management, area recovery) and store safety (e.g., conducting safety walks, reporting hazards, understanding safety and lifting directions).

The Sales Floor Department Supervisor works with his/her leaders to identify approaches and behaviors that best meet sales and service objectives, then communicates those best practices to the team in a way that inspires engaging, customer-focused behavior and goal attainment. Further, the Sales Floor Department Supervisor must supervise associates in other departments, as needed, to meet the demands of the store. This requires broad product knowledge and the ability to engage associates and customers across departments. It is important that this associate communicate upward to keep management informed of concerns, issues, praises, and morale.

jobs.title: Operations ASM
jobs.description:
What You Will Do
All Lowe’s associates deliver quality customer service while maintaining a store that is clean, safe, and stocked with the products our customers need. As an Operations Assistant Store Manager, this means:
• Anticipating customer flow and work demand and redirecting efforts and schedules to ensure proper coverage when and where needed.
• Planning for spikes in sales and ensuring the store has the in-stock position to support the demand.
• Conducting safety walks, monitoring use of store power equipment, and coaching associates around safe work practices.
The Operations Assistant Store Manager leads a team of associates who work together to ensure our customers receive exceptional service while shopping in a clean, safe, well-stocked store. The Operations Assistant Store Manager is accountable for achieving sales and margin goals while driving operational efficiencies and maximizing overall customer satisfaction with the Lowe’s in-store experience. At times, the Operations Assistant Store Manager is expected to provide full leadership over the store.

The Operations Assistant Store Manager collaborates with peers on the store leadership team as well as the District Manager and Area support staff to assess the needs of our customers and develop the best methods for achieving service, sales, and operational objectives.  Role-specific assignments and priorities will be tailored to front-end and back-end operations.  Furthermore, this individual may be asked to rotate through Merchandising and Specialty assignments for the purpose of cross-training and development.
Travel Requirements: This role does not require regular travel; however, this role may need to travel on occasion to meetings, trainings, or to support neighboring stores.

What We're Looking For
• Salaried: Generally scheduled for 48 hours; more hours may be required based on the needs of the business.
• Requires morning, afternoon and evening availability any day of the week.
• Physical ability to perform tasks that may require prolonged standing, sitting, and other activities necessary to perform job duties.
• Minimally must be able to lift 25 pounds without assistance; may lift over 25 pounds with or without assistance.

What You Need To Succeed
Minimum Qualifications
• 2 years of experience leading associates in a retail environment.
• 3 years of experience working in a fast-paced, cross-functional work environment.
• 1 year of experience performing manager-on-duty responsibilities, including management of daily store operations and processes within and beyond assigned areas of responsibility.
• Experience using Microsoft Office Suite.
• Ability to obtain sales related licensure or registration as may be required by law.
